<Katherine winces as she holds the shattered fragments of the broken hammer> 

I won't speak of this weapon's master in detail for the telling would fill me with shame, but I'll tell you what I can.

objectives.text: Speak with Katherine and Learn More

79940.objectivesText: Speak with Katherine the Pure and learn more about the broken hammer.
79940.title: A Lost Brother

79949.title: A Web of Lies: Debunking Myths and Legends

79951.title: Mummies: A Guide to the Unsavory Undead

79974.description:
"Always like to keep a reserve stash nearby in the off chance I've got to flee in a hurry.

The face of this mountainside is so beautiful you might say it was carved from the waterfalls of time. 
That's the eagles nest, that's what you're looking for."
79974.objectivesText: Dusting off a messenger bag emerging from the soil, you find a parchment nestled among the supplies.
79974.title: Wet Job

79976.description:
"So, I've decided to take my work back underground. To stop it falling into the wrong hands."

<The paper is torn just large enough to fit the message. You aren't sure if these are the last words you'll read from the author, or if they're a clue to the next hideout. An inadequately secured sleeping bag is unrolling itself onto your feet...>
79976.objectivesText: Whoever was here, you just missed them.
79976.title: This Must Be The Place

79980.description: "Not so bad, eh? Since you're reading this, it means my stash is still there. Take a hundred paces due north and don't break your ankles going down the steep cliffside. There should be enough to keep you going."
79980.title: Scramble

81900.description:
<The carving before you depicts a two-headed beast emerging from the Dark Portal. Fel-fire spews forth from its mouths. A plaque beneath the image reads: "Calefactus the Unleashed". 

Intuition tells you the Twilight cultists may have plans to harness this creature's destructive power for their own aims.

You reason that the next step in your hunt is towards the Blasted Lands. Someone there may know more of this hellish beast.>
81900.objectivesText: Find an expert on the beasts of the Blasted Lands.
81900.title: The Burning Beast

82084.description:
Your progress in the arcane arts has been exemplary, $n. I think you are ready to author a spellbook of your own.

Let's see... a quill from the Owlbeasts of the Hinterlands, and ink derived from silithid resin... yes, that will do. And for the pages, the finest Farraki Papyrus!
82084.objectivesText: Track down and collect the spellbook materials requested by the librarian.
82084.title: A Lesson in Literacy

86576.description:
In addition to spreading their filth across the Charred Vale, the Bloodfury harpies gather anything shiny that they can find. I'm told that they collect a variety of golden-yellow sunstones for decoration. I have no use for such trinkets, but Mor'rogal has mentioned using them before.

While you're fighting the harpies of the Vale, keep your eye out for Glittering Sunstones. Bring any that you find to Mor'rogal, up on the hills above us.
86576.title: Bloodfury Trinkets

86585.description:
The fallen mountaineer bears a standard of Ironforge. Perhaps she was scouting, or making a doomed charge. Either way, the standard has been cast down and trampled. The mountaineer was hit on the head so hard that her helm was knocked off and she was killed outright by a trogg, likely with a spiked club.

The trogg that killed her is probably still nearby, and likely remembers the banner. Raising the banner of Ironforge once more may call it out.
86585.objectivesText: Raise the standard of Ironforge, call out the trogg Headsplitter and kill it, then report to Captain Rugelfuss.
86585.title: Banner of the Fallen

86613.description: The excavation's tools, left behind when the dwarves fled from the troggs, seem mostly untouched. Returning them to the excavators will surely aid their work.
86613.objectivesText: Return $1oa Excavation Tools to Magmar Fellhew.
86613.title: Excavation Tools

86615.description:
Ach! Here I am serving as ambassador to the Wildhammers, and I left me satchel of the latest diplomatic missives somewhere in Wildhammer Keep. I must've left it in the tavern... or maybe I misplaced it by the steam tanks... or was it upstairs? I can never keep track!

I need those papers! If you have a better eye for the keep than I do, see if you can spot my missing diplomatic satchel!
86615.objectivesText: Find Ambassador Redstone's missing diplomatic satchel in Wildhammer Keep.
86615.title: Treaty Obligations

86620.description:
Though we have a good line of gryphons here, there are always a few egg clutches in the wild that are in danger of not making it. A gryphon parent can lose a fight against a wolf, or fall sick. Without help, the fledglings will never survive.

Fortunately, we have the means to raise and protect lost young ones like this. If you find lost eggs in the wild, bring them to me.
86620.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Lost Gryphon Eggs for Gryphon Master Talonaxe.
86620.title: Fledgling Rescue

86757.description:
Orcs have taken over the eastern forest, and their scouts and grunts now lurk throughout the woods! It's not safe for our kind to move about Ashenvale any more.

We need to push back the orcs and secure the forest. We've been able to pick off some of the grunts and scouts by carefully sneaking around the edges of their camp.

Fight the orcs and bring me the jagged swords and curved knives that they use. I'll make sure their weapons are salvaged and repurposed, so nothing goes to waste.
86757.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Jagged Orc Swords and $2oa Curved Orc Daggers to Shandrina.
86757.title: Slowing the Orc Advance

86758.description:
Did I ever tell you how I almost lost me hand to a crocolisk? Managed to jam me knife into its jaw, and scrambled out real quick. I thought I had the knife around here somewhere, but I can't seem to find it.

Anyway, that croc is probably still out there hunting along the edge of the lake. That nasty brute probably needs to go, for the safety of the other hunters, if nothing else.

I've taken to calling it Daggerfang. If you see it, give it a friendly hello from me! And by "hello" I mean "stab."
86758.objectivesText: Find and defeat the crocolisk Daggerfang and bring back Marek's knife.
86758.title: Twisting the Knife

86776.description:
Thelsamar's a great place to live, but we don't have all of the amenities of Ironforge. I'm always running out of bronze! I need more bronze if I'm going to keep making tools and kettles and pots!

I can tell you have a little experience at the forge. Think you could smelt me some bronze bars? I can pay you well for it!
86776.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Bronze Bars to Morhan Coppertongue.
86776.title: Ingredients for the Forge

86784.description:
My associate Eleanor Shackleton prides herself on traveling the wilds, surviving against weather and monsters. She is currently camped not far from here, in the hills to the west, and I remember a piece of advice that she once gave me: "When you think you have enough firewood, gather five times more."

If you have some spare time, you could collect some wood in this basket and take it to her camp. I'm sure she could give you a few tips about the existence of a traveling adventurer.
86784.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Dry Branches and bring them to Eleanor Shackleton.
86784.title: Sticks and Bones

87760.description:
I have received word back from Darnassus, $n!

From the animal samples, we learned that the naga dominated these sea creatures to use as unwilling mounts and beasts of burden. The ones that were too obstinate, or too old or badly injured, they drove out for sport. Monstrous!

It is our sacred duty to put a stop to this!

The naga have forces in the Ruins of Mathystra, and they must be seizing threshers from off the shore. Find their beastmistress, slay her, and bring back her tools of domination!
87760.objectivesText: Find a Stormscale Beastmistress, slay her, and bring back her Rod of Deep Dominion.
87760.title: Holy Diver

88756.description:
The Dark Irons have a few camps east of here on Direforge Hill, and they've stolen a bunch of explosives from our construction site and hauled 'em back to their tents.

I don't need tae tell ya what kinda mischief Dark Irons can get up tae with a barrel o' powder!

I know the Dark Irons are dangerous, but we need those barrels back. You can tell 'em from other barrels because of the red markings on 'em. We cannae let the Dark Irons keep 'em!
88756.objectivesText: Retrieve $1oa Stolen Explosives from the Dark Iron Dwarf camps.
88756.title: Bring Back a Bang

90902.description:
I am proud to welcome another newly risen paladin to our ranks. As you begin to reconnect with the light you may notice that certain abilities that were once second nature to you may cause you considerable pain to use now, particularly those involving channeling the light to heal yourself or others. 

The only way around this problem is--unfortunately--to go through it. Like any other muscle that has atrophied, you must push through the pain and exercise the flesh for it to return to full function.
90902.objectivesText: Heal $1oa Injured Deathguard with your Holy Light ability.
90902.title: Rediscovering the Light

91208.description:
Not all of our fellow Paladins who rise again are quick to acclimate to our new reality. Some struggle to reconcile that they are now, in a way, the very thing they spent their lives fighting against.

These individuals often simply need a kind gesture and a sympathetic ear. Unfortunately, many others are quick to turn violent. Find the frightened paladin who fled into the hills directly west of this chapel. Extend a hand in friendship. Lead them back into the light if you can.

objectives.text: Offer aid to the Frightened Paladin

91208.objectivesText: Find the Frightened Paladin in Deathknell.
91208.title: Coming to Terms

91317.description:
Not all risen paladins have acclimated well to our new existence, as you may have seen yourself already. Some have carried forward their prejudices from life, and continue to visit violence upon their fellow Forsaken.

As it stands we are mistrusted by our people who remember well the persecution inflicted by the living in the name of the light, and these attacks do not help. A number of these tarnished have taken up residence at Shadowvale to the southwest. End them and bring me their leader's head.
91317.objectivesText: Slay 8 Tarnished Drudges, 6 Tarnished Zealots, and collect the head of Commander Rudolph Gelhardt in Tirisfal Glades.
91317.title: The Tarnished

91725.description:
I was sent by Master Theocritus to pick up some enchanting supplies from the trading post, but on the way back I was ambushed by a pack of gnolls!

I dropped the package and escaped, but if I return without it, I'll be cleaning up after the polymorph experiments for weeks as punishment! Do you think you could find the supplies for me?
91725.objectivesText: Collect 5 Stolen Enchanting Supplies from gnoll camps around Stone Cairn Lake, then return to Blixie Fitzwink near the Tower of Azora.
91725.title: Stolen Enchanting Supplies

91733.description:
I was bringing back a supply shipment from the trading post, but my wagon tipped over and the supplies fell in the river! Before I could catch them, they had already washed downstream.

Between the murlocs and wolves down there, I don't stand a chance of retrieving the supplies on my own. You seem like the hardy sort. Do you think you could find them for me?
91733.objectivesText: Collect the Waterlogged Axe, Waterlogged Saw, and Waterlogged Toolbox that have washed downstream from Eastvale Logging Camp, then return to Ormin Pelford.
91733.title: Downstream

91740.description: This murloc has no doubt been terrorizing the local roads for some time. You suspect the nearby watch guards will want to know of its demise.
91740.objectivesText: Deliver Croaky's Head to Merell Ross at Ridgepoint Tower.
91740.title: Croaky's Head

91741.description:
<One of the kobolds dropped this book. It looks like the kobold might have tried to eat it.

Brother Paxton inside the abbey has a small library he maintains. The book must have come from there.>
91741.objectivesText: Return the book to Brother Paxton.
91741.title: Nibbled-On Book

91743.description: Those awful kobolds are eating my books! You have to get them back before they devour my whole library.
91743.objectivesText: Retrieve $1oa Stolen Books from kobolds in Northshire Valley and return them to Brother Paxton.
91743.title: Rascally Rodents

91746.description: The trophy serves as an impressive reminder of your victory over Elmpaw. A local hunter or skinner might be interested to hear the story.
91746.objectivesText: Deliver Elmpaw's Head to Helene Peltskinner near Goldshire.
91746.title: Elmpaw's Head

91751.description: Are you looking for an opportunity to practice skinning? My husband usually helps with hunting wolves, but he's busy up by the abbey. I could use a hand collecting more pelts to finish the orders I'm working on.
91751.objectivesText: Skin wolves around Elwynn Forest to obtain $1oa Rough Wolf Pelts, then deliver them to Helene Peltskinner near Goldshire.
91751.title: Rough Wolf Pelts

91752.description:
Every once in a while, a kobold comes through yelling "Picture for Narf!" I don't know who Narf is. Maybe one of the head kobolds at the back of the mine? I bet he has a whole sack of books by now.

Go get those books and bring them to our local law enforcement, Marshal McBride. You should find a friend to help. Those kobolds inside the mine are a lot meaner.
91752.objectivesText: Retrieve a Sack of "Picture" Books from Shinyfinder Narf. Bring the sack to Marshal McBride just inside Northshire's Abbey.
91752.title: The Big Picture

91753.description:
Academic rigor is of course essential to the enchanter's craft, but a practical foundation can pay dividends. Consider, as an example, the lowly Kobold. Lacking formal education, they nevertheless demonstrate a sort of innate aptitude for simple cantrips and enchantments.

Obtain some of their wax effigies and deconstruct the enchantments bound within them. You may find it elucidating.
91753.objectivesText:
Kitta Firewind in the Tower of Azora wants you to collect 3 Luminous Residue.

Luminous Residue can be obtained by disenchanting Crude Wax Effigies dropped by Kobold Geomancers.
91753.title: An Enchanting Lesson

91758.description:
You're not done with those kobolds yet. We just got word from Kelsey that a kobold left the mine carrying a large sack of books. I need you to track down this kobold so we can retrieve the books for Brother Paxton.

Go talk to Tordrin Sternblade. He's the new Hunter trainer that just arrived from Ironforge. You can find him behind the abbey, near the stable. He can help you track this kobold thief.
91758.objectivesText: Speak to Tordrin Sternblade near the stable behind Northshire's Abbey.
91758.title: Follow That Kobold!

91775.description:
While you're investigating the Fargodeep Mine, see if you can find any of Brother Paxton's books to return. In particular, Paxton is very concerned about a book titled, "Fun with Elementals". He thinks even a kobold could use it to summon an elemental servant. Be warned, the depths of the mine are fairly dangerous. You should bring friends.

Take this book bag to protect the books when you find them!
91775.objectivesText: Find 6 Lost Books and "Fun with Elementals" and return them to Marshal Dughan.
91775.title: Book Return

91777.description:
There are just two books left missing on Brother Paxton's list: "Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards" and "Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words".

The kobolds must have taken them to the Jasperlode Mine. Please track down those two books and bring them back to Brother Paxton.

But I'm afraid it will be quite dangerous. If the "apprentice" kobold was summoning an elemental, who knows what the master can do. I'd bring some friends if I were you.
91777.objectivesText: Recover "Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards" and "Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words" and return them to Brother Paxton inside Northshire's Abbey.
91777.title: Rare Books

91858.description:
A most unfortunate turn of events in Silverpine has presented a unique opportunity for us to prove our worth in the eyes of the horde.

A pair of dignitaries from the Earthen Ring went missing in Silverpine Forest en route to Tarren Mill. We don't know much else but rumors say that this is becoming quite the diplomatic incident. If we can recover these missing persons, it could help gain us the legitimacy we so dearly need.

We have a man at The Sepulcher, Trevan Rol. Travel there and speak with him.
91858.objectivesText: Travel to The Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest and speak with Trevan Rol about the missing Earthen Ring travelers.
91858.title: Diplomatic Incident

91859.description:
Cutting straight to it, these "dignitaries" are no ordinary diplomats. One was a Tauren. Ordinary enough for the Earthen Ring, but the other--and you'll scarcely believe this--was an elf. A *high* elf. They were cloaked, but I've seen quel'dorei before and I'd bet my good pinky finger that's what I saw.

Why was an elf accompanying a Tauren through horde territory? Well, your guess is as good as mine. That's as much as I know, so I'd suggest speaking with Deathguard Baldren near the entrance to town.
91859.objectivesText: Speak with Deathguard Baldren about the mysterious Earthen Ring travelers who recently passed through The Sepulcher.
91859.title: A Curious Pair

91860.description:
Out on patrol last night I spotted a group of gnolls dumping a very large body onto a pyre on the shores of Fenris Isle. I didn't see an elf or any smaller corpses, but I'd say this doesn't bode well for them.

If you are brave or stupid you are welcome to charge into Fenris Isle to learn more, but if you ask me, it's a lot of work to find some snooty elf that's probably long dead.

I know you paladins love swearing oaths and taking on lost causes, but this one isn't worth it. Trust me.
91860.objectivesText: Investigate Fenris Isle to the east and learn the fate of the Earthen Ring traveling party.
91860.title: A Grim Fate

91861.description: <The fact that you found only one body is a hopeful sign. Perhaps the High Elf that Trevan and Hadrec described is still alive somewhere deeper inside the nearby fortress?>
91861.objectivesText: Investigate Fenris Keep to the north and attempt to locate the missing member of the Earthen Ring party.
91861.title: Into Fenris Keep

91862.description:
Quel'dorei? No, I am no "quel'dorei". I am Lumina Windsinger and I am shen'dorei. One of the Windshaper Skyborne.

I came to these lands as a guest of the Earthen Ring. My companion Banon and I were passing through Silverpine to reach the Arathi Highlands so that we could study the elemental convergences there. Clearly, we didn't make it.

We have no time for this now though. Kill the gnolls nearby. Retrieve the key to this cage and free me. I will tell you the rest once we are safely away.
91862.objectivesText: Retrieve the Fenris Isle Key from the Rot Hide Gnolls and use it to free Lumina Windsinger.
91862.title: Lumina Windsinger

91920.description:
I wouldn't dare to question the effectiveness of Apothecary Renferrel's formulae, however I would be lying if I said that the potion made any noticeable difference.

Along the shore of Lake Lordamere are a swarm of murlocs, and of note, murlocs have eyes. I suspect the apothecary's willingness to try new things is suppressed by his recent obsession with hearts. Bring him a few.

If my choice is to inevitably die a second death or have Renferrel kill me for questioning his methods, I choose the latter.
91920.objectivesText: Gather 3 murloc eyes and bring them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
91920.title: Wild Eyes

91921.description:
Here is the new potion to aid in Quinn's recovery, made with love extracted from six whole hearts.

Now, please excuse me before your presence necessitates more paperwork.
91921.objectivesText: Bring Quinn's potion to Quinn Yorick at the Ivar Patch, north of the Sepulcher.
91921.title: Return to Quinn (Again)

92109.description:
Erm... 'Ello, $Gmister:miss;. I'm not supposed to talk to strangers, but... Hey, what are those shiny bottles sticking out of your backpack for? Are you an alchemist? That's so cool!

When I grow up, I want to be an alchemist too. Daddy won't let me play with any of his herbs; too dangerous, he says.

Well, I want to start learning now. Could you maybe get some supplies for me, pretty please?
92109.objectivesText: Bring 5 Empty Vials, 5 Silverleaf, and 5 Peacebloom to the young, aspiring alchemist inside the barn of Moonbrook in Westfall.
92109.title: My First Alchemy Set

92110.description:
Wow, my very first potion! Did you know that mixing those two herbs together would change the potion to a bright red color when you first started?

That was fun, but mixing a few flowers doesn't seem like the kind of alchemy Daddy does. He uses other ingredients too.

I don't know what else to use, so let's try the first thing that comes to mind! Let's see... maybe murloc eyes? That sounds so gross, but I bet something will happen.
92110.objectivesText: Gather 3 Murloc Eyes for the young, aspiring alchemist inside the barn of Moonbrook in Westfall.
92110.title: My First Real Potion

92124.description:
We need to take stock of how many books are missing!

Go talk to my useless assistant, Daniel. He can do a quick inventory and let us know how serious the problem is.

He's obsessed with the various trade professions in Elwynn Forest. The boy keeps focusing on those instead of his important work helping me.

Don't let him prattle on about tradeskills, and find out what's happened to my books!
92124.objectivesText: Speak to Daniel, Brother Paxton's assistant in the library.
92124.title: Book Inventory

92401.areaDescription: Investigate the disappearance of Edward Heartweaver in the Ruins of Lordaeron.
92401.description:
It's my husband Edward...

He has not returned from his weekly journey to the graveyard in the Lordaeron ruins. Our son was lost when Arthas razed the city, and my dear Edward is still filled with guilt and sorrow that we never found his body. I've tried to warn him against searching those overrun ruins, but he refuses to give up. I try not to worry, but it's been days.

There are things there I cannot contend with but if you are willing, I need to know the fate of my husband.
92401.objectivesText: Investigate the disappearance of Edward Heartweaver in the Ruins of Lordaeron.
92401.title: A Frightened Request

92415.description: <A torn and stained bundle of parchment has barely survived the undead trodden grounds of the graveyard. It mentions a missing child of the Heartweaver family. Perhaps the orphan matron in Stormwind City will know more.>
92415.objectivesText: Bring the Blood-Stained Letter to Orphan Matron Nightingale in Stormwind City.
92415.title: Remember That I Love You

92421.description:
As a paladin of the Forsaken, it is my duty to exact the will of our Dark Lady while tending to our people's needs. We are fortunate with an opportunity to accomplish both.

Above the Undercity, the scourge still roam unchecked in great numbers. Our forces dwindle trying to reclaim our land, and decaying flesh cannot be reknit. Not without replacements.

Would that our glorious captain Garek Bandarion still be with us, I know what he would wish. To finish what he started and heal our kin. For Lordaeron!
92421.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Intact Limbs within The Ruins of Lordaeron for Morbin Lightbane in the Undercity.
92421.title: Light's Justice

92422.description:
Reports have come in from the Lordamere Overlook deep within the Ruins of Lordaeron. An unholy fog has taken over the streets and graveyard, affording the scourge up there some measure of stealth. 

Our scouts indicate they're being conjured by a new power within their ranks, a necromancer known as Rath'mael. We do not have the luxury of waiting this one out, $n.

If you have allies, summon them and their aid to the Forsaken. Drive this creature out of our lands.
92422.objectivesText: Kill Rath'mael in the Ruins of Lordaeron for Deathguard Kristof in Brill.
92422.title: The Wrath of Rath'mael

92432.completionText: Report to the Image of Archmage Modera near the City of Dalaran.
92432.description:
I bring ill tidings from Dalaran. Something has disrupted our leylines, causing erratic and destructive behavior from our constructs in the city.

We know not yet what is causing this mayhem. The high council has ordered us to keep this matter private so as to not bring shame to our order. But we cannot keep up this charade forever. The city is being overrun as we speak!

Archmage Modera has dispatched me to solicit outside aid. Seek her image out near Dalaran beside Lordamere Lake.
92432.objectivesText: Report to the Image of Archmage Modera near the City of Dalaran.
92432.title: An Alarming Request

92434.areaDescription: Find a way into Dalaran along the Lordamere Lake
92434.description:
Whatever caused Dalaran's barrier to lower has left the city in turmoil. With you having dealt with their patrols, there is no better time than now to make our way inside and discover their secrets.

Take the key you found at the internment camp and seek out their sewers along the northern border of the city. With luck, those mages had no reason to put a ward over such a... disagreeable point of entry.
92434.objectivesText: Find a way into Dalaran along the Lordamere Lake.
92434.title: Blood in the Streets

92454.description: Welcome to the World of Warcraft!$B$BAs special thanks for purchasing the World of Warcraft Collector's Edition, turn in this gift voucher to Dalia Windbreeze in Thendal Grove. You'll then be given a gift: a little companion to join you on your quest for adventure and glory.$B$BThanks again, and enjoy your stay in the World of Warcraft!
92454.objectivesText: Bring the Thendal Grove Gift Voucher to Dalia Windbreeze.
92454.title: Welcome!

conditionalDescriptions.text:
If I have to teach you herbalism you can at least make yourself useful. I have an errand I need run.

For a city of mages, Dalaran has a surprising interest in botany. The Kirin Tor keep to themselves, but I would love a sample of their mana-infused vegetation.

You're clearly someone who is comfortable being where people don't want you, maybe you could find a way into the city. If you do, bring me back whatever is growing in their central garden.

92456.description:
If you're going to bother me you can at least make yourself useful. I have an errand I need run.

For a city of mages, Dalaran has a surprising interest in botany. The Kirin Tor keep to themselves, but I would love a sample of their mana-infused vegetation.

You're clearly someone who is comfortable being where people don't want you, maybe you could find a way into the city. If you do, bring me back whatever is growing in their central garden.
92456.objectivesText: Collect a Fel Infused Blossom from the City of Dalaran for Shylamiir in Stormwind City.
92456.title: A Green Sample

92457.description:
The breach has affected many of our factotums and enchantments throughout the city, including many that are seeing to our defenses. This fragmented arcane energy has spoken to rogue elementals who seek to saturate themselves in this free flowing magic.

While we are busy tending to the wards and other major incidents, it would be a favor to the Kirin Tor if you could cull this elemental throng.
92457.objectivesText: Defeat $1oa Seeking Remnants, $2oa Saturated Remnants, and $3oa Mana Echoes inside the City of Dalaran for Archmage Modera outside of Dalaran.
92457.title: Starving Arcane

92460.description:
Look at you, bright eyed and ready for adventure! We need all the help we can get here in Thendal Village and your arrival is most welcome. I imagine you are brimming with nerves for what is to come. After all, you only get to come of age once in a lifetime.

Go, seek out our village leader Rorian the Dayseeker at the entrance to the greatfather tree just west of here. He will get you started on your journey.
92460.objectivesText: Speak with Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove.
92460.title: Coming of Age

92462.description:
One of our rangers recently reported an infestation of cirrusflies here in Thendal Grove. 

Cirrusflies can be dangerous if the swarm is allowed to grow too large, so please head to the eastern end of the Grove and exterminate as many as you can.
92462.objectivesText: Slay 8 Pesky Cirrusflies in Thendal Grove.
92462.title: Infestation Investigation

92463.description:
If the forest is as thick with these insects as it sounds, simply killing the workers won't be enough.

Go deeper into the forest and find the queen. She'll be close to the hive and surrounded by bigger and more aggressive soldiers, so be careful.

Put her down and return here when it's done. That'll be one less problem to think about around here.
92463.objectivesText: Destroy the Cirrusfly Queen in Thendal Grove.
92463.title: The Cirrusfly Queen

92465.description:
The Al'Aketh cult is a blight upon this island. These cultists are surely the ones responsible for agitating the simple wind sprites that reside here and turning them violent.

Regrettably, we'll need to disperse these roiling winds here before they harm someone. We also need to send a clear message to the cult that they are not welcome in the grove.

Will you lend me your aid, $c?
92465.objectivesText: Slay $2oa Roiling Winds and $1oa Al'Aketh Converts in Thendal Grove.
92465.title: Agitators

92466.description:
While we owe much of our prosperity to the elements of wind, the path we walk requires that we obey the call of all four of the primary elements and undertake a trial for each. Before you begin your first trial in earnest however, you must prove the strength of your resolve.

Travel to the standing stones to the east. A force of Al'Aketh converts has been spotted there and they must be driven off. Confront the cultists there and bring me one of their signets as proof of your deeds.
92466.objectivesText: Bring a Signet of Akir to Windshaper Boro.
92466.title: Call of Earth

92469.description:
You've done enough here, $c. I'll stay and clean up any stragglers down there.

Head back to the Village and tell Rorian about the cult's presence. He will not be pleased.
92469.objectivesText: Bring word of the Al'Aketh to Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove.
92469.title: Return to Rorian

92470.description:
Rorian informed you that I've been watching you. I now offer you a test of resolve. However, be warned--it will send you into great danger.

Go to the caves to the west. Thin out the ursera's numbers there, and find their matriarch, one the rangers call "Urs'anah". Put her down and bring me proof of her demise. Once you have done that, you will have taken an important step on your path.
92470.objectivesText: Slay 8 Ursera Scavengers and collect the head of the den mother, Urs'anah in Thendal Grove.
92470.title: Foul Matriarch

92473.description:
The ursera den to the southwest is rapidly becoming a problem. Just last week the rangers had to kill an adolescent ursera who wandered too close to the village and attempted to attack a boy playing near the base of the elder tree in the center of the village.

We were fortunate that the boy escaped with his life. Hunger and desperation makes these beasts too dangerous to be left unchecked. Go south and put the scrawniest among the ursera down. Bring me their claws as proof when it is done.
92473.objectivesText: Collect 6 Scrawny Ursera Claws from Scrawny Ursera in Thendal Grove.
92473.title: Aggressive Encroachment

92474.description:
Well hello there, $n! Want to play a game?

All you've got to do is step up on that ledge... then jump! Use your innate ability to walk on the air to slow your fall and see how far forward you can float.

The rules are made up and the points don't matter, but you get bonus points if you can land right in front of Rorian the Dayseeker and startle him! He won't like it but I'll certainly get a good laugh if you can get him all worked up! Hah!
92474.objectivesText: Jump from the top of the watchtower in Thendal Grove and use your Walk on Air ability to slow your fall.
92474.title: Falling With Style

92479.description: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, $n. It appears to be a letter sealed with the mark of Tordrin Stemblade, our local hunter trainer. Take a moment to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
92479.objectivesText: Read the Scribbled Letter and speak to Tordrin Stemblade in Northshire Abbey.
92479.title: A Scribbled Letter

92480.description: The cultist you just killed dropped what appears to be orders from a high priestess of the Cult of Al'Akir. It makes mention of a spy in Shen'dar Village and cult operations in a place called Falaath Village. The authorities at Shen'dar Village will want to learn of this.
92480.objectivesText: Bring the Orders from the High Priestess to Shen'Dar Village and present it to whomever is in charge there.
92480.title: zzOLD UNUSED Cult Ambush

92482.description: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident hunter trainer--Tai'ree Farsight--left this note for you. You can find her just over yonder near the center of the village. Read the note then seek her out.
92482.objectivesText: Read the Scribbled Note and then speak with Tai'ree Farsight in Thendal Grove.
92482.title: The Way of the Hunter

92483.description:
While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident rogue trainer--Akeri Duskblade--has requested to speak with you. He left this note, so read that first, then seek him out inside the watchtower, here in the village.

He's a shady fellow, but then again, so are you. I think you'll get along well.
92483.objectivesText: Read the Simple Note then speak with Akeri Duskblade within the watchtower in Thendal Grove.
92483.title: At Home in the Shadows

92485.description:
While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident druid trainer--Xyton Silverwind--left this note for you. Read it as soon as you can, and then seek out Silverwind on the ground floor of this great tree just behind me.

Heed his words and his counsel, he can teach you much.
92485.objectivesText: Read the Folded Parchment then speak with Xyton Silverwind in Thendal Grove.
92485.title: A Student of Nature

92489.description:
The Kirin Tor have long been allies of the Alliance. With the destruction of their city at the hands of the arch demon Archimonde, the once proud city of mages has now become reclusive and distrusting of outsiders.

In recent years they have begun reconstruction efforts to bring the city of Dalaran back to its former glory. However, reports show they are struggling to contain an outbreak of wayward arcane energies.

We must help them disperse these attacks lest we lose one of our most powerful allies.
92489.objectivesText: Slay the Mana Elemental in the City of Dalaran for High Sorcerer Andromath in Stormwind City.
92489.title: Power Overwhelming

92516.description: A flock of Hippogryph have recently established nesting grounds southeast of Shen'dar Village and they've been wreaking havoc on travelers on the road. I need someone to head down there and thin them out for us.
92516.objectivesText: Slay 8 Hippogryph Youths, 6 Hippogryph Protectors and a Hippogryph Matriarch in the Shen'dar Highlands.
92516.title: Hippogryph Harassment

92517.description:
There's a cave not far to the north, hidden behind a waterfall. It's well known to me that there's a group of bandits that are operating out of that cave. They were a problem for us before the cult arrived, but now they are a real terror. I can't spare the people to go and clear them out, unfortunately.

I need you to go there and take care of them for me. Kill as many as you can, and if possible, take out their leader, the one they call "Badwind" Bennic. That cave is dangerous, so be careful.
92517.objectivesText: Kill 10 Highlands Bandits and their leader, "Badwind" Bennic in the Shen'dar Highlands.
92517.title: The Criminal Element

92519.description:
Apothecary Jorell was supposed to bring us a case of antidotes and elixirs days ago, but we're still empty handed. That fool has probably poisoned himself again by brewing in that poorly-ventilated shack he calls his lab.

If you want to further help our ward, you would be a far more reliable individual for this job.

Follow the road to Go'shek farm, south and a bit west of here. You'll likely find it packed and ready to go, with Jorell either missing or unconcerned with his obligations.
92519.objectivesText: Pick up a case of Packaged Tonics at Jorell's lab in Go'shek Farm and return to Doctor Gregory Victor in Hammerfall.
92519.title: Ward Restocking

92528.description:
The faithful of Al'Akir grow ever stronger with each eager new recruit like yourself. As you can see, our strength gives form to the storm itself!

Normally I'd send you straight to Skypriest Aanders for assessment, but he is occupied at present receiving a guest at the inn on the north side of town. Please avoid that place for now. An unshaven recruit like yourself in the presence of such a guest would be inappropriate.

For now, just don't get in anyone's way.
92528.objectivesText: Look around Falaath Village to learn about the cult's intentions in the Shen'dar Highlands.
92528.title: Among the Faithful

92529.areaDescription: Speak with Missionary Jasaan at the entrance to Falaath Village
92529.description:
It gladdens my heart that you wish to serve Al'Akir. Our current trials as a people stem from our own complacency. We grew prideful and took the bounty of the winds for granted. The stagnation that followed is the reason the spirits of the wind abandoned us.

Only through acts of contrition may we feel the wind's caress once more. If you seek the fellowship of like-minded shen'dorei, go to Falaath Village and find Missionary Jasaan there. I will mark you so that the faithful will know you as a recruit.
92529.objectivesText:
Report to Missionary Jasaan near the entrance to Falaath Village.

If you lose your Mark of Akir, speak with Sania Silverstream in Shen'dar Village to regain the effect.
92529.title: Falaath Village

92532.description:
While you were gone our warrior trainer--Blademaster Ren--requested that we send you their way when you returned. She dropped this note off for you as well.

Give it a read, then find Blademaster Ren inside the village watchtower.
92532.objectivesText: Read the Crumpled Note you've been given, then seek out Blademaster Ren inside the Thendal Village watchtower.
92532.title: The Warrior's Path

92544.description:
A band of Al'Aketh cult ruffians have taken up residence near the temple ruins just southwest of here, led by a real monster called Malduko Cloudcrush. This rabble has no doubt been dispatched here by High Priestess Lorthuna at the Shrine of Akir to attack travelers and coerce our people into joining the cult.

I need to stay here at my post to alert travelers leaving the grove of the danger, but I would be grateful if you could do something about those cultists and their leader for me.
92544.objectivesText: Slay 6 Al'Aketh Brutes, 4 Al'Aketh Neophytes, and Malduko Cloudcrush in Thendal Grove.
92544.title: Al'Aketh Thugs

92550.description:
Our best defense here might just be a strong offense. The advantage we now have is that we expect an attack is coming. What they won't expect is for us to hit them first.

I've already asked a lot of you, but please head back over to Falaath Village. Kill as many cultists as you can and if you can get close enough, kill the commander and bring me his head. I'll stay here and organize the citizens and our few peacekeepers to prepare a defense... just in case you don't return.
92550.objectivesText: Travel to the ruins of Falaath Village and slay 6 Al'Aketh Stormcallers, 4 Living Lightning and take the head of Commander Cyclas.
92550.title: Havoc in the Highlands

92553.description:
Up for a bit of work? I could use a bit of muscle from a strong adventuring-type such as yourself. With how dangerous things are getting around here, no one's had much time to hunt or forage of late, and I need someone to get out there and source me fresh eggs and strider meat to keep this village fed.

I'd be happy to teach you one of my famous recipes if you can bring me what I need. What do you say?
92553.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Small Eggs and $2oa Strider Meat from creatures found throughout the Shen'dar Highlands.
92553.title: Restocking the Larders

92579.description:
For now it seems the pylon and the village are safe, so I'd like you to deliver this report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar, at the southeastern edge of the island. Valennia is the leader of the peacekeepers on the island and she needs to know what happened here.

The cult is expanding rapidly and the peacekeepers have avoided direct conflict until now, but those days are over. Valanaar will need to be ready for a fight.

At any rate, thank you. You'll always have friends in Shen'dar, $n.
92579.objectivesText: Deliver Aonda's Written Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.
92579.title: To Valanaar

conditionalDescriptions.text:
The aura of arcane energy that surrounds you is strong, even for a mage such as yourself. 

Come, let us sit and speak some on the nature of the arcane and the plight of our homeland.

92596.description:
The aura of arcane energy that surrounds you is strong, even though you are not initiated as a mage. I am quite sure that you are going to be a capable adventurer, and your connection with our ancient magic will only ever be a boon to you even if you were to never utter a single word of power in spellcasting.

Come, let us sit and speak some on my order, the nature of the arcane here on Zephras, and the plight of our people.
92596.objectivesText: Have a seat and speak with Rathiril Sunlance.
92596.title: The High Order

92640.description:
Since engaging the cult in the open is not viable, our best chance is going to be to use this opportunity to attack the shrine itself. We can take Lorthuna herself off the board before she can finish her part of this scheme.

It so happens that Valennia has been preparing a strategy for a potential assault on the Shrine for some time now. The only problem is, we will need help. 

Speak with Valennia for the details.
92640.objectivesText: Speak with Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar and follow her instructions.
92640.title: Desperate Times

92646.description:
Lorthuna fled up to the spires above using some sort of portal. Ayessa and Elaadrin went in after her. That was just a few moments ago.

I'm afraid I took one too many hits and this is where I stay. Go through the portal, find Ayessa and help them stop Lorthuna.

Unless that help that Elaadrin and Ayessa said they sent for arrives soon, you are on your own from here. Good luck, $c.
92646.objectivesText: Take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with the High Priestess Lorthuna.
92646.title: Confront Lorthuna

92679.description:
H--Hello, stranger. You have the look of a capable adventurer about you. I...

<The Skyborne man winces, clearly suffering terrible pain>

...I was wondering if you were seeking employment? I came here to Valanaar to recruit fighters to help save my farm. If you are interested, please go find my wife Aamelia Windfield at our orchard to the west of Valanaar, in the lowlands.
92679.objectivesText: Listen to what Alvarion Windfield has to say and find Aamelia Windfield at the Windfield Orchard.
92679.title: Blood Tithe

92682.description:
Oh, so you've got more courage than sense, then? Fine, I won't argue.

Ferauu and his goons aren't due to pick up their take of the harvest just yet, so I'm going to put you to work for your meals until they arrive.

Head outside and gather today's batch of stormapples for me. Oh, and the bandits lurking around the stormapple trees... They think they are sneaky. They aren't. Kill them for me. 

Let's see what you've got in a fight.
92682.objectivesText: Gather 10 Ripe Stormapples and slay 5 Hungry Bandits at the Windfield Orchard.
92682.title: Make Yourself Useful

92684.description:
As if the harvest wasn't light enough this year already, the galestriders in the area have been getting into the orchard and stealing my stormapples. Think you can head out to the fields and cull them for me?

Take care though stranger, these lowlands galestriders are bigger and angrier than the highlands variety. Watch yourself. A well-timed kick is all it takes to put you down for good if you aren't paying attention.

Bring me some of their meat and I can make us a hot meal with it as well.
92684.objectivesText: Gather 7 Lowlands Galestrider Tenderloins from the Ornery Galestriders found throughout the Gustberry Lowlands.
92684.title: Ornery Ornery Galestriders

92685.description:
The bandits have camps all over and there's a small one in the hills just north of here. Head up there and start cracking skulls. If we can catch them off guard and take them out before they come for us, we might just even the odds enough to stand a chance.

Bring me their masks. The bloodier the better.
92685.objectivesText: Loot 7 Blood-Stained Bandit Masks from Highwayman Bandits in the Gustberry Lowlands.
92685.title: The Hills Have Eyes

92693.description:
You've done a lot to give us a fighting chance. Even if we die today, we'll at least know we gave it our best shot.

This is your last chance, stranger. If you want to head back to Valanaar and live another day, I wouldn't blame you.

On the other hand, if you really have a thing for lost causes just let me know when you are ready to go. We'll walk out there with our heads held high and whatever happens, happens.

objectives.text: Follow Aamelia and make your final stand

92693.objectivesText: Speak with Aamelia Windfield when you are ready to confront the bandit leader.
92693.title: Standing Our Ground

92706.description:
Calling all anglers!

A giant shark has been circling the waters near the shipping dock, attacking sailors and small boats. Dockworkers have given it the nickname "Bruuz". A hefty reward will be given to whoever brings me its fin!

-- Gazlowe
92706.objectivesText: Bring Bruuz's Dorsal Fin to Gazlowe in Ratchet.
92706.title: WANTED: Bruuz

92708.description:
The Windshapers have been hard at work trying to respond to the current crisis on Zephras Isle. We have made several surprising discoveries in our search for the missing wind spirits, and we are developing a plan of action that could help us gain the means to save the island.

We'll need strong young adventurers like yourself for this to work however. Please, if you have a moment, let us speak on this further.
92708.objectivesText: Listen to what Ayessa Dawnsinger has to say.
92708.title: A Grand Adventure

92727.description:
Seeking knowledge is the primary mandate of the High Order, but this work has never been more dangerous than it is now on Zephras.

One of our scholars--Fillion Flamebreeze--was en route to the Shen'dar Highlands to gather data on the windborne magic that congregates in some areas there. Regrettably, he has not returned and we fear that something may have befallen him on the road.

If you can, please locate him for us. He was last seen on the road leading west from Valanaar towards Shen'dar Highlands.
92727.objectivesText: Discover what became of Fillion Flamebreeze.
92727.title: The Missing Scholar

92741.description:
The Shadowgale Forest is incredibly dangerous and is usually off limits to normal adventurers. In recent months there's been an explosion in the shriekling population and they've started to expand their territory outside the woods, which is a potential problem. I have an interest in the alchemical properties of shriekling talons, so a much-needed culling also presents an opportunity for scholarly gain.

Travel to Shadowgale Forest and hunt the beasts. Bring me as many of their talons as you can.
92741.objectivesText: Travel to Shadowgale Forest and collect 8 Shriekling Talons for Iaadaria Bitterwind in Valanaar.
92741.title: Unwelcome Visitors

92742.description:
We must determine the source and nature of the poison corrupting this land. Let us begin with the groundwater under the farms in the area.

Go to the Jansen Stead in the north and the Molsen Farm northwest of here, and collect samples from the wells there.
92742.objectivesText: Use the Well Water Sample Kit to collect samples from the wells at the Jansen Stead and the Molsen Farm.
92742.title: Testing the Wells

92743.description:
As the strongest centaur clan in all the land, we deserve armaments with ferocity that matches our strength! 

Warug needs one most of all. A helm... no, a crown! A conqueror's crown! I heard legends of a fearsome conqueror across the seas. Go to a place they call the Badlands and seek out a crypt there. Return to me only when you have found the crown.

Do this for me, and I will reveal the Magram's greatest strength.
92743.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and return a Conqueror's Crown from the Badlands to Warug in Magram Village.
92743.title: A Conqueror's Crown

92744.description:
The corruption affecting Westfall's crops may have seeped into the ocean as well. If the local fish are affected too, it could doom Stormwind to famine.
Collect gills from the murlocs along the shoreline and bring them to me. Murlocs are quite hardy, but their physiology is extremely sensitive to contaminants. Any toxins in the seawater will be readily apparent in the gills you find.
92744.objectivesText: Alba Fairmoon wants you to collect 7 Longshore Murloc Gills along the shoreline of Westfall.
92744.title: Murloc Gills

92747.description:
Strange - the poison does not seem to originate from the mines you investigated.

I am told the Deadmines under the town of Moonbrook are the largest, deepest mines of Westfall, but they have been abandoned since the First War. Could the Deadmines be active again?

Please travel to Moonbrook, $n, and look for evidence of mining or industrial activity. This is the last lead we have!
92747.objectivesText: Collect 8 Suspicious Industrial Supplies from Moonbrook.
92747.title: Moonbrook Espionage

92749.description:
Industrial sabotage? You've got my attention!
We'll start with some dynamite...
92749.objectivesText: Obtain $1oa Rough Dynamite from crafting, trading, or the auction house, then return to Sprite Jumpsprocket in the Dwarven District of Stormwind.
92749.title: A Dynamite Plan

92752.description: That's it--the bomb's ready to go! Careful with that detonator, now.
92752.objectivesText: Return to Alba Fairmoon in Westfall.
92752.title: Explosive Consultation

92753.description:
The source of the poison is likely a large metallurgical forge of some kind. Find a way into the Deadmines and locate the forge, then place the explosives.
I will wait for you in the hills behind Moonbrook. Once you return, we can detonate the explosives. Hopefully, with the forge gone, the land can begin to heal.
92753.objectivesText: Find the forge hidden in the Deadmines, and plant the Extra-Destructive Explosives nearby. Then, meet up with Alba Fairmoon at the Deadmines exit.
92753.title: Destruction in Deadmines

92814.description:
My mate, Halea, is tasked with ensuring our armaments are empowered with appropriate magical energy.

The whole concept of enchanting is far beyond my understanding, but as the centaur whose job is to keep our village well supplied and equipped, I know that Halea is often behind on her duties--to no fault of her own.

I would like to gift her some simple clothes to practice her craft on. I see some adventurers wandering through sandstorms with simple facemasks. Could you get me a few of those?
92814.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring a White Bandit Mask to Molkar in the Gelkis Village in Desolace.
92814.title: I Need a Tailor

92817.description:
Convincing my Gelkis clanmates to put on armor is nigh impossible, despite the numerous losses we have suffered with blades or bolts through the chest.

I have been tasked with designing a vest that offers some reasonable protection, without the supposed 'itchiness' that they complain about. Supplies are scarce, so I dare not waste precious leather on junk.

Outsider, would you bring me a harness fit to a brutish centaur? I would like to learn from your technique.
92817.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring a Barbaric Harness to Talra in the Gelkis Village in Desolace.
92817.title: Leather Technique

92840.description:
Fillion was sent to the Overlook Standing Stones with a special device used to measure and study the elemental energy there.

Take this--an Index Esoteria--and use it to extract data from the massive windstone formations that form there. Be on your guard however, as the Windshapers are likely to be jealously guarding this site now.

Should any attempt to obstruct you, well... do what you need to do. I have no more patience for their interference.
92840.objectivesText: Take the Index Esoteria to the Overlook Standing Stones in Shen'dar Highlands and use it on the Windstone Formations in the area to gather data.
92840.title: Catching Wind

92841.description:
It is time, outsider, for you to learn of our great discovery... but Warug will not be the one to tell it!

Head south to the other end of the village. Look for a big, stinky centaur named Orgrul.

You will know when you get there.
You will know when you see him.
If he thinks you deserve to know, you will know.

And if he doesn't? Well. You can be happy knowing Warug has a new crown.
92841.objectivesText: Improve your reputation with the Magram, and locate Orgrul near the Valley of Bones south of Magram Village.
92841.title: Valley of Bones

92850.description:
I am feeling much better already. I have some skill with the arcane arts and we are but a short distance from Valanaar. I can make it on my own. More important than my safety, however, is how close to Valanaar these shrieklings have nested and the danger they pose. If you would be so kind, please head back inside and take the head of that beast!

After it's done, you'll find me back in Valanaar. I need to report to the Supreme Magister what occurred here and the status of my mission.
92850.objectivesText: Slay the Shriekling Matriarch in the Shriekling Den then return its head to Fillion Flamebreeze in Valanaar.
92850.title: The Missing Scholar

92858.description:
By order of General Feathermoon:

A bounty is being offered to whoever slays the ogre known as Ohk'zi. While not as pressing a threat as the naga, the Gordunni ogres are a similar menace to the lands of Feralas.

Ohk'zi was last seen at the Gordunni outpost east of here. The reward will be given upon proof of his death.

-- Latronicus Moonspear
92858.objectivesText: Bring the Staff of Ohk'zi to Latronicus Moonspear at Feathermoon Stronghold.
92858.title: WANTED: Ohk'zi

92860.description:
The High Order have done our best to avoid direct conflict with the cult, but that is clearly no longer an option. Their hostility has been clearly demonstrated, and now there are rumors of larger-scale cult movements around the island. They are clearly gearing up for something and whatever it is can't be good for the people of Zephras.

Report to Valennia Stormfist and inform her that the High Order offers our full support in Valanaar's efforts against the Al'Aketh, should the need arise.
92860.objectivesText: Report to Valennia Stormfist and let her know that the High Order is with them in their fight against the Al'Aketh.
92860.title: In Service of Zephras

92867.description:
Our heritage may be crumbling, but this is not our final redoubt. We have more in reserve, and it must remain hidden for its own protection.

Support grows for preserving our remaining sculptures and sacred burial grounds. The rabble that have taken up residence in our old kingdom have no notion of the vengeance coming for them.

Drive back the Boulderfist and Syndicate. They must learn Stromgarde is not merely fist, eagle, and stones.
92867.objectivesText: Defeat the Boulderfist, Syndicate, and Witherbark intruders in Stromgarde Keep and return to Groundskeeper Lomar.
92867.title: Ground to Keep

92871.description:
Valennia Stormfist and her peacekeepers have ever been the protectors of Zephras, and we've done our best to lend aid where we can. There are rumors of larger-scale cult movements around the island, and they are clearly gearing up for something.

Report to Valennia and reiterate to her that the Windshapers offer their full support in Valanaar's efforts against the Al'Aketh, should the need arise.
92871.objectivesText: Report to Valennia Stormfist and let her know that the Windshapers are with them in their fight against the Al'Aketh.
92871.title: In Service of Zephras

92872.description:
We eternally guard this tomb and the knowledge of ceremonial rites used to honor these fallen souls.

Now that you've descended three levels below the earth, you take your first steps toward returning to the sunlit world with sacred wisdom.

Each season, we carry some of the dust from this tomb and spread it to the oceans of Azeroth. A symbolic act of renewing cycles.

Take this small satchel. Travel to the cliffs behind Stromgarde Keep and cast it into the sea.

objectives.text: Pouch of Tomb Dust thrown into the sea behind Stromgarde

92872.objectivesText: Throw the Pouch of Tomb Dust into The Great Sea and return to Caretaker Alaric in the Stromgarde Keep crypt.
92872.title: Dutiful Steps

92880.description:
I suspect it will take a bit of time for us to mop up what's left of the attackers, but our chances are far better now. Head back to Valanaar and let them know that we are stable here now.

I can't thank you enough for your help. We'd be in much worse shape without you. I asked for reinforcements and it seems that I got a burgeoning hero instead. I'll take that.

May the four winds bless you, $c.
92880.objectivesText: Bring Yorna's Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.
92880.title: Return to Valanaar

92881.description:
The attacks on both the western and eastern watchtowers are not a coincidence. Based on what you told us about what occurred at the western watchtower with that skypriest, our best guess is that the cult is trying to do something to the anchor pylons.

Please speak with High Elder Shadowsong. He will tell you about a lead that could prove to be promising.
92881.objectivesText: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
92881.title: The High Elder's Request

92910.description: The part you managed to salvage from the harvester appears mostly intact. Someone interested in harvest golems may want to see it.
92910.objectivesText: Bring the Precessive Autocognition Assembly to Ozwin Ironsprocket at Saldean's Farm.
92910.title: Harvesting the Harvesters

92911.description:
I see... this gives me some insight into what makes those monsters tick. I have an idea how we could override their systems, at least momentarily.

I'll continue tinkering with the assembly you brought me. In the meantime, could you scrounge up some parts for the device?
92911.objectivesText: Ozwin Ironsprocket at Saldean's Farm wants you to bring him 8 Golem Isosprings, 4 Copper Modulators, and a Crude Scope.
92911.title: Harvesting the Harvesters

92914.description:
<You approach the strange crystal, guarded mere moments ago by emaciated mana elementals.

Its pedestal, though ancient, is noticeably less dilapidated than the elven ruins it is built upon.

A weak hum of power radiates from the fractured gemstone, but with its magic so heavily depleted its purpose will ultimately remain a mystery for the time being.

Perhaps there is more to discover nearby.>
92914.objectivesText: Explore Shen'dralas in an effort to find other pylons like the one you found.
92914.title: Strange Pylons

93036.description:
You may or may not be aware of this, but Sania Silverstream over there is a "missionary" for the Al'Aketh. They like to play at being a normal religious order and send non-threatening emissaries around to recruit. We've tolerated Sania so far to avoid direct conflict with the cult, but it's obvious the illusion of peace won't last much longer.

You are new here and unknown to most, so I'd like to see if you can use Sania to get close to the cult and find out what their plans are for the village.
93036.objectivesText: Speak with Sania Silverstream in Shen'dar Village.
93036.title: Infiltrating the Cult

93045.description:
I have placed the skull you provided alongside several bones I found while awaiting your return. Immediately I saw a sickly light spread from the skull and claim those old bones as its own. I see now why the call of necromancy is so hard to resist.

Do you remember this crystal? It is draenethyst. I know little of its potential, but I believe it can channel Theradras' power. With it, perhaps you can dispel the curse.

The ritual site can be found by the pond just east of the village.
93045.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and dispel the necromantic curse present on the Accursed Skull. Once successful, report back to Nerlokh near the Valley of Bones.
93045.title: Test Your Theory

93065.description: The Peacekeepers are mobilizing and we are all gearing up to head out. Make whatever preparations you need to make and meet us at the eastern road leading north out of town. We'll have one final check-in with everyone before we move out.
93065.objectivesText: Speak with Valennia Stormfist in the Gustberry Lowlands.
93065.title: Prepare for Battle

93089.description:
Please extend my thanks to Elaadrin for all that the High Order and your new friends from this "Kirin Tor" have done for Zephras Isle. I'm aware of the High Order's plans to leave the island, and your order has my blessing and well-wishes in this expedition.

I can only hope that whatever arcane solution the High Order finds can truly provide us with the stability we've lacked these past years. If you plan to go with them... well, this mission will be all the stronger for it.

Winds be with you, $n.
93089.objectivesText: Speak with Elaadrin Evengale when you are prepared to leave Zephras Isle.
93089.title: What Comes Next

93090.description:
Please extend my thanks to Ayessa for all that the Windshapers and your new friends from this "Earthen Ring" have done for Zephras Isle. I'm aware of the plan to take the Windshapers' shamans and leave the island, and your order has my blessing and well-wishes in this expedition.

I can only hope that whatever solution the Windshapers find can truly provide us with the stability we've lacked these past years.

Winds be with you, $n.
93090.objectivesText: Speak with Ayessa Dawnsinger when you are prepared to leave Zephras Isle.
93090.title: What Comes Next

93125.areaDescription: Escort Rokren out of the Outcast Hideaway
93125.description:
You! I saw you outside fighting the outcasts. I know not where you come from, but I need your help.

I was lured here by my Gelkis brethren with an assurance of safety. I knew the war in the Desolace was escalating beyond our control, but I never imagined my own people turning to necromancy in a convoluted bid to defect to the Magram clan. When I spoke out against this, they threatened to kill me if I ever stepped hoof outside this tent!

Please help.
93125.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and escort Rokren out of the Outcast Hideaway. Then inform Nerlokh near the Valley of Bones about what happened.
93125.title: Going Home

93159.description:
Uh, um... h-hello, I mean to say, hi! Greetings, even! I'm sorry... it's um, been so long since I've actually spoken to another person. I'm afraid I'm a bit rusty at this.

<The strange hooded figure shifts uncomfortably before you.>

So er, um... how is your day going?

objectives.text: Learn more about the Strange Hermit

93159.objectivesText: Speak with the Strange Hermit in the Shadowgale Forest and learn more about him.
93159.title: The Strange Hermit

93172.description:
Most of the elves on this island seem to think that these woods are haunted, and they aren't wrong.

At the old ruins to the northeast, a strange type of ghost-like spirits gather. Some nights, you can almost hear them "singing". It's not like any song I've heard before, but it's definitely a song and it's... just so sad.

I'm not sure why, but I think something terrible happened there at some point, and the spirits are trapped there somehow. If you are feeling brave, maybe you can help set them free?
93172.objectivesText: Destroy 10 Wind Hollows in Shadowgale Forest.
93172.title: Free the Hollows

93173.description: <As the roiling currents that hold the Wind Hollow together begin to dissipate, a small metal device tumbles to the ground at your feet. It appears to be some sort of mechanical gadget. The Strange Hermit mentioned he was still missing some equipment. He might be interested in this.>
93173.objectivesText: Return the Rusty Gadget to The Strange Hermit in Shadowgale Forest.
93173.title: (UNUSED) The Rusty Gadget

93225.description:
I have noticed that centaur from different clans sometimes gather away from settlements and engage in trade. I have observed this across numerous nights and seemingly with every clan; most importantly I have seen the currency they use: carved totems.

I believe we can turn the tides in our favor with either the Gelkis or the Magram if we deliver a heavy bundle of totems right to them. I have already begun carving some, but I doubt they will be easily fooled without a few authentic ones.
93225.objectivesText: Acquire $1oa Carved Centaur Totems by slaying centaur of any clan throughout Desolace, then return them to Gurda Wildmane at Ghost Walker Post.
93225.title: Carved Centaur Totems

93226.description:
Siding with the Magram would be my choice. There is no question that they are the dominant clan in the present day, regardless of their previous struggles. I have heard reports that they are brutally hostile against the Gelkis.

I sympathize with both warring clans and especially the Gelkis, but this is their war; not ours. We ought to side with the faction that poses the least risk to our cause. I believe that to be the Magram.

Bring this to their quartermaster in Magram Village to the southeast.
93226.objectivesText: Bring the Totem Tote to the Magram Quartermaster at Magram Village in the Desolace to significantly increase your reputation with that clan. You must be of at least Neutral standing with the Magram Clan Centaur.
93226.title: Buying Friendship: Magram

93227.description:
At first glance, I would wager that the Gelkis are struggling. Their numbers are far fewer than the Magram, and I rarely hear of them stomping around from our scouts.

Nonetheless, they are one of the dominant clans in the Desolace and survive to this day. They must be doing something right.

If you want to make peace with the Gelkis, take this tote of totems with you to Gelkis Village far to the southwest. Primitive as they may be, they are likely to have a treasurer of some kind.
93227.objectivesText: Bring the Totem Tote to the Gelkis Quartermaster at Gelkis Village in the Desolace to significantly increase your reputation with that clan. You must be of at least Neutral standing with the Gelkis Clan Centaur.
93227.title: Buying Friendship: Gelkis

93318.description:
By order of Constable Aonda of the Peacekeepers, a bounty is hereby placed upon the scourge of the highlands, Vulgara the Insatiable. Last spotted on a hilltop rise just southwest of Shen'dar Village, the winged vuldren terror is highly dangerous and should be approached with caution.

Deliver the beast's head to Danarii Bellowveil to receive your reward.
93318.objectivesText: Kill Vulgara the Insatiable in the Shen'dar Highlands and bring her head to Danarii Bellowveil.
93318.title: WANTED: Vulgara the Insatiable

93319.description:
We are relying on windstones more and more for day-to-day living here on Zephras so we try and maintain a cache of them in reserve for emergencies. Lately I've noticed some go missing from our stores.

We've found windstones on bandits we've captured recently, and I suspect they are behind our shortages.

If you find yourself near the bandit cave to the north, mind knocking a few heads together and reclaiming some of our pilfered windstones for me?
93319.objectivesText: Collect 10 Pilfered Windstones from the Highlands Bandits in the Shen'dar Highlands.
93319.title: Pilfered Windstones

93320.description:
I've just received word that the cult is attacking the pylon watchtower just outside of town! I've sent the few extra peacekeepers we have here to try and break through the enemy back line to relieve the defenders, but any additional help could mean the difference between our people there living or dying.

Please leave immediately for the east watchtower and provide whatever aid you can.

My lieutenant Yorana Windyreed led the relief force. If she still lives she can tell you how best to help.
93320.objectivesText: Report to Yorana Windyreed at the eastern watchtower in the Gustberry Lowlands.
93320.title: Tower Defense

93362.description:
Please spare the details of how the life may have been twisted there. My heart is broken enough with the loss of my necklace.

But while I weep, the plants suffer.

$n, I would like you to go back to the garden and cull some of the angered flora. Please be swift and merciful; they can feel pain, and they have been hurt enough. If you intend to go hunting for my necklace as well, I would ask you to prioritize that before visiting the gardens again... in the unlikely chance you find it.
93362.objectivesText: Cull plants in the Forlorn Garden and then return to Mithera at Shen'dralas.
93362.title: What They've Done to My Peonies

93394.description:
I suspect your curiosity is luring you toward the grand structure now, yes? Good!

The Shen'dralar there are unlikely to welcome you with open arms, but so long as you tread respectfully, I do not think you will run into any trouble.

With any luck, my old friend Kirandis might be easy to find. Of everyone, he is the most likely to be amicable to your presence.
93394.objectivesText: Locate Magister Kirandis inside the temple of Shen'dralas.
93394.title: Meeting the Magister

93429.description:
Although they are our kin, the Lost Ones of Fallow Sanctuary have become beings of pure violence and hatred.

There can be no redemption or salvation for them. They are doomed to wander this swamp as mindless, hateful creatures for all their lives.

Their suffering must end. Someone must put them out of their misery. A grisly task, I know, but would you do it to protect those of us who remain?
93429.objectivesText: Slay 10 Lost Ones in the Fallow Sanctuary.
93429.title: Blood of My Blood

93430.description:
Now they've really done it! As if those wretches weren't already enough to deal with, one of them has stolen my lucky lure!

I was just out fishing this morning, when one came up out of the muck, cut my line, and ran off with it. The thief is almost certainly one of the Lost Ones' own fishermen, hoping to use the lure themselves.

Well, our supply of fish depends on that lure, so I need it back. The Lost Ones fish along the banks east of here. Find that thief, $r!
93430.objectivesText: Find the Lost One Fisherman who stole Pelluk's lure, and take it back.
93430.title: Taking the Bait Back

93443.description:
<A handwritten label appears on the side of the crate. On the right side is a map with a large red circle along a southeastern shoreline north of a poorly drawn temple surrounded by water and some kind of winged creatures. On the left is a note in massive font.>

PROPERTY OF FRIZ FRAZZLESPARK

POWDERFUSE PORT

WARNING: NOT for tampering. Do NOT open without supervision.

<An additional note appears at the bottom of the label.>

If lost, return to Friz Frazzlespark. Powderfuse Port. Riverglades.
93443.objectivesText: Deliver the Lost Shipping Crate to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.
93443.title: Lost Shipping Crate

93450.description:
Being corporeal has its challenges, as you know, but being INcorporeal is a whole other situation. Will I fall through THIS chair? Will I trip over THAT cat? Worst of all, however, it makes everyday work impossible!

Do you see this sword on my anvil? I began work on this thousands of years ago, but met my demise before it was finished. Now it taunts me, AND takes up precious real estate! I cannot work with it! I cannot MOVE it!

I need you to help, uh, "ferry" it to the spirit realm. What do you say?
93450.objectivesText: Take Vindael's unfinished sword and figure out a way to usher it into the spirit realm, then return the Phantasmal Blade to him at Shen'dralas.
93450.title: Phantasmal Problems

93461.description:
You've got that "High Order" look to you. Those with Highborne ancestry always seem to have a slight twinkle in their eyes that gives it away. Before I properly put you to work around here, you should check in with our resident High Order elder Rathiril Sunlance. You can find him here in the main lodge, just around the corner from me.

Oh, and check in with Coriella Calmbreeze as well, she runs the local inn and can provide lodging and supplies, should you need them.
93461.objectivesText: Speak with Rathiril Sunlance and Coriella Calmbreeze in Shen'dar Village.
93461.title: Welcome to Shen'dar Village

93464.description:
Allow me to admit something, $n. While draenethyst is sacred to us, and keeps us sane, none here fully understand it.

I recall a mage who once came to the Harborage, from Desolace. A human by the name of Azore. He feared the power of the draenethyst; said it shouldn't fall into the wrong hands. 

At the time, we drove him away to protect what was ours. Lately, however, I find myself wondering what exactly he knew.

I ask that you find this mage, $r. His knowledge could be of immense value to us.
93464.objectivesText: Find the mage in Desolace who knows about the power of draenethyst.
93464.title: The Visiting Mage

93546.description:
Finally, FINALLY I can use this anvil for something other than a monumentally heavy table. I am delighted to finally hone my craft again after centuries of missed practice.

Now, you are probably thinking, "Vindael, this sounds like you are setting the stage for another request." And you would be correct!

I need to replenish my supply of iron, but your iron has a similar predicament to my blade. Fortunately, the solution is MUCH simpler.

<He hands you a ghostly pickaxe, without a chance to refuse.>
93546.objectivesText: Search for Spectral Iron Deposits around Shen'dralas and collect $1oa Spectral Iron Ore. Return to Vindael in Shen'dralas once you have found enough.
93546.title: Spectral Iron Ore

93552.description:
Windstones are a critical resource on Zephras Isle as they contain the raw, concentrated energy of the winds themselves. The wind elementals who used to live here on Zephras with us vanished a number of years ago, and since then, the magic that sustains this island is slowly fading. Not without limitations, the windstones are still a reliable energy source, and are incredibly valuable to us.

You'll find raw windstones scattered around the grove. Think you can help me harvest them?
93552.objectivesText: Collect 15 Windstone Clusters from Raw Windstones in Thendal Grove.
93552.title: Harvesting Windstones

93574.description:
<With a terrible crunch, you removed a piece of the worm's carapace upon its demise.

Despite its enormous size and hefty weight, it is disappointingly ordinary. This creature was seemingly not the result of a cruel experiment nor carefully bred to be an all-devouring beast.

It is simply an impressive shell, likely desired only by collectors. Perhaps you could find one, though other than the centaur, who else might be alive around here?>
93574.objectivesText: Find someone interested in Corpsefeeder's Carapace.
93574.title: Corpsefeeder's Carapace

93585.areaDescription: Escort Father Tuttle to The Harborage
93585.description:
Oh thank goodness, someone civilized!

I came here on behalf of the Church of the Holy Light to make contact with the draenei of the Harborage. The Alliance has no foothold here, you see, and a bit of diplomacy with the locals may help us in that regard. The Light welcomes all into its fold, after all!

However, the road past this bridge is crawling with the draenei's more savage kin. If I am to make it to the Harborage safely, I will need protection. Would you aid me, $c?
93585.objectivesText: Escort Father Tuttle to The Harborage.
93585.title: This Light of Mine

93594.description:
Among the treants borne of the necklace, one in particular stood above all the others to have received the gift of life and sentience. I suspect if they have fallen, he may be the only one that remains.

He spent his days tending to each and every bloom and bud, and his evenings rooted in the ground to serve as a nest for the smaller critters.

If he is alive, and I pray that to be true, then he may know what happened.

I am holding out hope for my good friend, Woodwyrd.
93594.objectivesText: Find Woodwyrd in the Forlorn Gardens at Shen'dralas in the Desolace.
93594.title: Word of the Woods

93644.description:
<Found near Shen'dralas, this dirty old tome no longer holds most of its knowledge.

Of the text that remains, individual letters are difficult to distinguish from words. It may prove challenging to read at first, but one of them appears to be a surname.

Perhaps its author, "Evenshade", may be found nearby.>
93644.objectivesText: The text suggests the author of this journal may be somewhere in Shen'dralas.
93644.title: Tattered Journal

93663.description:
The draenei of the Harborage are skilled fishermen, and willing to trawl more dangerous waters than I. We occasionally trade. They give us some of their catch, and I offer some of our extra supplies.

I'd sent a goblin courier to deliver my latest shipment, but he never returned. A crocolisk likely made a meal of him.

More importantly, my business reputation is at stake. That shipment must be found, and delivered to the harborage. Please, find it if you can. Check near the waters along the road.
93663.objectivesText: Find the missing courier, and ensure Dar's shipment is delivered to the Harborage.
93663.title: Lost in Transit

93678.description:
I've prepared a transcription of Gimashi's notes on draenethyst. It appears the shards possess some degree of energy, but a pure sphere of the stuff is vastly more powerful. That seems to be what the Burning Blade was after.

Many of Gimashi's notes allude to portals and demonic summoning rituals. Portals to where, or to summon which demons, I cannot say for sure.
