While my answers are not definitive, please take these notes back to the swamp with you. I hope you'll understand if I don't come along.
93678.objectivesText: Take Azore's transcribed notes back to Magtoor at the Harborage in Swamp of Sorrows.
93678.title: Abridged Notes on Draenethyst

93680.description:
The Alliance had an army of mages known as the Kirin Tor. While they were powerful, the demonic Burning Legion proved to be even more so. In one fell swoop, the arch demon Archimonde flattened their city like it was a child's plaything. Those who remained were reduced to merely dispossessed vagabonds.

That is, until they rebuilt Dalaran. And on the Dark Lady's very doorstep, no less!

While in their camps, search for something that can get us into the city unnoticed. I must know more.
93680.objectivesText: Acquire the Dalaran Sewer Key for Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill.
93680.title: Key to the City

93689.description:
This is excellent news! With Dalaran returned to peace, I can see no reason the Kirin Tor would not welcome you with open arms!

Please, report to the council with great haste. I'm sure they will be looking forward to meeting the city's savior.
93689.objectivesText: Speak with Archmage Celindra in the City of Dalaran.
93689.title: Friend of the Kirin Tor

93735.description:
Historically, the Windshapers have seen to the tending of the magical instruments and devices that were gifted to us by the spirits of the wind. This includes the myriad of magical constructs around the island. Since the spirits left us, only a scant few of these are still functional.

One of the few remaining working constructs in Valanaar has become damaged. One of our artisans was dispatched to help, but he may be in need of aid. Travel to the west end of the city and offer any assistance you can.
93735.objectivesText: Find Riaani Nightwind on the west side of Valanaar.
93735.title: The Broken Construct

93736.description:
The paramount concern of the Windshapers is to better understand why the spirits left us, and what we may be able to do to bring them back. One curious fixture of Shadowgale Forest to the north is the presence of a curious form of wind sprite that some call "hollows". We know little of them and why they are there, but we do know that they first started to appear after the spirits of the wind left us.

I need you to go there and disperse them. Gather the remains and bring them back here.
93736.objectivesText: Gather 10 Wind Hollow Essences from Wind Hollows in the Shadowgale Forest.
93736.title: Unwelcome Spirits

93737.description:
Oh, hello. Ayessa sent you to assist me? Very well then. 

Not sure what an obvious novice like yourself can do, but if you give me a moment to pull my head out of this construct's innards I might have a few ideas of things you can do to help.

objectives.text: Listen to what Riaani Nightwind has to say
Obtain Crystallized lightning from the Shriekling Cave
Obtain Enchanted Gyrozephyr from Windsong Lake
Obtain Air Construct Core from the Bandit Camp

93737.objectivesText: Speak with Riaani Nightwind and listen to what he has to say.
93737.title: The Broken Construct

93738.description:
Brightwish, eh? So the High Order wanted to remove these components for some reason. But why though?

The High Order has always been meddlesome, constantly wanting to experiment with the wind spirits' magic. They are too bold by a mile, and we've strictly forbidden them from meddling with knowledge under Windshaper purview, but lately they've been testing our patience.

I think you should report what you've learned back to Ayessa Dawnsinger. She can instruct you further on what to do.
93738.objectivesText: Report back to Ayessa Dawnsinger in Valanaar.
93738.title: The Broken Construct

93739.description:
Azeroth is a large world, and the territory of the Horde is vast. The Undercity, Orgrimmar, and Thunder Bluff all have very unique people and culture.

If you are to be a guest of the Horde here on Azeroth, it would do you good to visit each of our capital cities in turn. Speak with my advisor Nazgrel for directions.
93739.objectivesText: Speak with Nazgrel in Grommash Hold to receive further instructions. Use the instructions received to locate and speak with Vol'jin, Cairne Bloodhoof, and Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.
93739.title: Exploring the Horde

93786.description:
Does your blade thirst for human blood, $n?

Some years ago, the human defectors laid claim to a small farm to the southwest across the river. With the area rich in lumber and stone, it was only a matter of time before they expanded their reach to the keep along the eastern shore known as Farholde.

Our first skirmishes would have ended in our favor if we'd had the numbers. It's time to remind them of our presence.

Disrupt their farming efforts. Take no prisoners. Send them a clear message.
93786.objectivesText: Slay $1oa Meadowsbrook Farmhands, then return to Krom'rosh with news of your success.
93786.title: A Message in Blood

93787.description:
Humans within these lands have long enjoyed the warmth, comfort and sustenance these lands provide. It's time we start denying these humans such pleasantries.

Seek out the supplies of our enemies at the farm to the southwest. Take whatever you find.

It won't bring pleasure like bloodying a blade, but slowing them buys us time to plan our next move.
93787.objectivesText: Steal $1oa Feed Satchels from the Alliance farm in Meadowsbrook then return to Krom'rosh.
93787.title: Food for the Taking

93788.description:
With the human presence to the south and Twilight to the west, the battle for resources has become difficult. But why gather resources amongst our enemies when their blades will suffice?

Follow the river south to the mill. When you hear the whistling of woodworkers among the trees, tread lightly. When the opportunity presents itself, strike hard and fast.

I'll stay behind to keep the forge running hot. Gur'dok will break down the blades while I fashion weaponry forged of their own materials.
93788.objectivesText: Retrieve $1oa Woodworker's Axe from the lumberjacks at Turner's Logging Camp for Kreza Darkthorn in Rog'mar.
93788.title: Borrowed Blades

93791.description:
$n, it is clear your skill with magic is growing and I believe it is time for you to partake in one of the High Order's oldest traditions for young and aspiring mages. It is time for you to craft a spell focus of your own.

Seek out Belann Windwood in Valanaar. He has been crafting staves and wands for the High Order for over a century, so you will be in good hands.
93791.objectivesText: Speak with Belann Windwood in Valanaar.
93791.title: Speak with Belann

93797.description:
It is a time-honored tradition for young mages to create their own spell focus when they have shown a certain degree of magical proficiency. This is typically done by gathering a fallen branch from our oldest trees, as they have some lingering traces of elemental wind.

I have found the most ideal ones to be near the wind shrine, just south of Falaath Village. Go and bring me back a large branch and I will teach you about the traditions as we create your spell focus.
93797.objectivesText: Bring a Wind-Infused Bough to Belann Windwood in Valanaar.
93797.title: Boughs in the Wind

93835.description:
Lorthuna fled up to the spires above using some sort of portal. Ayessa and Elaadrin went in after her. That was just a few moments ago.

I'm afraid I took one too many hits and this is where I stay. Go through the portal, find Elaadrin and help them stop Lorthuna.

Unless that help that Elaadrin and Ayessa said they sent for arrives soon, you are on your own from here. Good luck, $c.
93835.objectivesText: Take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with High Priestess Lorthuna.
93835.title: Confront Lorthuna

93836.description:
Muln has told me much of the elemental lords and I am afraid that we have good reason to fear Al'Akir. Now that the wards that have hidden Zephras from his view are down, we are utterly defenseless. If he chooses to attack us, we stand no chance against him here in his own domain.

High Elder Shadowsong needs to know of the danger we are in, and more importantly, what our intentions are for our mission to Azeroth. We will find the means to save our home. I swear it.
93836.objectivesText: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
93836.title: The Fate of Zephras

93926.description:
Whatever reason the cult has for attacking the tower, it's not worth losing our people over.

I'd like for you to head to the southwest and check in on that watchtower for us. Find the peacekeepers there and tell them to head back to the village. Holding that tower is not worth the lives it would cost and I'd rather concentrate the defenders we do have here to protect our citizens.

Peacekeeper Vaaniel is in charge; let him know to head back here as quickly as possible. Hurry!

objectives.text: Check in on the Western Watchtower in the Shen'dar Highlands

93926.objectivesText: Find Peacekeeper Vaaniel at the western watchtower.
93926.title: The Western Watch

93951.description:
The hippogryphs that have taken up residence southwest of the village can be a nuisance, but they also present a rather unique opportunity to obtain their feathers. Many skyborne love to adorn their hair with vibrant plumes and the down feathers of a hippogryph are exceptionally vibrant and, more importantly, silky soft.

If you are heading that way, try and gather as many of the fallen feathers as you can from around their nesting grounds. Do be careful, as wild hippogryph are not tolerant of guests.
93951.objectivesText: Collect 8 Hippogryph Down feathers in the Shen'dar Highlands.
93951.title: A Little Beauty

93963.description:
Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus all have unique peoples and cultures. As a guest of the Alliance here on Azeroth, you should take some time to visit each of our capital cities in turn. 

Speak with Randal Emerson in the southern antechamber for directions to get you started.
93963.objectivesText: Speak with Randal Emerson in Stormwind Keep to receive further instructions. Use the instructions received to locate and speak with King Magni Bronzebeard, High Tinker Mekkatorque, and Tyrande Whisperwind.
93963.title: Exploring the Alliance

94003.description:
I am all that remains of the line of Skybreakers here on Zephras Isle. The rest were murdered by the Al'Aketh.

The only thing that outweighs my sorrow is my shame. My family's ancestral shield--the Skybreaker Bulwark--is now in the hands of a cultist named Zaal Stormshield. Family lore holds no harm may befall a worthy wielder of this shield.

Zaal is not worthy, of that I am sure. Find this man at the Shrine of Akir and reclaim my shield from him. Do this and I will teach you the Skybreaker Defense.
94003.objectivesText: Reclaim the Skybreaker Bulwark from Zaal Stormshield at the Shrine of Akir.
94003.title: The Skybreaker Bulwark

94007.description:
Now that you've gained a level of comfort in the wilds of the highlands, I believe it is time for you to seek your very own animal companion.

Go to the port of Valanaar to the southeast, and speak with Quel'ana Quickgale there. He will instruct you in the art of beast taming.
94007.objectivesText: Report to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.
94007.title: Taming the Beast

94013.description:
You've returned triumphant from taming two beasts. It's time now for your last trial. The winds of Zephras whisper of greater challenges ahead. 

Take this Taming Rod and journey to the Gustberry Lowlands. There, tame a Vuldren Alpha and prove your mastery. 

Complete this lesson and you'll be ready to learn the deeper ways of the hunter.
94013.objectivesText: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Vuldren Alpha in the Gustberry Lowlands. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.
94013.title: Taming the Beast

94050.description:
You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it. For this, there is none better than my sister, Quel'dora. She will give you the ability to train your new pet. 

Go with the winds, young $c.
94050.objectivesText: Speak to Quel'dora Quickgale in Valanaar.
94050.title: Training the Beast

94373.description:
Aye, the time's come, young shaman. Ye've grown stout and sturdy, like the stone beneath our boots. Takin' up the shaman's path shows ye've got the wisdom o' the mountain, even before ye've proven yerself. Ye've the grit of stone to walk the earth's path.

But to earn its favor, ye must face it proper. South o' here, the Frostmane trolls live in a cave.

Bring me two of the necklaces they wear, crafted from the Iceclaw bears. Then we'll speak more of yer future.
94373.objectivesText: Bring 2 Frostmane Bear Pendants to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar.
94373.title: Call of Earth

94374.description:
Aye, sapta's a brew forged with magic, bindin' our spirit to the elements. Only a few shaman know the recipe, and it's nae for the weak-willed. Drink it, and ye will see what others can't. Hold true--it's only to be drunk in a sacred place.

Head north to the Spirit Stone, tucked at the end of a hidden path up the mountain. Drink it there... see what the earth has to show ye.
94374.objectivesText: Find the Spirit Stone and drink the Earth Sapta.
94374.title: Call of Earth

94375.description:
Take this rough quartz from me and bring it to Teo Hammerstorm as proof o' our meeting. He will craft a totem for ye, and this pebble will be the heart o' it. As small as it may seem, ye will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest o' things can outlast many others.

Be patient, $n. Remain strong. And seek wisdom. This is what earth asks o' ye. In the end, ye shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect ye.
94375.objectivesText: Bring the Rough Quartz to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar.
94375.title: Call of Earth

94411.description:
Be warned, members of the High Order have been seen in the vicinity of the standing stones north of the village. We have warned them time and again to not meddle at our sacred sites, but they are growing more bold in pushing us. Prove your resolve to us by going to the standing stones and dispersing them.

I am loathe to condone outright bloodshed, but do what you must to drive them off. Return to me when it's done.
94411.objectivesText: Slay 6 High Order Apprentices in Shen'dar Highlands.
94411.title: Meddlesome Mages

94413.description:
The recent emergence of the leylines on the surface of Zephras has been profound for our order. We have more direct and tangible access to the energies that permeate this place and it has increased our understanding of said magic greatly.

The Windshapers, however, view these emergences as scars on the land that must be "healed". This is an affront to our order and is something we simply cannot abide.

Go to the leyline in the forest to the southwest and drive off the Windshapers you find there.
94413.objectivesText: Slay 6 Windshaper Novice Seers in Shen'dar Highlands.
94413.title: A Magical Affront

94435.description: I don't know why you'd go out of your way to help me, but I appreciate it. If someone sent you my way, tell them I appreciate them too. You'll always have a friend in Tanis Alderwood, $c.
94435.objectivesText: Return to Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep.
94435.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94436.areaDescription: Speak with Deathguard Billmuth at Tyr's Watch.
94436.completionText: Speak with Deathguard Billmuth at Bandarion Keep.
94436.description:
It's time to demonstrate your ability to channel one of the light's greatest gifts.

The item I just gave you is called the Symbol of Life. Take care, as it may cause you some discomfort to handle a talisman of the light such as this. The light may be anathema to the force that created us, but it is still our guide and ally. The pain reminds us of this.

Go see Deathguard Billmuth downstairs. He just arrived and he has petitioned us for aid. Show him and the Forsaken what a true paladin can do.
94436.objectivesText:
Speak with Deathguard Billmuth at Bandarion Keep.

Should you misplace your Symbol of Life, return to Danitha Morr for a replacement.
94436.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94438.areaDescription: Take the Symbol of Life and use it to resurrect Deathguard Falgan at Venomweb Vale.
94438.completionText: Take the Symbol of Life and use it to resurrect Deathguard Falgan at Venomweb Vale.
94438.description:
Falgan and I were sent on a mission to scout out scarlet activity in Venomweb Vale. We managed to sneak close enough to one of their camps to hear about new orders involving an attack on Brill. Before we could decide what to do next, I stepped on a twig and the noise alerted them to us.

Falgan yelled at me to run, so I ran. By the time I realized he wasn't with me, I was halfway to Brill. That brave idiot probably stayed behind to hold them off for me.

Please, find my friend and help him if you can.
94438.objectivesText:
Take the Symbol of Life and use it to resurrect Deathguard Falgan at Venomweb Vale. 

Should you misplace your Symbol of Life, return to Danitha Morr for a replacement.
94438.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94440.description:
These Scarlet Crusaders often carry satchels with their deployment orders. We know an attack is coming, but if we can recover their orders, we can warn the rest of the Deathguard and prepare an ambush. 

You are clearly an impressive paladin. Kill these scarlet animals and retrieve a copy of their orders and bring them back to Deathguard Billmuth. He'll take it from there.
94440.objectivesText: Retrieve the Scarlet Crusade Attack Plans from the Scarlet Crusaders at Venomweb Vale, and return to Deathguard Billmuth at Bandarion Keep.
94440.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94449.description:
It's been long since ye were last tested, $n. Ye've shown patience, aye -- but now it's time ye learned of chaos... of destruction. Fire's call is loud, and if ye're ready to pay its price, it'll speak to ye. 

Seek out Bruegs Kindleborn, far east in the mountains. He dwells in a cave above South Gate Outpost. He'll know if ye're truly ready.
94449.objectivesText: Find Bruegs Kindleborn in Dun Morogh.
94449.title: Call of Fire

94465.description:
Aye, ye've the strength to bear the totem o' fire, lad--but strength alone won't make ye ready.

Beyond the Valley o' Kings, in the crags of Loch Modan, lies a hidden path to one o' our sacred peaks. There, Braldir Ashmantle guards the Shrine o' the Dormant Flame. 

Take this torch to him--it shows yer intent. Return it burnin' by the shrine's brazier, and I'll see ye earn the totem proper.
94465.objectivesText: Bring the Torch of the Dormant Flame to Braldir Ashmantle in Loch Modan.
94465.title: Call of Fire

94466.description:
Bah, ye didn't trek all this way for tales, did ye, $n? Ye seek the Eternal Flame and the fire totem.

First, ye'll need a sapta to bind yer spirit to the flame.

I'll craft it--but I'll need two things: fire tar from Tunnel Rat Geomancers in the kobold caves up north, and a reagent pouch from a Stonesplinter Seer lurkin' in the southern hills. Dangerous work, but worthy of the flame.
94466.objectivesText: Bring 1 Fire Tar and 1 Reagent Pouch to Braldir Ashmantle in Loch Modan.
94466.title: Call of Fire

94468.description: Torch firmly in hand, you turn away from the brazier and look out over Loch Modan. You feel an excitement tugging at your spirit as the wind picks up and forces the flame to dance violently.$B$BYou start off down the path back to Dun Morogh in search of Bruegs Kindleborn.
94468.objectivesText: Bring the Torch of Eternal Flame to Bruegs Kindleborn in Dun Morogh.
94468.title: Call of Fire

94480.description:
The humans of these lands are only one of many threats. With the encroaching Twilight and snarls of gnolls echoing from the hills nearby, battle may call at a moment's notice. Maintaining the strength of our allies may be the difference between Rog'mar's success or our removal from these lands.

Deliver the goods you've gathered to Gorg. He'll make sure our allies are well fed.
94480.objectivesText: Deliver the Stolen Feed to Gorg in Rog'mar.
94480.title: A Gift From Our Enemies

94481.description:
This hearty stew keeps our trainees fed, enough so that our enemies remain at a distance.

Bring this and feed our trainees to the west. Don't listen to any complaints. With how difficult defending our supply lines has become, they should be so lucky we're not feeding them dirt.
94481.objectivesText: Feed $1oa Rog'mar Trainees at the training grounds.
94481.title: A Serving of Strength

94483.description:
Our scouts have reported training camps by the river to the south. If I'd received word sooner, it would have saved us both the hassle of locating and removing the human filth in a timely manner.

Continue your efforts, $n. Holding back the humans to their precious little keep will buy us time to focus on other matters at hand.

Be swift about it.
94483.objectivesText: Slay $1oa Farholde Priests and $2oa Farholde Scouts south of the river.
94483.title: Show Them How It's Done

94484.description:
A moment if you will, $n. Are you headed towards Shadowgale Forest? There is a druid conclave there in a cave to the northeast. I have been waiting on word from them but their correspondence is long overdue.

With Ban'aethall in ruins and all the unrest lately I worry something dire may have happened. Please, if you are able, go seek out Elegael Thornpaw and put my mind at ease.
94484.objectivesText: Find and speak with Elegael Thornpaw in the northeastern part of Shadowgale Forest.
94484.title: Unnerving Silence

94486.description:
The other ingredient I need for the poultice is feathers from the Shadowgale shrieklings that roam this forest. In their juvenile form, the shrieklings have insulative feathers which would be ideal to put over the moss. These feathers will prevent the antiseptic sap from drying out and will provide at least some protection against the elements.

Be warned, the shrieklings are normally docile but they have been incredibly hostile of late. Their large talons can easily disembowel you if you aren't careful.
94486.objectivesText: Collect $1oa feathers from the Shadowgale Shrieklings in Shadowgale Forest.
94486.title: Feathers for Binding

94488.description:
The reason for cultists' presence here still baffles me, but I smell a familiar scent over the bloodshed.

One of our circle druids, Haalien, disappeared months back. It appears he's thrown his sorry hide in with the cultists.

Show him what happens when he spills the blood of his kin! Take his head and return it to me.
94488.objectivesText: Kill Commander Haalien and bring his head to Elegael Thornpaw in the Shadowgale Forest.
94488.title: The Ties That Bind

94490.description: <Tucked behind one of Haalien's bracers is a note that's been slightly torn and bloodstained in your fight. It looks like it contains useful information about the cultist motivations for the attack on the druid den. Elegael would be interested in this intel.>
94490.objectivesText: Bring the Ripped Missive to Elegael Thornpaw in the Shadowgale Forest.
94490.title: Ripped Missive

94493.description:
Thank goodness our message got to Lotheluum. Wait, where are the rest of the reinforcements? Surely it is not just you they sent?

<Elegael pales as you explain yourself.>

So the message did not get to Valanaar. We are in dire straits indeed then.

<Elegael sighs deeply then looks resolute.>

Then we must handle this on our own. Time is of the essence.
94493.objectivesText: Speak with Elegael Thornpaw in the northeastern part of Shadowgale Forest.
94493.title: A Sacrifice in Vain

94494.description:
Long has it been since ye were last tested, $n. Ye have shown patience thus far in yer studies, but the time has come for ye to learn about the purity of water.

Seek out Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan. He is along the north western edge o' the lake, south of Stonewrought Dam. Ye will find him there at his burrow hut. Good luck to ye, $n.
94494.objectivesText: Find Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan.
94494.title: Call of Water

94497.description:
Ah, so ye've come seekin' the sapta, have ye? Well then, listen close, love. To find understandin' and earn the sapta, ye must seek water in its various forms. As ye gather the samples, keep yer eyes open. Watch the beasts that guard it, the land it nourishes, and how it changes lives.

We'll start simple: fill this skin at the base o' the falls, where the fresh meets the brackish. Go on now, and mind the marsh.
94497.objectivesText: Fill the Empty Brown Waterskin at the bottom of the waterfalls below Hervdana's cave and return it to her in the Wetlands.
94497.title: Call of Water

94499.description:
Aye, Redridge drinks deep from Lake Everstill, but by the time the waters tumble down Stonewatch Falls, somethin' has seeped in. The murlocs down there are big, twisted brutes. Not like the ones ye find here or in the Loch. Lucky for the townsfolk they keep to the base o' the falls.

Bring a sampling to me. I've a mind to find out if it's magic, venom, or somethin' worse that's taintin' the waters near that old fort.
94499.objectivesText: Fill the Empty Red Waterskin at Stonewatch Falls near the Nightcrawler Murlocs and return to Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands.
94499.title: Call of Water

94500.description:
Take this waterskin and journey deep into the emerald shade o' Ashenvale. Astranaar rests cradled by waters untouched by corruption. Ruins litter the bed o' the lake, hinting at a bygone era. Bring back a sample from the lake. Pure, ancient, and possibly enchanted water.

It's the last liquid I need before I send ye back to Norric.

Board the boat in Menethil to Auberdine. It stops in Southshore on the way over.

And mind yerself... the forest's got eyes, and they don't blink.
94500.objectivesText: Fill the Unfilled Blue Waterskin at the waters of Astranaar in Ashenvale and return to Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands.
94500.title: Call of Water

94501.description: Norric will have one more task for ye before rewarding ye with the water totem rites. The vial of water I've given ye is necessary for whatever that task is. Go now and find him. We shall meet again some day.
94501.objectivesText: Bring the Vial of Purest Water to Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan.
94501.title: Call of Water

94502.description:
In Westfall, outside o' Moonbrook lies Stendel's Pond. Once a pure spring, now touched by dark forces. The spirits there 'ave gone silent. 

Ye must drink the water sapta, then face the corruption that fouls the waters. Take its bracers and the last drops o' Hervdana's potion, then place 'em on the shrine. That'll call forth a spirit, cleansed and true. Speak with it, learn what ye can.

Bring me proof the deed's done, and I'll grant ye the totem.
94502.objectivesText:
Drink the Water Sapta and Cleanse the corruption at Stendel's Pond in Westfall.
Return to Norric in Loch Modan when finished.
94502.title: Call of Water

94503.description: Light erupts as the final word leaves your lips. The hiss of water turning to mist fades into silence, and your senses reel as the corrupt spirits around you unravel, their essence scattered like ash in the wind.
94503.objectivesText: Speak to the Minor Manifestation of Water in Westfall.
94503.title: Call of Water

94532.description:
Though the gnoll presence has dwindled with the Twilight's encroachment, the threat remains.

The hills to the southwest are infested with their kind, disrupting trades and travelers alike.

Clear a path for our allies by removing the threat.
94532.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Redridge Mystics, $2oa Redridge Trappers, and $3oa Redridge Brutes for Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.
94532.title: Gnoll Infestation

94533.description:
Among the cackling inhabitants of the Bristle Hills southwest of here is an elder gnoll by the name of Snargl. The sounds emanating from this particular gnoll are quite unpleasant. Their presence inspires those around, creating a problem for allies and scouts who enter the area.

A trophy as a memento of our having dealt with this most unpleasant gnoll fiend would fit nicely with my collection.

Be swift about it, $n.
94533.objectivesText: Locate Snargl in the Bristle Hills, kill him, and retrieve his snout for Neza Bloodsnout.
94533.title: Snargl's Snout

94535.description:
Our allies mining ore from the hills to the south reported several attacks by gnolls in the area.

Travel south, locate their camps and retrieve the stolen ore. Take it from their dead bodies if need be.
94535.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Stolen Ore from gnolls in the Bristle Hills for Kreza Darkthorn.
94535.title: Bristle Hills Bandits

94559.description:
There is a turncoat amongst the Al'Aketh. They claim to know the cult's true intentions for the island and want to come in, but will only do so with assurances of protection.

This defector is hiding at a house just northwest of Valanaar, just inside the highlands. I need someone who can discreetly go there, find the traitor, find out and escort him back to us. This might be a trap, but if this information is as important as this traitor claims, it's worth some risk.
94559.objectivesText: Seek out the Al'Aketh Turncoat in the Shen'dar Highlands.
94559.title: UNUSED

94568.description:
The turncoat clearly was afraid of what the cult had planned, enough so to defect and seek our aid. It's truly unfortunate that he is dead and took his secrets to the grave with him.

We must discuss this further to determine our next steps.

objectives.text: Learn what you can from the crystal

94568.objectivesText: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong and observe the conversation.
94568.title: The Cult's True Plans

94614.description:
You seen those murlocs down by the river, just west of here? Nasty things. Bad for my animals, and bad for the wildlife. Not to mention, they've settled right on top of my favorite fishing spot!

There ain't a soul in the Riverglades who wouldn't appreciate you getting rid of a few, that's for sure. 

Please, kill any you see. You'd be doin' us a whole heap of good.
94614.objectivesText: Kill 8 Mudfin Oracles and 8 Mudfin Warriors along the river near Wheeler's Grange.
94614.title: Freshwater Fiends

94617.description:
There's a pack of coyotes livin' in a den west of here. We can see 'em sometimes from across the river. They used to hunt fish on the shore, but I guess the murlocs pushed 'em out of their usual feeding ground, and so they've taken to eating horses.

The leader of the coyote pack's a bigger one with dark fur. We'd nicknamed him "Sootfur". I reckon if you kill him, the rest'll scatter.
94617.objectivesText: Kill the coyote known as Sootfur, and bring its pelt back to Benjy Wheeler.
94617.title: Coyote Huntin'

94672.description:
Humans are not our only adversary within the Riverglades, $n, nor are they our most dire.

A cult known as the Twilight's Hammer has begun a campaign against those they deem heretics in the eyes of their twisted gods. The ravaged remains of a human settlement to the west are but the first to fall to their conquest. No doubt Rog'mar will be next.

We cannot afford to let them establish a foothold so close to our doorstep. Go to this so-called Sunnyglade and thin their numbers.
94672.objectivesText: Defeat $1oa Twilight Raiders and $2oa Twilight Neophytes within Sunnyglade for Tran'gul in Rog'mar.
94672.title: Encroaching Twilight

94678.description:
The gnolls have been a thorn in our side ever since we arrived. While less a threat than the Twilight's Hammer, they are aggressive, persistent and, worst of all, numerous.

The hills beyond this post are infested with them, making passage to the north dangerous, and posing a threat to those living outside the walls of Farholde Keep.

If we are ever to make these lands safe, removing the gnoll threat is imperative.
94678.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Redridge Mystics, $2oa Redridge Trappers, and $3oa Redridge Brutes for Cedric Dalton at Southern Watch.
94678.title: Gnoll Infestation

94679.description:
Gnolls value strength above all else. By killing their strongest, we not only lessen the threat they pose physically, but also strike fear into their hearts.

In a den among the Bristle Hills is a notorious gnoll by the name of Snargl. His death would no doubt sow panic among the Redridge's ranks.

Bring me his snout, and be quick about it.
94679.objectivesText: Locate Snargl in the Bristle Hills, kill him, and bring his snout to Cedric Dalton at Southern Watch.
94679.title: Snargl's Snout

94680.description:
There have always been small pockets of Twilight's Hammer cultists here and there, but never have I seen them in such numbers. They seem emboldened by someone, or something, to expand their influence.

I would know more of these cultists and what they seek. Their shadowmancers are blessed by the dark powers and are likely the most trusted within their order to lead attacks of this scale.

Bring me anything you find off their corpses that we may glean knowledge into their campaign.
94680.objectivesText: Retrieve $1oa Twilight Missives from Twilight Shadowmancers in Sunnyglade for Tran'gul in Rog'mar.
94680.title: Twilight Missives

94727.description:
The Twilight's Hammer are here for more than simple chaos, $n. They appear to be digging throughout the Riverglades for something. As for what they are searching for, I cannot say. A source of power, of course, but what that is still eludes me.

Their zealots may not be willing to divulge their secrets, but they must have someone doing the digging for them. These are the ones you are to question. Return to Sunnyglade and 'convince' one of their miners to talk. We must get to the bottom of this.
94727.objectivesText: Convince a Twilight's Hammer miner in Sunnyglade to divulge their secrets.
94727.title: Digging for Answers

94775.description: Elune bless you, good $r. I hope your Light finds you and protects you well this day.$B$BOne of your priests was here not long ago looking for you. He mentioned you returning to the Cathedral of Light as soon as possible to speak with High Priestess Laurena. It seems you've done well to garner such attention. I wouldn't spend too much time here--your people have need of you.
94775.objectivesText: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
94775.title: Divine Grace

94777.description: Just a short time ago, one of your priests was here looking for you, $r. He said that if I were to see you, I should direct you towards the Cathedral of Light. He said it was very important, but I would not be overly concerned if I were you. His demeanor seemed positive... as though it were good news. I wouldn't take too long in making my way there if I were you.$B$BElune be with you, good $r.
94777.objectivesText: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
94777.title: Divine Grace

94778.description: You're needed in Stormwind, $n. The High Priestess there, Laurena, says it's time for you to prove you're worthy of the next level of your training. Don't waste too much time finding your way there. You can find her in the Cathedral of Light in the center of the city. Give her my regards, and prove how worthy you are of such a calling. The Light be with you, $n.
94778.objectivesText: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
94778.title: Divine Grace

94779.description: Praise be to Elune, and to your Light, $n.$B$BAbout this time, many of our order learn abilities reflecting their faith in Elune. If knowledge serves me, I believe the same holds true for your order also.$B$BWhen your business in Darnassus is complete, I would seek out one of your High Priestesses for further training.
94779.objectivesText: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
94779.title: Divine Grace

94789.description:
The winds o' Azeroth greet ye, and soon ye'll stand among some o' our mightiest kin. I'm proud to see how far ye've come--your future looks bright indeed.

The element o' air's a tricky one to master, but I've faith your skill will see ye through any challenge.

Make your way north into Arathi Highlands. In its northern hills, you'll find Veyric Thundervein. He'll teach ye more.
94789.objectivesText: Find Veyric Thundervein in Arathi Highlands.
94789.title: Call of Air

94792.description:
Many hunters prefer to travel with animal companions. With a beast at your side, you will find that you can survive even the most dangerous of circumstances. As they say, everything is easier with a friend. However, obtaining an animal companion is something that must be done with care. The balance of nature is delicate, and must always be respected.

Take this Taming Rod with you to the forest. With it, you will be able to tame a Rockhide Boar and practice your skills as a hunter.
94792.objectivesText: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Rockhide Boar. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Josephine Carson.
94792.title: Taming the Beast

94819.description: $n, your High Priestess Mims would have an audience with you in Ironforge. Make haste, my clever friend, your next test quickly approaches. Although I wish I could bear witness to your race's own special rites, my place is here. But may the Light go with you in your travels. Mims should still be in the Mystic Ward once you reach the city. She will be waiting.
94819.objectivesText: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.
94819.title: Contingency Plan

94821.description: A priest recently visited our halls seeking you out, young $r. He said that he was on a mission to find you and that you should return to the Hall of Mysteries in Ironforge as soon as possible. When you arrive, seek out High Priestess Mims--she will tell you more.$B$BThe Light be with you, $n.
94821.objectivesText: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.
94821.title: Confounding Flash

94822.description: You've caught the attention of our superiors, $n. They've asked you to travel to the Hall of Mysteries in Ironforge as soon as possible. Apparently they feel you've proven yourself already and are prepared to further your training. When you get there, find High Priestess Mims. She will be able to guide you further. Good luck, and may the Light be with you.
94822.objectivesText: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.
94822.title: Confounding Flash

94825.description: Just a short time ago, one of your priests was here looking for you, $r. He said that if I were to see you, I should direct you towards the Hall of Mysteries. He said it was very important, but I would not be overly concerned if I were you. His demeanor seemed positive... as though it were good news. I wouldn't take too long in making my way there if I were you.$B$BElune be with you, good $r.
94825.objectivesText: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.
94825.title: Confounding Flash

94826.description: Praise be to Elune, and to your Light, $n.$B$BAbout this time, many of our order learn abilities reflecting their faith in Elune. If knowledge serves me, I believe the same holds true for your order also.$B$BWhen your business in Darnassus is complete, I would seek out your High Priestess for further training.
94826.objectivesText: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.
94826.title: Confounding Flash

94829.description:
If you've come to demand more of our crop, you're too late. No doubt you saw my farm. Destroyed. All of it.

Good folk toiled in these fields for years to feed troops and civilians alike. But when those cultists arrived, where was the military? Where was our promised protection after all the rations they'd taken from us?

If you've any sense of decency, I beg you. The least we can do is recover their belongings from those cursed raiders. Let my people rest with their kin in the graveyard to the west.
94829.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Farmers' Mementos from Twilight Raiders and place them on the graves west of Elbrim's Farm.
94829.title: What We Lost

94841.description:
<A handwritten label appears on the side of the crate. On the right side is a map with a large red circle along a southeastern shoreline north of a poorly drawn temple surrounded by water and some kind of winged creatures. On the left is a note in massive font.>

PROPERTY OF FRIZ FRAZZLESPARK

POWDERFUSE PORT

WARNING: NOT for tampering. Do NOT open without supervision.

<An additional note appears at the bottom of the label.>

If lost, return to Friz Frazzlespark. Powderfuse Port. Riverglades.
94841.objectivesText: Deliver the Lost Shipping Crate to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.
94841.title: Lost Shipping Crate

94842.description:
We make our own fertilizer out here. It's a special formula of mine that reeks like hell, but grows trees like they're weeds.

It's a 1:1:2 ratio of crawfish shells, manure, and murloc heads. Tasty, right?

The manure's easy enough. We've got the ranch to the south for that. The heads and shells? Those you're going to have to go wading in the river for.

If you feel like lending a hand, we could sure use your help getting some fertilizer ingredients.
94842.objectivesText: Gather 4 Jumbo Crawfish Shells, 4 pieces of Fresh Manure, and 8 Mudfin Murloc Heads for Halligan Turner.
94842.title: Unsavory Plant Food

94843.description:
Considering you got yourself wrist-deep in guts and manure for us, it's only right you get to do the fun part too.

The boys and I gather seeds from the trees as we work. With the fertilizer you've provided, I've made a planting kit to put them in the ground to grow new saplings.

Take it, and find some good planting spots around the work sites.
94843.objectivesText: Plant $1oa saplings around the lumber camp with Halligan Turner's tree sprouting kit.
94843.title: From Seed to Sprout

94858.description:
There was one more thing I wanted to talk to you about, friend.

When the Twilight's Hammer attacked, I put everyone who couldn't defend themselves in the barn to hide. I thought they would be safe. I thought...

<Elbrim's voice cracks as he recounts what happened.>

If you could do me one last kindness, will you go see what's left of my family? They should be buried here at home with me. I just don't have the heart to check myself.
94858.objectivesText: Find Farmer Elbrim's family's possessions in the nearby barn and return them to him.
94858.title: All That's Left

94861.areaDescription: Go with Hurley to save Curly.
94861.description:
Well, I guess that explains why Curly didn't come back for lunch break. Looks like I have to bail him out again -- typical. The way he makes me worry, I swear, I'll be gray in a year.

Come on, we'll have to save him ourselves, and it sounds like we don't have much time.
94861.objectivesText: Go with Hurley to save Curly.
94861.title: Helping Hands

94864.description:
You've proven yourself by taming a boar and a wolf. Now it's time for your final challenge. Elwynn's balance depends on respect and skill. Take this Taming Rod and seek out a Young Forest Bear. Show that you can earn the trust of even the mightiest companion. 

Completing this lesson will deepen your attunement to beasts.
94864.objectivesText: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Young Forest Bear. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Josephine Carson.
94864.title: Taming the Beast

94872.description:
The fierce Magram are undoubtedly winning the war of territories at the moment. While we can all be thankful the clashes haven't erupted too frequently throughout the desert, every day their village just to the east grows a little bigger; their soldiers a little bolder.

I worry gravely about the consequences of an unchecked Magram clan, but I cannot deny their potential as an ally.

If you wish to earn their trust, offer this sack of totems to their quartermaster, but be careful.
94872.objectivesText: Bring the Totem Tote to the Magram Quartermaster at Magram Village in the Desolace to significantly increase your reputation with that clan. You must be of at least Neutral standing with the Magram Clan Centaur.
94872.title: Buying Friendship: Magram

94873.description:
Either dominant centaur clan is likely to pose a good ally, but I ought to offer a word of caution regarding the Gelkis.

I have trustworthy intel that suggests, between the Magram and the Gelkis, the latter are very much on the losing side. This may work to our advantage--desperation may push the isolated clan into opening up to outside help.

I have prepared a tote of totems for you to take to their quartermaster, assuming they have one, in Gelkis Village. This may work in our favor.
94873.objectivesText: Bring the Totem Tote to the Gelkis Quartermaster at Gelkis Village in the Desolace to significantly increase your reputation with that clan.  You must be of at least Neutral standing with the Gelkis Clan Centaur.
94873.title: Buying Friendship: Gelkis

94877.description:
When you look around you, what do you see? A broken home and a tired people.

Stormwind has left us to fend for ourselves, and we have less to do that with every day. Many within these walls are refugees who barely escaped tragedy without so much as even their own families.

Farholde is no Stormwind, stranger. We lost a settlement in the northwest to the Twilight's Hammer, but we will not let them keep it. If you wish to fight, go to Sunnyglade and purge those savages from our lands.
94877.objectivesText: Defeat $1oa Twilight Raiders, $2oa Twilight Shadowmancers, and $3oa Twilight Neophytes within Sunnyglade for Demar Brant.
94877.title: Saving Sunnyglade

94881.description:
My, what have we here? A brave new $c come to save us from our woes? How charming! Maybe you can help me with something then? I'd quite like to learn more about this cult in Sunnyglade.

Like any cult, they operate in a caste system. Those with an affinity for magic are often in high favor and are given tokens to demonstrate such. These charms are then imbued, and thus have a rich abundance of cultist magic.

I wish to see these tokens for myself. Be a dear and see if you can bring me a few, hmm?
94881.objectivesText: Retrieve $1oa Twilight Charms from Twilight Shadowmancers and Twilight Neophytes in Sunnyglade for Ashe Amberhall in Farholde Keep.
94881.title: Curious Trinkets

94884.description:
I've had enough of this cave. Once you clear your way out, I'll slip out amidst the chaos.

I'm afraid I'm in too weak of condition to carry those samples, however. Their energy is overwhelming, and I've been trapped down here for Light knows how long. Once we get out of here, please take them to Lady Amberhall immediately. I must rest.
94884.objectivesText: Bring the Filled Crystal Catalyst to Ashe Amberhall in Farholde Keep.
94884.title: An Unsettling Discovery

94887.description:
Field Marshal Ryan is one of our best. His keen eyes and reliable intel have been paramount to our war efforts.

His final reports refer to a Twilight's Hammer fortress to the west. Find him before it's too late. And take his logbook with you. It may offer more clues as to the whereabouts of our missing marshal.
94887.objectivesText: Find Marshal Ryan within the Twilight's Shroud.
94887.title: Saving Marshal Ryan

94889.description:
It seems every day the Twilight's Hammer are drawing more into their order, while we haven't heard so much as a word from Stormwind. Sooner or later we'll be overrun.

I don't care what a bureaucrat like Amberhall says. I'm not abandoning this position while an army amasses in our own homeland. If we leave now, we'll only have to deal with these cultists again later. Only next time, on our doorstep.

If your orders are to babysit me anyway, at least make yourself useful and help me cull these zealots.
94889.objectivesText: Defeat $1oa Twilight Fanatics, $2oa Twilight Corrupters, and $3oa Twilight Champions within the Twilight's Shroud for Sergeant Riftan.
94889.title: Carving a Path

94890.description:
With this kind of momentum, we can't stop now. The soldiers we rescued are itching to draw blood, and you've already proven yourself a capable battering ram.

Return to the Twilight's Shroud and finish what we've started. Their leader, an orc by the name of Overlord Kilgar, hides deep within his keep while his underlings are lost in their panic.

If we want to put an end to this, bring me the head of Kilgar. These gods-fearing cowards can't make a single decision on their own.
94890.objectivesText: Defeat Overlord Kilgar within the Twilight's Shroud and bring his head to Sergeant Riftan.
94890.title: Bring Me His Head

94893.completionText: Deliver Marshal Ryan's Crest to Terry Lawrence in the Cathedral Square of Stormwind City.
94893.description:
So, his final thoughts were of Abigail?

I know this is not your business, friend, but I must ask you to deliver the news of the Marshal's passing on my behalf. Ryan's betrothed, Abigail Lawson, did not join us when we established Farholde Keep. The two of them apparently had a disagreement, and while I do not know the specifics, I do know that she now resides within Stormwind City.

Please take the Marshal's crest to Terry for me. I don't think my presence would be a welcome one.
94893.objectivesText: Deliver Marshal Ryan's Crest to Abigail Lawson in the Cathedral Square of Stormwind City.
94893.title: Delivering Closure

94894.completionText: Deliver Kilgar's Head to Bolvar Fordragon within Stormwind Keep in Stormwind City.
94894.description:
Lady Amberhall told me of your exploits with the Twilight's Hammer. I'm impressed. But concerned.

Farholde started its campaign originally to remove the Horde from our homeland. While that remains our primary goal, we cannot take this sudden surge in cultist activity lightly. If our pleas to Stormwind remain unheard, we will be overwhelmed as we face foes on two fronts alone.

With the evidence you carry, perhaps they can set aside their pride long enough to listen. At this point it's our only option.
94894.objectivesText: Deliver Kilgar's Head to Bolvar Fordragon within Stormwind Keep in Stormwind City.
94894.title: The Twilight Threat

94897.description:
If you are traveling to Ban'aethal, I have a selfish request. My love, Resaan... I believe is no longer a part of this world. He had tried to go back to get supplies even though I begged him to stay. It has been over a week already and I fear the worst.

Please, if you find him, bring him home. If he has perished then I beg you to please bring me his heirloom.
94897.objectivesText: Find Resaan in the Ruins of Ban'aethal.
94897.title: The Fate of a Loved One

94907.description:
You've been such a good little $c for me, I wonder if I could ask you to do one more small favor.

With the reagents you collected being so finely attuned to Twilight's Hammer magic, they are perfect for a summoning ritual. However, we'll need to take them to the source of their power.

Should you happen upon a conduit while you're gallivanting about the Twilight's Shroud, see if you can't call upon one of the cult's thralls and capture it with this soulstone for me. For questioning, of course.
94907.objectivesText: Summon a Twilight's Thrall from a conduit within the Twilight Shroud and capture it with Amberhall's Soulstone.
94907.title: A Small Favor

94911.description:
Greetings, young $r. I can see that you have much promise in the druidic arts. There is one who you may want to speak with in the city of Thunder Bluff by the name of Turak Runetotem. He will teach you how to reach the stronghold of the Cenarion Circle on Kalimdor, Moonglade. 

You will be welcomed there, and the druids of the circle will impart their knowledge upon you. 

As your people would say--go with the wind's blessing, young one. I wish you good fortune in your adventures.
94911.objectivesText: Speak with Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
94911.title: Child of Nature

94912.description:
Greetings, young $c. 

Have you heard of the Cenarion Circle? I'd expect not. They are an ancient order of naturalists and practitioners of the druidic arts, much like yourself. In the city of Stormwind you'll find a night elf by the name of Sheldras Moontree. He will teach you how to reach the stronghold of the Cenarion Circle on Kalimdor, a place called Moonglade.

Go now. You have much to learn if you wish to save your home.
94912.objectivesText: Speak with Sheldras Moontree in Stormwind.
94912.title: Child of Nature

94913.description: All druids are welcomed to the sacred lands of Moonglade. Keeper Remulos--Moonglade's guardian--keeps watch over all druids who hibernate there. I'll teach you the spell that lets you transport yourself there. Cast it whenever you seek Moonglade's knowledge or solace.$B$BAs for your first lesson here on Azeroth, travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven about the path you're now on. Good luck, young druid.
94913.objectivesText: Use the spell "Teleport: Moonglade" to travel to Moonglade. When you arrive, speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.
94913.title: Moonglade

94923.description:
<Robbie leans in to talk to you, as if sharing a grave secret.>

Psst! Hey $gmister:miss;, I need your help!

My sister got me a hat for my birthday but I lost it playing in the river. I'm not allowed to be down there because of the murlocs so I can't ask Dad or Ellie for help because then they'll know where I was!

It's a good hat. I bet one of those murlocs found it and kept it for himself!
94923.objectivesText: Find Robbie's Hat somewhere along the river near the murlocs.
94923.title: Hats Off

94925.description:
Farholde prides itself on its independence, but there are a few things we can only get through trade.

We've negotiated an arrangement with a dealer at Powderfuse Port. We provide her with goods that are dangerous to acquire, and she provides us with specialty munitions.

Currently, she's in the market for lion fur. A pride of them live atop a large hill in the center of the plains. If you'd like to make yourself useful, you could aid me in harvesting some of their hides.
94925.objectivesText: Bring 8 Prized Lion Hides to Watcher Terral.
94925.title: A Fur Trade

94927.areaDescription: Help Dunston break out of Bolder'ok
94927.description:
When you're ready, I'll unlock my shackles, and we'll commence the escape. We'll take the quickest route, right through the center of camp. Be prepared for a fight.

Once we're out, I'll return to Farholde for medical treatment. As a final favor, I ask that you update Cornelius on my whereabouts. Frankly, the last thing I want after all this is to get an earful from that man.
94927.objectivesText: Help Dunston break out of Bolder'ok then return to Watcher Cornelius.
94927.title: Dunston Checks Out

94928.description:
These hides are to be delivered to Powderfuse Port. It is a goblin-run port to the northeast.

When you get there, deliver the hides to Friz Frazzlespark. Tell her they're from Cornelius. The details of our trade have already been worked out, so she'll know what they are for.
94928.objectivesText: Deliver the Bundle of Lion Hides to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port.
94928.title: A Few Furs for Friz

94930.description:
<A handwritten label appears on the side of the crate. On the right side is a map with a large red circle along a southeastern shoreline north of a poorly drawn temple surrounded by water and some kind of winged creatures. On the left is a note in massive font.>

PROPERTY OF FRIZ FRAZZLESPARK

POWDERFUSE PORT

WARNING: NOT for tampering. Do NOT open without supervision.

<An additional note appears at the bottom of the label.>

If lost, return to Friz Frazzlespark. Powderfuse Port. Riverglades.
94930.objectivesText: Deliver the Lost Shipping Crate to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.
94930.title: Lost Shipping Crate

94931.description:
The boys up at Southern Watch do a good job keeping gnolls out for the most part. Every now and then a few sneak into the camp at night and cause a bit of trouble. They especially like to steal saw blades, which they likely use to make weapons out of the sharp metal.

If you could get some back for us, it'd be a big help. The gnolls have probably got 'em stashed away somewhere in their camps up in the hills to the west.
94931.objectivesText: Recover $1oa Saw Blades from the gnoll camps in Bristle Hills for Halligan Turner at the lumber mill.
94931.title: Stolen Saws

94946.description:
I had intended to be the first of us to step foot onto Azeroth, but recent events with the cult have changed my plans. As a result, I will be remaining here in Valanaar for a time. Fret not though, we have several mages awaiting our people's arrival in Dalaran. I'd encourage you to explore Azeroth while we set our affairs in order here. We will call upon agents such as yourself when you are needed.

When you are ready, please proceed to the dock just outside this lodge and board the skycutter ship there.
94946.objectivesText: Take the skycutter ship from Zephras Isle to Dalaran City and speak with Danaaris Stargale when you arrive.
94946.title: The Magical City of Dalaran

94947.description:
It's a big world down here, and we need our people to start branching out to explore it. That's where you come in.

The Kirin Tor is a member of an "Alliance" of like-minded nations. The de-facto heart of this alliance is the city of Stormwind to the south. Elaadrin has asked me to find someone to travel to Stormwind and meet with the regent lord there, a human named Bolvar Fordragon.

When you are ready, the Kirin Tor mages have set up a special portal for the High Order to use to access Stormwind.

objectives.text: Take the Skyborne Portal to Stormwind

94947.objectivesText: Take the Skyborne Portal to Stormwind and report to Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep.
94947.title: Welcome to Azeroth

94961.description:
<The gnoll pulls a bit of gold from his pocket and waves it at you.>

$R, I offer trade! There is more where this came from. Help me get revenge, and I will show you!
94961.objectivesText: Bring 20 Twilight Finger Bones to Fuzzle.
94961.title: Biting the Hand

94963.description:
Come, $r. It is time to leave this place. If any try to stop us, we will tear them to shreds!

Once we are safe, I will take you to your reward.
94963.title: Biting the Hand

94979.description:
You've proven you can tame the river's crawler. Now it's time to test your skill on open ground. The plains of Zephras echo with the cries of the galestrider, a proud, winged hunter that runs like the wind.

Take this Taming Rod and seek one out. Travel to the lowlands and earn its trust.

Show you're ready for the trials yet to come.
94979.objectivesText:
Use the Taming Rod to tame an Ornery Galestrider in the Gustberry Lowlands. 
Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.
94979.title: Taming the Beast

94982.description:
Our scouts mentioned a network of caves to the northwest along the mountains, hidden by natural surroundings. Most who sought information from deep within have yet to return. I fear they may be lost.

Those watching from a distance mentioned a Twilight presence moving in and out of the caves, often in darkness.

Locate this stronghold. If it is what I think it is we must deliver a deathly blow to their leader. Only then may we continue our efforts to remove them from these lands.
94982.objectivesText: Infiltrate Krol'dok Stronghold and return to Commander Brant with proof of their leader's demise.
94982.title: Eye of Mugg

94984.description:
No matter our efforts, the Twilight forces persist. We've deduced they must be coming from somewhere else.

With the new pet you brought me, I was able to politely ask our dear Twilight Thrall if it knew anything about where its former masters were coming from. Of note was mention of shadow magics and an ogre by the name of Nar'gurk in a hidden stronghold north of Sunnyglade.

Seek him out. Kill him and recover what you can. There must be something we can learn from these efforts.
94984.objectivesText: Kill Nar'gurk within Krol'dok Stronghold and recover any valuable information.
94984.title: Tome of Twilight

94992.areaDescription: Escort the lost horse to Wheeler's Grange.
94992.description: <The horse bows its head in your direction then nudges its nose into your underarm. Wherever you go, it may follow.>
94992.objectivesText: Bring the lost horse back to Wheeler's Grange.
94992.title: Rescue Roundup

95033.description:
If you be gettin' tired of dem wide open plains, my old friend Uzer'i always be lookin' for help. He always be twistin' dem magics, but little do most o' dem people know he be quite da hunter too.

If you's interested, you can find him all da way out at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

Tell him ol' Tan'jani sent ya.
95033.objectivesText: Tan'jani wants you to speak with Witch Doctor Uzer'i at Camp Mojache in Feralas.
95033.title: On the Other Side

95034.description:
I think you should know that it wasn't actually the Gnolls who attacked us on the road.

We were actually attacked by a giant, wolf-like creature that I now know as a "worgen". It dispatched our guards and came for me, but Banon threw himself in its path. I managed to get a spell off which startled the creature, causing it to flee, but Banon was already badly bitten. He insisted I leave him there but I refused.

We were limping back here when the gnolls found us. What came next was terrifying...
95034.objectivesText: Speak with Lumina Windsinger in the Sepulcher.
95034.title: The Debt

95036.description:
Trevan tells me that the worgen are a major threat to the citizens of Silverpine Forest. Despite their strength and resilience they can be killed, but there is one in particular that just doesn't ever seem to stay dead due to unknown magic.

That's the one that attacked us. He is known as Old Fire-Eye and he is the biggest and meanest of their kind. To put him down, we'll need a special kind of weapon.

Speak with Trevan and he will supply you with a list of what is needed to forge such a weapon.
95036.objectivesText: Speak with Trevan Rol in the Sepulcher and bring him the materials he requires.
95036.title: A Moon-Kissed Blade

95041.description:
Before we fled Gnomeregan, I made a hard copy of my family's archives. Arcanotechnical field equations, Second War submarine hull designs, Grandma Quikswitch's chili recipe... our greatest accomplishments are in those files.

It wasn't until we reached Ironforge that I found a hole in my pack! Several punch cards are gone, and without them the data's too scrambled to recover.

The cards must be buried in the snow, somewhere outside Gnomeregan. Could you find them? I know it's a long shot...
95041.objectivesText: Collect 7 Gnomeregan Archival Data cards from around Gnomeregan, then deliver them to Jemma Quikswitch in Ironforge.
95041.title: Data Hoarders

95059.description:
Time for a special delivery.

Knight Commander Demar Brant at Farholde is waiting for this. For some reason he always makes me say his full name. What an odd fella.

Anywho, you can find him holed up in the keep southwest of here. Massive stone fortress. Ya can't miss it.
95059.objectivesText: Deliver Frazzlespark's Crate to Knight Commander Demar Brant in Farholde Keep.
95059.title: Frazzlespark's Crate

95062.description:
Time for a special delivery.

Old Krom'rosh is waiting for this package over at Rog'mar just west of here.

I suggest you get it to him quickly, but carefully. Why, you might ask? It's better to not ask questions.
95062.objectivesText: Deliver Frazzlespark's Crate to Krom'rosh at Rog'mar.
95062.title: Frazzlespark's Crate

95065.description:
What a view... Best an old man can ask for.

The fish sure are bitin' now, though I'm down to my last bait. I don't suppose you have any spare fishing supplies on you? Of course not, forgive me. I get so excited at the thought of casting another line it didn't dawn on me I may be one of the few carrying supplies everywhere I go.

Would you be able to help refresh my stock? Catherine Leland has an assortment of fishing goods just west of the Trade District along the canals. Tell her old Gray sent you.
95065.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Shiny Bauble and $2oa Nightcrawlers to Gilbert Gray at the harbor in Stormwind.
95065.title: Fishin' Time

95066.description:
The message we've delivered is clear.

Return to Brant within the keep and show him the report. I'm certain he'll be pleased with our progress.
95066.objectivesText: Deliver the report to Demar Brant in Farholde Keep.
95066.title: The Rog'mar Situation

95111.description:
In Tarren Mill there is a weaponsmith known as Ott. By all accounts he is an unremarkable smith, selling simple blades to travelers. I purchased a sword from him myself, and when I took it to the undercity for maintenance some time later, the smiths there were surprised at its quality. They assumed it came from a well-known master smith, but no, it was just Ott.

I'd like to give this orc a chance to do something truly special. Take the materials to Ott in Tarren Mill and offer him the commission.
95111.objectivesText: Speak with Ott and ask him to forge your blade.
95111.title: An Underrated Talent

95118.description:
Murlocs, murlocs, murlocs! That's all I ever hear about; from the sailors, the fishermen, even my own kids! Everyone's on my case about 'em! They're a nuisance, I admit, but I got a port to run here!

Help a guy out, would ya? Kill a couple 'a those things and I'll make it worth your time.
95118.objectivesText: Kill 8 Murloc Oracles and 8 Murloc Warriors along the Eastwind Shore.
95118.title: Saltwater Savages

95119.description:
You know the Eastsea crew? Real unsavory bunch, and that's coming from the guy running a place called "Powderfuse Port".

They're destructive, bloodthirsty, and, worst of all, cutting into my bottom line. They steal cargo, and sink ships, both of which end up costing me the big bucks!

We gotta take down their whole operation, starting with the ones closest to here. You can find 'em along the beaches to the north.
95119.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Eastsea Buccaneers and $2oa Eastsea Musketeers along the Eastwind Shore, north of Powderfuse Port.
95119.title: Unfriendly Competition

95120.description:
Sailors and swimmers beware! An especially aggressive murloc, nicknamed "Old Rot-Chum" by local fishermen, has been seen attacking rowboats and other small vessels in the waters to the south, near a collection of murloc-infested islands.

A reward is being offered by Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz in exchange for proof of the creature's demise.
95120.objectivesText: Bring proof of Old Rot-Chum's demise to Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz.
95120.title: WANTED: Old Rot-Chum

95121.description:
Welcome to Fimbo's cafe on the water! Today's menu is roasted boar, and roasted fish...same as every day...

This menu needs a shake up, badly. I've had my eye on a new seafood stew recipe, but I'm gonna need some fresh meat. A few murloc eyes and some crab meat oughta do.

You can find both along the beaches nearby. Can't beat some good ol' fashioned local ingredients!
95121.objectivesText: Gather 12 Murloc Eyes and 6 pieces of Sand Crawler Meat for Fimbo Greasemitz.
95121.title: A Taste of the Sea

95122.description:
Those Eastsea pirates you whacked, while dangerous, were just the small fries. They've got bigger, badder brothers in arms north of here. They ransacked Windstead--took all the plunder they could, then burned it to the ground.

They've gotta be stopped before their turf gets any farther inland. Thin out their ranks so that doesn't happen.
95122.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Eastsea Raiders and $2oa Eastsea Bombardiers for Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz.
95122.title: Unchecked Expansion

95123.description:
As much as I love seeing Eastsea heads roll, we also gotta take out their ships. Can't have 'em running off for reinforcements, now can we?

I've got a plan for that, but we're gonna need some gunpowder. A LOT of it.

The pirates are probably storing some near the freshly-demolished Winstead to the north. See if you can get your hands on it. I'll fill you in on the rest later.
95123.objectivesText: Steal $1oa Eastsea Powder Kegs for Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz.
95123.title: A Blast Ye Scurvy Dogs!

95124.description:
Now it's time to go after the big man himself: Admiral Lamora. Obviously, I want him dead, but I need a little something extra from him too.

Seeing how all his plundering has been costing me a fortune, I figure it's only right that I recoup some losses.

Lamora's on one of the Eastsea's boats northeast of here. Find out which and where on it he's keeping his loot. Bring me whatever he's got. If it's locked up, he's likely got the key on him.
95124.objectivesText: Slay Admiral Lamora, locate his stash of loot, and return it to Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz.
95124.title: Admiral Lamora

95125.description:
These are some truly fine materials, $c. You honor me by allowing me to forge this blade for you and I only hope that I can live up to your expectations.

Please, stand back so that I may begin the forging process.
95125.objectivesText: Watch as Ott forges your blade.
95125.title: Ott's Masterwork

95140.description:
I see that you have your weapon now, $c. I pray that it will not fail you.

The locals tell me that Old Fire-Eye hunts in a large area south of here and you can generally find him near the gates to Gilneas. Find him, and use your new blade to end him. When it is done, return and you will have the gratitude of the Windshapers.
95140.objectivesText: Use the Moonsilver Blade to destroy Old Fire-Eye in Silverpine Forest.
95140.title: Old Fire-Eye

95141.description:
Far to the northeast beyond Stonard lies an embattled land along the eastern coast known as the Riverglades.

Many have sought to lay claim to these lands, but few have succeeded. There is one, however, whose experience battling our enemies proved enough to settle a small outpost known as Rog'mar. Through countless attacks, it still remains.

As ruthless as Krom'rosh may be, his will has served our allies greatly. If it's battle you seek, head northeast to seek out this old friend of ours.
95141.objectivesText: Report to Krom'rosh at the Rog'mar outpost in the Riverglades.
95141.title: Report to Rog'mar

95143.description:
I've been watching you, $n. You handle yourself well out here. Perhaps you'd be interested in helping me locate my brother, Tan'jani.

He was always searching for something--for what I do not know. I received two messages since he left. The first from another traveler, letting me know he'd run into Tan'jani somewhere south of Loch Modan. The second was a bloodstained letter mentioning Riverglades and somewhere called Rog'mar, even further south. The rest was illegible.

Think you can locate him for me?
95143.objectivesText: Find Tan'jani at Rog'mar in the Riverglades.
95143.title: Finding Tan'jani

95147.description:
You... where did you come from? You shouldn't be here!

<Bolain struggles through the pain--bruised, battered, and a disease-ridden bite wound to his leg.>

Take this to Dalton. Head north up the road and east where the plains open wider than this gash in my damn leg. I'd tell you to tell him he was right, but I won't give him that satisfaction... at least not until after I'm dead.

I hate these damn hills!
95147.objectivesText: Deliver Bolain's message to Captain Dalton at Southern Watch.
95147.title: The Lost Scout

95148.description:
As much as I'd like to deliver the blood-soaked message to the knight commander himself, I'd also like to keep my post. I've cleaned it up a bit so it's less... well, bloody.

Given the recent gnoll uprisings, I'm afraid the task of delivering the news falls upon you.
95148.objectivesText: Deliver the Southern Watch Gnoll Report to the knight commander at Farholde Keep.
95148.title: Southern Watch Gnoll Report

95156.description:
Our training dummies are starting to show significant wear and tear. If we don't fix them up soon I worry our recruits may be unprepared for battle.

If you hadn't seen it on your way in, there's a small farmstead just outside the keep run by a man by the name of Wheeler. He may have a few extra bushels of hay he'd be willing to part with.

I'll see to it he's compensated if he's able to spare supplies for our efforts.
95156.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Bundles of Hay for Ember at the training grounds.
95156.title: Stuff 'Em and Stick 'Em

95162.description:
With so little land not claimed by the humans or Twilight's Hammer, this ranch is one of our very few sources of food. Ogres aren't much in the way of farmers, but they love a good paletusk roast, and have agreed to let me stay so long as the meat keeps coming.

As our war advances, the demand for food is only ever increasing. Now I hardly have enough food to keep these ogres from looking at me like I'm their next meal.

If we want to have enough meat for Rog'mar, I'll need your help with the harvest.
95162.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Chunks of Boar Meat for Na'zok near Bolder'ok.
95162.title: Paletusk Harvesting

95163.description:
As you can see, there are more pigs strewn about the valley than there are in their pens. Gorgegut has been less than an ideal farmhand, but he keeps the humans away.

Some of the little ones have escaped across the river. They're still too small to be harvested out in the field so we need to return them here. Take this stick and give them a good swat! That should send them scampering back to their pens.
95163.objectivesText: Return $1oa Young Paletusks to Na'zok's farm near Bolder'ok.
95163.title: Drive Them Back

95165.description:
So, here's how we're gonna sink those ships. 

I can use that gunpowder you stole and make timed charges. All you've gotta do is hop on each of the Eastsea's boats, and plant one charge in the hull of each. Look for a spot near their cannons, that gunpowder'll make our explosives even more powerful. Once the charges are set, get outta there, and I'll hit the detonator!

The elegance of the plan is in its simplicity, don't ya think?
95165.objectivesText: Plant a remote explosive charge on each of the Eastsea's three boats.
95165.title: See Ya, Scallywags!

95184.description:
The rigors of training for battle are one thing, but these trainees don't yet understand the difference between a training sword and the well-kept blade of a seasoned veteran.

I think it's time we show our recruits how a sharpened blade can be the difference between victory and death.

If you can find us a few sharpening stones, we'll put them to good use. There are certain craftsmen known to study this trade. I'd suggest starting there.
95184.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Solid Sharpening Stones to Ember Bladewhisper at the Farholde training grounds.
95184.title: The Sharpest of Blades

95189.completionText: Return the Crest of Lordaeron to Lady Dena Kennedy in Stormwind City.
95189.description: <A weathered crest depicting the mark of Lordaeron. With so few relics left after the kingdom's fall, someone in Stormwind would be very keen to get their hands on this.>
95189.objectivesText: Return the Crest of Lordaeron to Lady Dena Kennedy in Stormwind City.
95189.title: Crest of Lordaeron

95195.description: <The old Alliance insignia appears to have belonged to a soldier of Lordaeron. These ruins are likely filled with similar medals that living relatives would be grateful to have returned to them.>
95195.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Bloodied Insignias and take them to General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind City.
95195.title: Bloodied Insignia

95204.description: <A weathered crest depicting the mark of Lordaeron. With so few relics left after the kingdom's fall, someone in the Undercity would be very keen to get their hands on this.>
95204.objectivesText: Bring the Crest of Lordaeron to Oran Snakewrithe in Undercity.
95204.title: Crest of Lordaeron

95212.description:
We're getting ready to send a team of rams to reinforce the Alterac expedition, but we've run out of material to make their saddles.

Collect pelts from the largest, fiercest leopards to the east and bring them to me. It's biting cold up there and our forces deserve nothing but the finest pelts to keep them warm!
95212.objectivesText: Collect 6 Pristine Leopard Pelts and deliver them to Amberstill Ranch.
95212.title: Never Saddle on Quality

95214.description: This keg held enough powder to turn King Magni's throne room into an open air courtyard. We've got to get it back from the troggs before they work out how to ignite it.
95214.objectivesText: Recover $1oa Stolen Blasting Powder from the troggs east of Gol'Bolar Quarry, then return to Quarrymaster Thesten.
95214.title: Stolen Blasting Powder

95216.description:
Welcome to the most vital organ of the Undercity: The Apothecarium! Here we experiment on the most virulent of Azeroth's exotic specimens.

You've caught me in a good mood, so I will let you in on my latest investigation. It appears there is a particularly venomous arthropod stalking the ruins above our fair city. Its toxins are said to eat through even undead flesh. How exhilarating!

I wish to validate these claims. Should you find yourself withering away from its bite, I should love a sample.
95216.objectivesText: Collect the Highly Toxic Strain from Witherfang in Ruins of Lordaeron for Theodore Griffs in Undercity.
95216.title: The New Plague

95217.description:
So you're looking to learn the blacksmith's trade? Maybe we can help each other.

The supply shipment's late, and I need materials for some repairs around the camp. If you get me what I need, I'll teach you some of my techniques. Sound fair?
95217.objectivesText: Collect 12 Copper Bars and 4 Toughened Boar Hides and deliver them to Frast Dokner.
95217.title: The Quarry's Smith

conditionalDescriptions.text:
Ah, a fellow human. It's about time Lordaeron sent reinforcements.

My master has already charged into the fray and has ordered me to maintain my post. It has been quite some time, however.

I don't dare trust this task to any of these filthy half breeds, but if I could impose on you a favor, I beg of you to find me the Grand Marshal. He is the tallest, most statuesque hero you've ever laid eyes on. You'll know him when you see him.

95250.description:
What do you want, $r? Can't you see there is a war to be won?

My master has already charged into the fray and has ordered me to maintain my post. It has been quite some time, however.

I doubt you'll survive ten minutes in combat, but if it keeps your simple mind busy, why don't you seek out the Grand Marshal. He is the tallest, most statuesque hero you've ever laid eyes on. You'll know him when you see him.
95250.objectivesText: Collect the Head of the Baron in the Ruins of Lordaeron and bring it back to Captain Truman.
95250.title: Abominable Creatures

95254.description:
Calling all anglers!

I'm in the market for some crab meat. Not just the usual shreds either, I'm talking whole claw. I've seen a big one crawling around under the docks, stealing bait and cutting lines.

I'll pay a reward to anyone who brings me that thing's pincer. You'll also get a helping of the dish I whip up.

-- Fimbo Greasemitz
95254.objectivesText: Bring Trapclaw's Pincer to Fimbo Greasemitz.
95254.title: WANTED: Trapclaw

95260.description:
