The hide is painted with broad strokes of fish guts and squid ink. It appears to depict some kind of sea monster, rising up from the waves, with a long neck. What could this beast be?

The nearest port is Powderfuse Port. If this monster is real, and lurks these waters, a sailor there has surely seen it.
95260.objectivesText: Find someone at Powderfuse Port who can identify the monster from the painted hide.
95260.title: Terrors From the Deep

95261.description:
That monster...with the long neck, just like you said. I've seen 'im around those islands -- out on my boat. I tried <hic> tellin' folks, but ohh nooo, you can't <hic> believe ol' Argo. He's just some...some...drunkard fisherman! Makin' up stories!

We'll show 'em...soon as I get some bait...

Hey! Quit standin' around! I'm gonna need entrails, a LOT of 'em. Any beast from around here. The smellier <hic> the better. I'm also gonna need some Rotflesh mushrooms. Those grow in that cave by Windstead.
95261.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Beast Entrails and $2oa Rotflesh Mushrooms for Argo Brinewhistle.
95261.title: It Takes Guts

95288.description:
You look like you're in the habit of doing whatever other people tell ya. I like that in a lackey. With a little trainin' you could be a great asset. Let's put that to the test.

Recently some of those Eastsea pirates made off with a shipment of MY stolen goods. That's bad sportsmanship. I stole them first!

Lesson one, lackey. Never backstab a backstabber. Go show them that they messed with the wrong goblin and take back my stuff. With force, preferably.
95288.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Smuggled Goods for Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port.
95288.title: Smuggler's Paradise

95294.description:
Friz sure knows how to get her point across. Well, you won't hear any objections from me. The Eastsea pirates won't interfere with her business. In exchange, maybe we can come to an arrangement. Pirating's a little difficult when you've got a scorned goblin sending marauding adventurers after you all day.

Run along back to your master, $c. Let Friz know there's a new captain in charge, and he foresees a profitable relationship in our future.
95294.objectivesText: Return to Friz Frazzlespark in Powderfuse Port.
95294.title: Smuggler's Bargain

95312.completionText: Speak with Fizbuz Mithril in Gadgetzan
95312.description:
I don't have Friz's money. Well, I had her money, but I bet it all on ol' Slugjaw here in Fizbuz's arena in Gadgetzan.

Don't gimme that look. It was a sound investment. I won big! I just haven't had a chance to collect my winnin's yet. If you're Friz's new errand $Gboy:girl;, why don't you go get it for me? I got a bad back, you know.

Hey, you don't want to go back to your boss empty handed, do ya? Gadgetzan is just west of here. You can't miss it.
95312.objectivesText: Speak with Fizbuz Mithril in Gadgetzan.
95312.title: Coming to Collect

95314.description:
Before the Scourge invasion, the reclusive village of Shadowvale was known for its Whispering Elixir. Distilled from herbs found only in Tyr's Fall, the elixir was sought by apothecaries, mystics, and poisoners alike even after being banned in the city.

I've had requests from a number of buyers eager to get their hands on some elixir. Travel to the ruins of Shadowvale deep in the Whispering Forest to the west. I'm prepared to offer significant compensation if you can recover some bottles for me.
95314.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Bottles of Whispering Elixir from Shadowvale, then return to Carolai Anise in Brill.
95314.title: That Shadowvale Green Elixir

95315.description:
Word from one of our scouts suggests a large force of enemies amassing to the far, far south, well beyond the Wetlands.

Even more curious is there appears to be an alliance settlement out there. Farholde? The name sounds familiar.

Let's not wait on this. Best to begin the conversation before it's too late. We're dealing with enough here as it is.

Take this correspondence and deliver it to whoever claims to be the leader of this detachment.
95315.objectivesText: Deliver Captain Nials' Correspondence to Demar Brant at Farholde Keep along the southeastern coast in the Riverglades.
95315.title: The Riverglades Report

95322.description:
Your timin' couldn't be better, friend. I was just on my way to collect my shipment from the Bloodsail Buccaneers. They're good friends of mine. Always happy to supply anything Friz is willin' to pay for.

But, ahem, just in case, it couldn't hurt for you to be my liaison. A good caravaneer knows it doesn't hurt to show off a little muscle. Just as a deterrent, of course.

They said they left my stuff in a chest on the hill outside of town for safekeepin'. Why don't you take a look for me, eh?
95322.objectivesText: Find the Bloodsail Trunk outside of Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.
95322.title: Get the Goods

95326.description: <The ledger contains a log of each of Ruzzgot's deliveries. The final note marks the heist a success and Ruzzgot's valuables collected by a nearby Venture Co. agent. The goods must still be with him.>
95326.objectivesText: Kill the Venture Co. Agent and take back Ruzzgot's Shipment for him in Booty Bay.
95326.title: The Big Payback

95327.description:
Looks like a deal's a deal. The Venture Co. got their comeuppance, Friz gets her loot, and everybody's happy. Overall a pretty smooth transaction if I do say so myself.

Now scram, I got another shipment comin' in soon from some Southsea Pirates.
95327.objectivesText: Return to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.
95327.title: All's Well That Ends Well

95328.description: Against your better judgement you scrape up and collect the squirming remains of the beast. Someone in Undercity might have a use for them.
95328.objectivesText: Deliver Whispering Horror Residue to Father Lankester in the War Quarter of Undercity.
95328.title: Whispering Horror Residue

95329.description:
There is a watch tower overlooking the plains to the north. It serves as an observation point to track any motion of the Horde's forces.

The watcher stationed there is named Cornelius. Speak to him and get a status report. He is all alone out there, so I like to check on him with some regularity. Fair warning, he can be a bit...taciturn. It's why he was assigned such a remote post in the first place.
95329.objectivesText: Go to Terral's Watch to get a status report from Watcher Cornelius.
95329.title: Out in the Field

95330.description:
My husband and I have a farm north of here. I come to Farholde after each harvest to sell what we grow. In good seasons, I like to set aside whatever we don't sell to give to folks who need a little pick-me-up. Gotta take care of your neighbors, I say.

There's a logging camp north of our farm, right on the river. I'm sure those boys could use some fruits and vegetables to give 'em some variety in their diet.

If you're heading that way, could you give this to the foreman there? Name's Halligan Turner.
95330.objectivesText: Deliver Cassandra's surplus farm goods to Halligan Turner at Turner's Logging Camp.
95330.title: Love Thy Neighbor

95349.description:
The recent events with the cult have delayed my plans to travel to Azeroth and I must remain here in Valanaar for a time. You and a handful of other Windshapers will be our vanguard instead. Alaana Stormwalker will be waiting to receive our Windshapers upon arrival in Mulgore, and I'd encourage you to explore Azeroth while we finish our business here. We will join you soon.

When you are ready, please proceed to the dock just outside this lodge and board the skycutter ship there. 

Banu-Alah, $n.
95349.objectivesText: Take the skycutter ship from Zephras Isle to Mulgore and speak with Alaana Stormwalker when you arrive.
95349.title: The Earthen Ring

95350.description:
It's a big world down here, and our new allies are the key to our survival.

The Earthen Ring is a member of the "Horde", a proud collection of like-minded peoples. The nearby city of Thunder Bluff is a part of the Horde, and further to the east lies the capital of Orgrimmar.

Seek out the flight master in the center of Thunder Bluff. They will fly you to Orgrimmar where you will make contact with the Horde warchief--Thrall, on behalf of the Windshapers. Winds guide you, $n.
95350.objectivesText: Travel to Orgrimmar and speak with Thrall in the Valley of Wisdom.
95350.title: Welcome to Azeroth

95383.description:
<Wharfmaster Steamfizzle inspects the coin you offered him.>

Whoa-ho! Ol' Friz sure is training the new generation right. Apologies for the delay, $Gsir:ma'am;. You're here to deliver a crate to someone in town, right? I don't know anythin' about that, but if I did, I'd go talk with Tazzik on the dock. He seems to be interested in things like that.

But be quick about it though, yeah? Don't need folks gettin' the wrong idea, ya know.
95383.objectivesText: Deliver Friz's Secret Stash to Tazzik in Steamwheedle Port.
95383.title: Shipping and Handling

95417.description:
Clubtoe see friends go. Some no come back. Some come back purple. Dat weird. Purple ones no act like friends no more.

Where others go? Why they no come back? Make Clubtoe think.

You hit hard. Maybe you go find friends in cave? Maybe you turn purple. Dat weird too.
95417.objectivesText: Find missing ogres in the caves beneath Sunnyglade for Clubtoe.
95417.title: The Purple Ones

95426.description:
Supply delivery to this area is no easy feat. All sorts of unscrupulous characters surround us in all directions, each seeking their own piece of the pie.

Now, with that said, perhaps this is an opportunity to slow Rog'mar's growth. What do you say to throwing a little wrench in our orc friends' plans?

Head north of Rog'mar to their training grounds and steal their supply shipments. The recovery time alone ensures our forces remain battle ready while theirs... well, you see where this is going.
95426.objectivesText: Retrieve $1oa Horde Supply Shipment from the training camps north of Rog'mar.
95426.title: Rog'mar Supplies

95427.description:
Clubtoe friends... dead? Why?

This Chogg'Zac fault! Dey say they make ogres strong! They lie!!

No more smashing rocks! Tiny creature help Clubtoe smash Chogg'zac stupid heads instead!
95427.objectivesText: Kill Chogg'Zac in the Sunnyglade cave and collect their heads for Clubtoe.
95427.title: Twilight No More!

95472.description:
I'm tellin' ya, I can't pay Friz back! I got nothin' left but the shirt off my back!

Why are you lookin' at me like that...
95472.objectivesText: Bring Tazzik's Sweaty Shirt to Friz Frazzlespark in Powderfuse Port.
95472.title: Consolation Prize

95494.description:
I need someone with a strong sword arm and some extra time on their hands to help me gather some lion hides. It stings my pride to ask a stranger for this aid, but I took an injury to my leg recently. Until I heal, I'm in no shape to go hunting myself but I have obligations to keep.

The big ones in this area generally have the best hides, so start with those first.
95494.objectivesText: Collect 6 Savannah Lion Hides from the Savannah Matriarchs and Savannah Patriarchs in the Barrens.
95494.title: Bruised Pride and Lion Hides

95495.description:
These hides are bound for a tanner who I often trade with. He is something of a hermit and he lives alone on the top of the ridge behind me. Climbing up a steep hillside isn't something I can manage easily right now so I'd be in your debt if you could make this delivery for me.

Oh, and about this tanner's... appearance. You need not be alarmed. In spite of his looks, he is no threat. I swear this is true.
95495.objectivesText: Bring the Bundle of Hides to the hermit on the ridge overlooking the Dry Hills in the Barrens.
95495.title: The Hermit Tanner

95507.description:
While you are out there, it would be of great help to me if you could check on my traps for me. I've got them strewn all over the valley.

Bring back any small game that I've caught. Keep your eye out for the other wildlife, though. This area can be dangerous if you aren't paying attention.
95507.objectivesText: Collect 8 Trapped Game from traps found in Sprung Traps in the Barrens.
95507.title: Vrang's Game

95561.description:
<The loud cries of baby Dawnbright echo through Farholde Keep. Tessa looks at you with a tired smile.>

Oh, hello there adventurer. Sorry for the noise. Little Emma here seems to be quite fussy today, but I'm not sure why. Maybe some food will help.

Do you think you could help me find something for her to eat? My husband stepped out to get some supplies so my hands are a little too full to get them myself. If you could find a few apples around here I could make a lovely mash for her.
95561.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Fresh Apples for Tessa Dawnbright in Farholde Keep.
95561.title: Apple of My Eye

95562.description:
I have a confession to make. Lady Amberhall did send me to collect those samples, but in truth I volunteered. Sunnyglade was my home before the war took it from me, and I could not rest knowing monsters still taint it. Be it horde or Twilight.

There is no victory here by learning from them. There's nothing to learn. They're beasts, plain and simple, and should be put down like beasts.

We must slay their master at the bottom of this cave and bring an end to this. Surely my mistress will understand.
95562.objectivesText: Kill Chogg'Zac in the caves beneath Sunnyglade and retrieve their heads for Apprentice Claire.
95562.title: Cut Off the Heads

95599.description:
<The key is covered in a thick layer of rust, suggesting that the key has been underwater for a significant amount of time.

There must be a matching lock somewhere nearby to use it on but you'll have to search for it. Perhaps the pool of water to the southwest of this camp might be a good place to start?>
95599.objectivesText: Find the old chest that the key belongs to nearby in Feralas.
95599.title: The Old Key

95601.description:
<This dead ogre must be one of the friends Clubtoe was looking for. The Twilight's Hammer seem to be conducting rituals on their members, empowering some and killing more.

These ritualists and their monstrosities must be stopped before they spread.>
95601.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Empowered Brutes and $2oa Twilight Ritualists then return to Clubtoe in Sunnyglade.
95601.title: The Purple Ones

95602.description:
Me hate smashing rock. All day me smash. Chogg'Zac say so. He big boss. Say we smash tinies, but now we work for tinies. That stupid.

Why smash rock? Me no know. Find shiny light in rocks. Chogg'Zac like shiny, me guess. Are you here for shiny light too? Others won't like that. They really like light. They draw pictures with it.

Clubtoe not get it. Light make Clubtoe feel sick. Me hate light. Me want SMASH shiny pictures! But Chogg'Zac be mad. Squish Clubtoe. That bad. But someone should.
95602.objectivesText: Destroy $1oa Twilight Ritual Circles found throughout the caves underneath Sunnyglade.
95602.title: Sickening Lights

95603.description:
Since brother Lowley and I began serving Farholde in a more secular capacity, the church here has fallen into disuse. I'd like to think that once the fighting is over, we will be able to bring the Light back to this place. Although, I fear that may not be for a long while...

Still, we need to keep the church in working order, in the hope that day will come.

To that end, a colony of bats has taken to roosting in the upper stories of the church. It would be a great help if you could remove them.
95603.objectivesText: Kill 5 Roosting Duskbats in the Farholde Cathedral for Sister Rowland.
95603.title: Bats in the Belfry

95613.description:
While we no longer hold service at the church, I feel it important to keep the candles lit on the graves of our fallen in the church's crypt. To me, keeping the candle's flame alive is a symbol that they are not forgotten and their sacrifices were not in vain.

If you would, bring me candles so that I might continue this ritual. It would mean a great deal to me.

If you're not sure where to find them, speak with Marla in the house just outside of the church. She's a friend and may have some to spare.
95613.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Holy Candles to Sister Rowland in Farholde Keep.
95613.title: Keeping the Light On

95615.description:
If you don't mind, I'd like you to do the honor of lighting these memorial candles. Go to the cemetery just outside and place a fresh candle wherever you see one that's gone out.

Such a task is a far cry from the excitement of your other adventures, I'm sure. Think of this as an opportunity for service and reflection--a quiet moment to acknowledge those who left this world before us, so that we might carry on and make it a better place.
95615.objectivesText: Place $1oa Memorial Candles on graves in the chapel graveyard for Sister Rowland at Farholde Keep.
95615.title: In Memoriam

95643.description:
As Lady Amberhall's apprentice in the dark arts, I may not look it but I'm usually quite capable of handling things on my own. I did not, however, anticipate an entire cave of void-infused ogres.

If you managed to get all the way down here without being captured, you must be powerful yourself. I was not so lucky with those ogres and their masters roaming about. Do the world a favor and kill the hideous beasts. Nothing good comes from a fanatic with a purpose, empowered or otherwise.
95643.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Twilight Ritualists and $1oa Empowered Brutes within the caves underneath Sunnyglade.
95643.title: Indiscriminate Purge

95646.description:
These brackish wetlands hold a greater well of unsalted southern waters. It pains me, yet within my roots I sense a corruption seeping through that mountain gully.

The creatures, like those in our lowlands, react more bitterly to the taint. Lacking the sea's hardening salt since life's dawn, they have little strength against such evil.

Go to those highlands, and bring me the Highland Horror's root core.
95646.objectivesText: Kill a Highland Horror within Excavation Sites and bring its root core to Rethiel the Greenwarden in the Wetlands.
95646.title: Horrors in the Highland

95647.description:
My husband, Ardin, has a rare gift for sensing nature. He'll scale any peak to gather the herbs and flowers I need for my alchemy, keeping our shelves and pantry stocked.

But I fear he's wandered into trouble. An excavation crew passed through seeking supplies. They spoke, among other things, of towering grasses unlike anything they'd ever seen. Those were what he told me he had to go see for himself. He's been gone too long!

If you learn anything of him, I'd be grateful.

objectives.text: Learn what happened to Ardin Grassman

95647.objectivesText: Find Ardin Grassman in the Excavation Sites.
95647.title: Lost in the Thicket Things

95663.description:
The Dragonmaw are a formidable clan.

They're known for binding magic strong enough to make dragons serve, and rumor claims they're preparing some display of it in the Wetlands. Whether truth or bluster, the Deathstalkers can't act on half-formed whispers. Broken symbols carried only that much to me.

A deathstalker agent needs a hand in the hills above the Dragonmaw encampment. Meet her there. She'll reveal the next steps.
95663.objectivesText: Travel to the Wetlands and meet the Deathstalker Agent in the hills above the Dragonmaw camp.
95663.title: Dragonmaw Rumors

95664.description: This unusual composite shard scatters light like a living prism. Its nature is uncertain, but its power feels ancient. The most knowledgeable minds for artifacts of this bygone age must reside on the Elder rise in Thunder Bluff.
95664.objectivesText: Take the Titan Relic to the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff and look for someone who can tell you more about it.
95664.title: Elder Knowledge

95682.description:
Dragonmaw. <She lets out a dry, amused scoff.>

The remnants of the dragon-wrangling clan think they've found something that could lead to them rising to their former power. In the eyes of whom... their false warchief?

Clear out their ragtag clan within the Excavation Sites so our Deathstalkers can move in undetected.

If the Dragonmaw carry anything of note upon them, return it to me--this information must stay between us and our royal command.
95682.objectivesText: Slay the Dragonmaw forces within the Excavation Site and return to the Deathstalker Agent outside with anything you recover.
95682.title: Open the Maw

95697.description:
Zamja tells me we need more homestyle cooking.
If we start selling raptor, she thinks it'll draw in customers who don't usually visit Borstan's Firepit.

Her idea is not so bad. But I want something that rises above the smells of our birth villages. We're in Orgrimmar! Borstan should serve a grand take on their familiar favorites.

A hunter recently came back from the Wetlands with a giant talon from the thicket raptors in the Excavation Sites.

Up for a job?
95697.objectivesText: Enter the Excavation Sites in the Wetlands and bring back Thicket Raptor Meat.
95697.title: Changing Tastes

95737.description:
From time to time, I correspond with others in my craft--herbalists or eccentrics who study rare plants and local oddities. We trade discoveries, and sometimes warnings of what lies ahead.

One alchemist in the Wetlands wrote of an excavation team her husband was part of, uncovering signs of a long-lost primordial grass... but she never sent word of its abundance or accessibility.

If you can, check on Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.
95737.objectivesText: Speak with Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.
95737.title: Seeking Caitlin

95748.description:
This is odd. This piece of the tablet you have brought me refers to the lost city of I'lalai as if it is a massive sprawling civilization. But the ruins off of the reef are not large enough to be something of that size.

$n, to the north of the Vile Reef there is an ancient troll ruin on the hills along the coast. A tablet that contains legends of the lost troll city is within. I wish to study this legend further.

Take this hide and charcoal to create a rubbing of this tablet, then return to me.
95748.objectivesText: Use the hide and charcoal to create a rubbing of the Third Troll Legend tablet.
95748.title: The Gurubashi Legends of Old

95772.description:
Me brother tried draggin' me off tae the Wetlands with some diggin' crew out o' Loch Modan. Said they were headin' into hills no dwarf's ever set boot in for some sort o' excavation.

Aye, I'd 'ave gone, if I wasn't already behind on this pile o' girdles I've got to refit.

Daewyn normally writes after he sends off, though. Haven't heard a thing, gives me a strange feelin' this time.

If yer marchin' that way, mind checking in on me brother?
95772.objectivesText: Look for Dorin Songblade's brother, Daewyn, in Whelgar's Excavation Site.
95772.title: Songblade Search

95774.description:
The healer who saved me could not save her, and she has died in battle. Her name is Olgra, and I will never forget her.

You did not find her adornments on her body? She wore many jewels of polished bone.

Slay the Razormane Raiders near where she fell, and find her precious works of art!

I will place them with the memorial that I build in her memory.
95774.objectivesText: Slay quilboars and collect $1oa of Olgra's Adornments for Mankrik's memorial.
95774.title: Her Name Is Olgra

95775.description:
What I am about to ask you is no small feat, $c, and will likely require strong allies to accomplish.

I want to know more about the ruins on the other side of the cavern the naga are guarding. If my suspicions prove correct, it could indeed be the lost city of I'lalai. The amount of lost historical knowledge at our fingertips could be unrivaled, but I am too old to venture myself.

Enter the ruins and gather etchings of any tablets you find there, then return to me.
95775.objectivesText: Use the hide and charcoal to create rubbings of the tablets found in the Drowned City.
95775.title: The Drowned City

95776.description:
You have done well to slay the naga just off of our coast, but the fact that they are in our waters in such numbers means there is yet a larger threat.

I have spoken to Kin'weelay, and he thinks these Brinescale naga are infiltrating the ruins of the Drowned City. If the naga are there, then they are up to no good and are likely searching for something.

We can't let them get their hands on anything that could compromise us here and it is time to put an end to this. Slay their leader and return to me.
95776.objectivesText: Slay Var'Taka in the Drowned City.
95776.title: The Only Good Brinescale...

95787.description:
<Loremaster Dibbs' hands shake as he reads the scouting report and the troll legends.>

Could it be? By this account it sounds like the lost troll city of I'lalai has risen just off the coast of Stranglethorn! We must investigate immediately. Why, if my research is correct this could be the archeological discovery of the century!

Please, I know it is a long trek back to Stranglethorn but if you find yourself in this Drowned City, collect any legends you find there and return them to me.
95787.objectivesText: Use the hide and charcoal to create rubbings of the tablets found in the Drowned City.
95787.title: Take Two With Water

95788.description:
The Skullsplitter fetishes Brother Nimetz sent with you are indeed powerful, though I do not think they contributed to Kurzen's condition, or at least not directly.

Still, if the rumors are true and the lost troll city of I'lalai has indeed risen from its watery grave, it is possible the dark magics used to raise the doomed city may be related.

If you dare to venture into the Drowned City of I'lalai, please gather any troll fetishes you find and bring them here to me for further study.
95788.objectivesText: Collect $1oa I'lalai Fetishes from trolls in the Drowned City.
95788.title: Magics of the Drowned City

95789.description:
Hey pal, you look like you can handle yourself in a fight.

Baron Revilgaz has me keep'n my ear to the ground for magical objects. Word on the street is that a sunken troll ruin has mysteriously become, eh, un-sunk, which means there are a lot of unclaimed goods, if you catch my meaning.

Problem is, it's also caught the eye of pirates! Not just any pirates, the Saltseers specifically collect magical artifacts. I need you to go into the Drowned City, clear them out and take their stolen artifacts.
95789.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Voodoo Infused Artifacts from Saltseer pirates in the Drowned City.
95789.title: Shady Saltseers

95791.description:
The Saltseer pirates have been a thorn in my side recently and knowing they're in the Drowned City makes it worse! I mean they're always bad news, but there is one captain in particular I want outta the picture. That damned Captain Dreadrise!

He and his crew are very accomplished at gathering all the magical artifacts I've been after, and I'm tired of the competition.

I want you to remove Captain Dreadrise and his Saltseer Coroners from the picture. Permanently.
95791.objectivesText: Slay 3 Saltseer Coroners and Captain Dreadrise in the Drowned City.
95791.title: The Saltseer Captain

95792.description:
If you wanna land a big score, you gotta go where others wouldn't dare! This cave behind me's rich with untapped mineral deposits. I'm talkin' BIG bucks if we can get a crew in there.

There's just this... teeny tiny... dragon problem. It's nothing, really.

If you're willing to go in there and save me the hassle of clearing the dragons out, there's a nice reward in it for you. Not to mention, you'll be in the good graces of a future mining tycoon!
95792.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Cinderscale Whelps and $2oa Cinderscale Warriors for Gelinda Coppergleam.
95792.title: Clear 'em Out

95803.description:
Now that we've claimed the head of the tarnished commander, I need you to deliver it to the Undercity. Sylvanas Windrunner mistrusts us greatly, and all but openly disparages us.

Deliver Rudolph Gelhardt's head to the Dark Lady. Show her that we tend to our own house and are devoted to the prosperity of the forsaken.
95803.objectivesText: Bring the head of Rudolph Gelhardt to Sylvanas Windrunner in the Undercity.
95803.title: A Token of Good Faith

95809.description:
I need a moment to rest before I find my own way out.

<He pulls some reeds from his pack and quickly braids and bends them into a heart.>

Take this, and bring it back to Caitlin. Let her know I'll be home soon! Now that we have a path cleared out thanks to you, I'll gather my bushels and follow your trail.

Thank you.
95809.objectivesText: Return to Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.
95809.title: Heartwoven

95810.description:
You pick up a fractured piece of the rock-mech automaton. It has a texture unlike anything you've touched before, a composite material of unknown makeup. This is certainly bound to be more 'device' than 'debris.'

Prospector Whelgar himself at his excavation site might have something useful to share about the relic.
95810.objectivesText: Bring the Titan Relic to Prospector Whelgar in the Wetlands excavation site.
95810.title: Lost Relic Carry

95819.description:
Greetings, accomplished craftsperson!

Completion of this form will grant you non-exclusive, revocable, and legally limited permission to display advertisement signs for your tradeskill(s) all across Azeroth!

Once completed, please bring this to your local Durotar Supply & Logistics Contract Coordinator to begin processing.

Happy crafting!
95819.objectivesText: Bring the completed form to Jornah in The Barrens.
95819.title: Sign Me Up!

95882.description:
An Alliance scouting party has been seen on a small island northeast of Rog'mar. They are led by a scoutmaster who has made tracking enemy movements increasingly difficult. The bastard even named his filthy pet after me as an open mockery. He knows I'm hunting him.

This human has eyes everywhere, and they need to be put out. I already claimed one before he managed to flee. Bring me his other as proof that the scoutmaster is no more. Show him he is not as untouchable as he thinks.

-- Neza Bloodsnout
95882.objectivesText: Bring the Scoutmaster's Eye to Neza Bloodsnout in Rog'mar.
95882.title: WANTED: Scoutmaster Vargas

95883.description:
<The preparations for a hastily-assembled ritual are gathered unceremoniously on the altar. According to the scrap of note, everything has been gathered. All that's missing are the offering of blood and the Tortured Soul.

The undead around you look tortured enough. They may have what you seek.>
95883.objectivesText: Collect a Tortured Soul from the nearby undead in Beren's Peril in Silverpine Forest.
95883.title: The Tortured Soul

95884.description:
<The scrap of note is mostly illegible. What is still readable, however, are notes about preparations for an offering.

An offering stone is mentioned, as well as a ritual.

Perhaps you can find this offering stone nearby.>
95884.objectivesText: Find the Offering Stone in Beren's Peril in Silverpine Forest.
95884.title: The Offering Stone

95885.description:
<All that's left now is the offering of blood.

The note scrap mentioned a 'willing sacrifice.'

An intense sense of dread washes over you.>
95885.objectivesText: Use the Tortured Soul to give an offering of blood at the Offering Stone in Beren's Peril.
95885.title: The Offering of Blood

95912.description:
With each orc we cut down, another takes its place--somehow even more capable than the last. A skilled warrior must be training this new generation. If we are to make a dent in their numbers, we need to ensure they don't have a chance to recoup their losses.

If any soldier is brave enough, it's imperative we find this blademaster and put an end to him. He is likely at the trainee camp north of the Horde outpost even now. Kill him, take his banner, and destroy the orcs' morale.

-- Ember Bladewhisper
95912.objectivesText: Bring the Blademaster's Banner to Ember Bladewhisper in Farholde Keep.
95912.title: WANTED: Blademaster Kaijo

95913.description:
<Tessa rocks her baby, trying to help her sleep.>

If she isn't hungry, maybe she's just tired. To be honest, Emma here was a delightful surprise, but that means we were a little unprepared. My husband built her this lovely bassinet, but I worry these blankets are too old. She deserves the best, after all.

If you're still willing to help, I would be forever grateful if you could find some pelts for me to line her bed with. If this stops her crying, I think everyone in Farholde would be grateful.
95913.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Coyote Pelts for Tessa Dawnbright in Farholde Keep.
95913.title: Fit for a Princess

95934.description:
My surveying tools show signs of a never-before-seen mineral in these caves. Cubic draconia, I call it. Probably worth a fortune.

Exciting as this is, no one's gonna come help me dig it up if I can't show 'em proof that it exists. Sure, I have the readings from my tools, but people like to hold a big shiny crystal, not look at charts.

I'm sure there's a few crystals poking up from the dirt in there. If you're willing to dodge a few dragons and get one, you'd really be helpin' a gal out.
95934.objectivesText: Find a piece of Cubic Draconia for Gelinda Coppergleam.
95934.title: Proof of Profit

95935.description:
The dragon's head is all teeth, scale, and ash--a grisly prize taken from a grisly creature. Holding it, you feel the heat of its last fiery breath still radiating from its mouth.

While the threat Scaldaron once posed is no more, the sentries at the Southern Watch ought to know about what happened here.
95935.objectivesText: Take the Head of Scaldaron to Cedric Dalton at the Southern Watch.
95935.title: Hail the Dragonslayer

95951.description:
'Ey boss-$Gmon:lady;, ya need help from ol' Tan'jani? Don't worry about it, I fix you up good.

Orcs be good at hittin' humans with axes, but when you wanna stick 'em before dey see ya comin', that's when you call on the headhunters. You wanna learn to stick 'em too? I see it in your eyes, heheh.

First we get you your own spears. Dis one's mine. Go to the human camp to de west and take their wood. Take knife with ya. You can sharpen their lumber into good spears for stickin'. Den bring 'em back.
95951.objectivesText: Collect Wood Bundles from Peasant Woodpiles in Turner's Logging Camp then fletch them into $1oa Makeshift Stickin' Spears.
95951.title: Fetch 'n' Fletch

95957.description:
Here ya go, champ. One drink for ol' grumpy guts over there. If this doesn't sober him up, nothin' will.

Oh and uh... wash your hands after touchin' this. And don't get it in your eyes.
95957.objectivesText: Deliver Zizplink's Frothing Mug to Gray Dawnbright in Powderfuse Port.
95957.title: Drink Up!

95961.description:
<Tessa's baby continues to wail loudly.>

I guess she isn't tired. Oh... everyone makes it look so easy. Her father always knows how to cheer her up. If only he'd come home already.

$n, I hate to ask this, but can you see what is taking him so long? He set out a while ago but he should have been back by now. Emma just lights up when she sees him.

You should find him at Powderfuse Port-- he seems to go there a lot lately. You'll know my Gray when you see him. He shines as brightly as the sun.
95961.objectivesText: Find Gray Dawnbright in Powderfuse Port.
95961.title: Stepped Out

95975.description:
Tess says little Emm can't sleep without me? And you did all that for them? A total stranger? Damn it. What was I thinking...

Even if I can't guarantee a perfect world for her, I still need to be a part of it. What am I even fighting for if I can't hope for a brighter future?

Thank you for helping my family in my absence, friend, but it's time for me to go home. If I could ask one more favor, can you pick some flowers and take them to Tess? Let her know I'll be home soon? I need to clean up first.
95975.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Wildflowers and deliver them to Tessa Dawnbright in Farholde Keep.
95975.title: Her World

95981.description:
Taking away their pendants is just the first step. If the Kirin Tor really are shipping a steady supply of relics from Dalaran, we must stop them at the source.

Search the roads around Ambermill for Dalaran's wizards and watchers. Their presence has allowed free access across our borders for too long. If we can cull their numbers, that should put a stop to these pendants making it into Silverpine Forest in the first place.
95981.objectivesText: Slay $1oa Dalaran Wizards and $2oa Dalaran Watchers for Shadow Priest Allister in the Sepulcher.
95981.title: Watching the Roads

95983.description:
The skeleton is badly mangled. Deep markings on its limbs vaguely match patterns of teeth and claws. Many days beneath the beating sun have made the bones pale and brittle as well. The brutality of both the attacker and the weather have rendered the victim's identity a mystery.

You can't take the whole skeleton with you, but you could bring its skull to the nearby watchman and see what he knows.
95983.objectivesText: Bring the Gnawed Skull to Watcher Cornelius at Terral's Watch.
95983.title: A Feast for Buzzards

95984.description:
These markings are from a lion. By the look of them, this one's especially large. The leader of the nearby pride, most likely.

If rumor spreads about a man-eating lion prowling around on my watch, Demar will be furious. Fortunately, I have a plan.

I can make a whistle that mimics the call of a wounded tallstrider. We can use that to lure the beast out. I'll just need one of their beaks to give it the right sound. There's tallstriders all over the plains. Get me a beak, and make it snappy!
95984.objectivesText: Bring an Intact Tallstrider Beak to Watcher Cornelius at Terral's Watch.
95984.title: Song of the Strider

95988.description:
Talked to Gray, didja? Ball of laughs, that guy. Last thing he needs is you gettin' him another drink. This is an inn not a bar. He's lucky I haven't thrown him out.

You tryin' to take him with you, be my guest. Though I don't think he's in any condition to go anywhere like that. Not without a little goblin pick-me-up.

Why don't ya gather some ingredients for me from this list while I prepare your little friend his 'drink.' We'll see if he still wants booze after he's had my specialty cocktail.
95988.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Crawler Spittle, Fresh Chum, Goblin Degreaser, and Expired Poison for Innkeeper Zizplink in Powderfuse Port.
95988.title: Goes Down Smooth

95992.description:
Dese waters be treacherous. My headhunters keep the paths clear as dey can, but there be a beasty stalkin' de rivers even we cannot catch. Excitin', eh?

Boss say we gotta clear it out, so we got a little competition goin'. Find de white one patrollin' de rivers and bring me its fang. Whoever sticks this slippery crocolisk win de whole pot. Just don't get snapped yourself, heheh!

-- Tan'jani
95992.objectivesText: Bring Ghostmaw's Fang to Tan'jani in Rog'mar.
95992.title: WANTED: Ghostmaw

95999.description:
Wanted! Incinerator Gar'im, Leader of an orc incursion in Render's Valley. Purported to be working with the Blackrock of Stonewatch Keep.

Beware of Incinerator Gar'im. He and his Shadowcasters are extremely dangerous. A handsome reward will be given to any brave soul that can deliver proof of Incinerator Gar'im's demise to Magistrate Solomon.
95999.objectivesText: Deliver the Broken Staff of Incinerator Gar'im to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire.
95999.title: WANTED: Incinerator Gar'im

96009.description:
One thing that never ceases to amaze me is the drive of humans. They see a desolate warzone teemin' with orcs and cultists and figure that's the perfect spot tae set up shop! Amazin'.

But, it's not me job tae tell 'em where to build. Just gotta show 'em how. And if we want this keep tae be as big as they say, we're gonna need lots o' wood.

With how dangerous the roads have become our lumber shipments from the mill tae the northwest are slowin' to a crawl. Think ye can fetch a few bundles for us?
96009.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Wood Bundles from Turner's Logging Camp for Bertrand Ironbrow in Farholde Keep.
96009.title: High Stakes

96010.description:
Although I am sure we can attribute the damage to both pylons to the reckless centaur stomping about, I suspect the timing of their rampage resulted in the shards being separated. I know little about their quarrels, but I do know there are at least two main factions that have trespassed into Shen'dralas: the ferocious Magram and the cunning Gelkis.

Keeping these treasures in the midst of a battlefield would be unwise. By now, I am assuming they have taken their trophies back to their own villages.
96010.objectivesText: Recover shards and fragments of the pylons, found guarded at the Magram and Gelkis villages. Return them to Mordent Evenshade.
96010.title: Fragments of the Pylons

96015.description:
We should be thankful that our foe is stupid. An army of ogres at their disposal, and the Twilight's Hammer have them working in the mines nowhere near the fight. I don't know if I chalk it up to mismanagement or an internal struggle, but either way they're in no position to defend themselves.

That's where we come in. With the cult's focus divided, we have an opportunity to strike the enemy while they're vulnerable and split them further. Go to this mine and sow some chaos among their ranks.
96015.objectivesText: Defeat $1oa Ogre Miners and $2oa Twilight Subjugators in the cave near the Twilight's Shroud for Sergeant Riftan.
96015.title: A Miner Problem

96018.description:
You may have seen the floating sparks of mana scattered throughout Shen'dralas. This is a new phenomenon, likely the result of the damage the pylons have endured.

We need this mana back in a semicrystallized form. We can accomplish this by using the Mana Sieve found within the temple. Borrow the sieve and collect any floating mana orbs you find.

The temple's denizens will not appreciate their precious artifact being borrowed without their consent, but they will understand in time.
96018.objectivesText: Acquire the Mana Sieve from within the temple in Shen'dralas and use it to collect Ancient Mana Crystals. Once you have acquired enough mana, empower the pylons and return to Mordent Evenshade.
96018.title: Powering the Pylons

96031.description:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, $c. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.
96031.objectivesText: Speak with Gretta Finespindle in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96031.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

96044.description:
So, you've become a Blacksmith. That's a great choice if you want to make sure your blades never dull.

I reckon I know someone that can help with that by teaching you how to craft a Sharpening Wheel. Bring one of these out at your camp and all the warriors and rogues in the area will be lining up to hone their weapons.
96044.objectivesText: Speak with Tognus Flintfire in Kharanos to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96044.title: Camping 101: Blacksmithing

96056.description:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
96056.objectivesText: Speak with Balthus Stoneflayer in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96056.title: Camping 101: Skinning

96057.description:
Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.

I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.
96057.objectivesText: Speak with Uthrar Threx in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96057.title: Camping 101: Tailoring

96058.description:
Engineers like yourself can cook up all sorts of bits, bots, and bombs for fun and profit.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Reagent Bot for your camp. This helpful automaton can help keep you well-supplied so that you and your allies never run out of the materials needed to fuel your spells.
96058.objectivesText: Speak with Bronk Guzzlegear in Kharanos to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96058.title: Camping 101: Engineering

96059.description:
Now that you've begun your journey into being an enchanter, I reckon I can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp once you've learned the ropes.

It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
96059.objectivesText: Speak with Thonys Pillarstone in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96059.title: Camping 101: Enchanting

96060.description:
Let me be the first to share that I was a master swordsman in life. I forged weapons by day and wielded them by night.

As you are quite well aware, my relationship with this particular blade is now extraordinarily complicated. Though I think I could swing it around, I'm not convinced it would be of much use unless I was fighting other spirits. Is that really of any value to me in Shen'dralas?

Nonetheless, I would like its capabilities tested and I think our forests could use a gentle culling.

objectives.text: Shen'dralas wildlife slain with the blade

96060.objectivesText: Use the Phantasmal Blade to execute $1oa wildlife in Shen'dralas, then return to Vindael at the temple.
96060.title: Tempered Expectations

96063.description:
The fuel of the future's not coal, or oil, it's gas, baby! Those marshy ponds to the southwest spew it out by the ton, and I've got just the invention to put it to use--a new type of engine that runs on the stuff. The gas is a real pain to collect, though.

If you feel like making a humble contribution to the future of science and industry, why don't you help me get some of that gas? You can see it coming up from vents near the water.
96063.objectivesText: Gather 5 Marsh Gas Vials for Sleebo Fizzlespout.
96063.title: Gaseous Gold

96067.areaDescription: Fight G45-B4G in a stress test of Sleebo's engine.
96067.description:
You may have noticed my mechanical companion here, G45-B4G. Whirlin' around in that burlap chest of his is the one, and only, working prototype of my gas-powered engine.

I figure it's in need of some stress testing. How'd you like to take him on in a fight? I can power him up with the gas you've collected.

Oh, and don't worry about hurting him. He can't feel a thing!
96067.title: Rock 'em and Sock 'em

96081.description:
If there is one thing a fighting force always needs, it's bandages. Unfortunately, Farholde has no reliable way to manufacture cloth. Thus, we depend on imports from the goblins or, if we are lucky, what we can take back from the orcs.

Currently, our supply of quality cloth is running low. I will have to start making bandages of old shirts before long. If you have the means to aid us, you would be saving many lives.
96081.objectivesText: Gather 20 Mageweave Cloth for Brother Lowley at Farholde Keep.
96081.title: Wound Dressings

96082.description:
I will fashion the cloth you've given me into bandages. In the meantime, please take these ones that I have already made, and dress the wounds of the soldiers who need it. It should be a matter of basic first aid.

Your assistance here is both necessary, and highly appreciated. I simply cannot be everywhere at once.
96082.objectivesText: Bandage up 3 Wounded Soldiers for Brother Lowley.
96082.title: Doctor's Orderly

96084.description:
I will spare you the grisly details, but these soldiers are violently ill. The nature of their sickness leads me to believe there is an issue with either their food or their water.

I've already checked the crops coming in from the nearby farms, so this only leaves the water, which comes from the local rivers. The best place to collect a sample is from the pools in the plains to the north. Nearly every river runs through the area, so it would be wise to check for contamination there.
96084.objectivesText: Collect a sample of drinking water from the plains for Sister Rowland at the chapel in Farholde Keep.
96084.title: Something's in the Water

96103.description:
The skeleton is badly mangled. Deep markings on its limbs vaguely match patterns of teeth and claws. Many days beneath the beating sun have made the bones pale and brittle as well. The brutality of both the attacker and the weather have rendered the victim's identity a mystery.

You can't take the whole skeleton with you, but you could bring its skull to a hunter at Rog'mar and see what they know.
96103.objectivesText: Bring the Gnawed Skull to Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.
96103.title: A Feast for Buzzards

96104.description:
These markings are from a lion. By the look of them, this one is especially large--the leader of the nearby pride.

I would gladly hunt the beast myself, but you have first claim. Instead, I will aid you.

I can make a whistle that mimics the call of a wounded tallstrider. You can use it to lure the lion out. I'll just need one of their beaks to give it the right sound.

There are tallstriders all over the plains. Find me a beak and the hunt can begin!
96104.objectivesText: Bring an Intact Tallstrider Beak to Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.
96104.title: Song of the Strider

96105.description:
The whistle is made, $n.

Take it and go to the top of the hill south where the lions dwell.

Once you are ready to face your quarry, blow the whistle and the beast should appear.

I wish you luck in your hunt. May you return in glory.
96105.objectivesText: Use the Tallstrider Call to call forth the leader of the lion pride. Slay the beast and retrieve its hide for Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.
96105.title: King of the Wild Plains

96107.description:
A hunter goes through more arrows in her lifetime than there are stars in the sky.

Personally, I make mine by hand. I only trust my own work.

The coarse feathers of the nearby buzzards make for excellent fletching. Would you aid me by collecting a few?
96107.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Plains Buzzard Feathers to Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.
96107.title: Feathers for Fletching

96108.description:
Arrows are always essential, but sometimes you need something more potent to take down your prey.

This is where poison coatings come into play. They ruin the meat, but if you need something dead, they do the job.

Poisons can either be brewed or, if you are brave, gathered. You strike me as the latter.

The vipers by the pools to the south produce a powerful venom. If I have estimated you correctly, I think you could collect some of it.
96108.objectivesText: Bring 4 samples of Glade Viper Venom to Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.
96108.title: Poison Tips

96109.description:
As important as a hunter's weapons is her quiver. A good quiver holds many arrows, while not being so large as to slow the wearer down. It must be durable, and fit snugly onto the body.

Around here, there is no better material for a quiver than the pelts of lions. They are already well-suited for the life of a hunter on the plains.

The lions gather on a hill to the south. You can see it from here. Please, bring me their pelts.
96109.objectivesText: Gather 6 Prized Lion Hides for Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.
96109.title: A Hunter's Quiver

96125.description:
Now that the lion hides have been collected, and the orcish poachers culled, I can finally get a break.

At least, that's what I would say, if the man who was supposed to relieve me of my watch wasn't missing.

Dunston Willis, explorer extraordinaire, went to investigate the ogre settlement to the north a few days ago. He said he'd take over my post upon his return.

Find him. If he's alive, bring him back here. If he's hanging up on meat hooks, bring me proof so Demar can send me someone else.
96125.objectivesText: Find Dunston Willis somewhere among the ogres in Bolder'ok.
96125.title: In Need of Relief

96126.description:
I'm not sure how you got in here, but please, listen to me.

As you know, I serve as a watchman for Farholde Keep.

While on patrol, I was ambushed by a band of these brutes and taken prisoner. Now, I am forced to fight in the ring for their amusement.

I haven't much strength left. If I'm to escape, it's now or never. 

My captor is an ogre they call "Gronok the Butcher". He has the key to my shackles. Will you bring me that key and help me out of here?
96126.objectivesText: Find Gronok the Butcher, kill him, and bring Dunston the key to his shackles.
96126.title: An Ogre's Captive

96135.description:
Euck, just bein' around these blasted totems is givin' me the willies--but that's good. This much twisted corruption will be exactly what we need tae summon the quilboar's elementals.

Go to the Thousand Needles and find a suitable spot for your defenses. The steam pools should work. They're rich with fire, earth, water, and air alike. Place these totems and be ready for a fight. The Razormane won't take too kindly to yer interference.
96135.objectivesText: Use the Twisted Totems to put an end to the quilboar ritual.
96135.title: Heed My Call

96136.description:
As you have no doubt experienced yourself, the elements of Azeroth are unique to those in Zephras. It is one thing to channel the forces of nature within the elemental plains, and another thing entirely to do it down here in the muck.

I could grant you your totem of air, but I think it would do you more good to meet with the one who trains the other earth-bound initiates. What say you, $n?
96136.objectivesText: Find Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles.
96136.title: Call of Air

96138.description:
A bow left by the spirit of Merrick Valor, famed Watcher who prided himself on keeping the roads safe from encroaching enemies.

With Merrick's spirit still wandering the roads, perhaps his unfinished business was to clear out invaders near his home in Raven Hill. The ogres south of town may be what's troubling his spirit.
96138.objectivesText: Defeat $1oa Splinter Fist Warriors and $2oa Splinter Fist Taskmasters then return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire for more information.
96138.title: Merrick's Bow

96139.description:
In dark times like these, it's important we remember our heroes as much as our foes. Darkshire would not still be standing if it weren't for the bravery of folk like the good Lady Althea or those who lost their lives at Raven Hill.

Have you read much on Raven Hill? No, of course not. Its history was wiped out along with its people. My library, impressive as it is, has little on the subject.

If you happen to find anything, I'd appreciate it if you brought it here. Those folk deserve to be remembered.
96139.objectivesText: Search Raven Hill for anything of interest and return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire.
96139.title: The Valor Family

96204.description:
Now that I'm free I'm going to make these vile creatures regret ever laying eyes on a Windshaper.

Let's get out of here, $c.
96204.objectivesText: Accompany Lumina Windsinger and help her escape Fenris Keep.
96204.title: The Windshaper's Wrath

96241.description:
Something funny be happenin' over there at Gloomrise. Ol' Mazu'kon be hearin all about these nasty new beasties skitterin' all around there.

Some say those creepy crawlies got a venom that have some unique properties and this be gettin' me curious. Take my extractor. Use it on the dead bodies layin' around that place to harvest the venom. Do this and I be in ya debt, mon.
96241.objectivesText: Use the Toxin Extractor to gather $1oa Gloomrise Toxin Samples from the Gnawed Corpses at Gloomrise.
96241.title: Talkin' bout Toxins, Mon

96243.description:
It's past time ye heeded the earth, brave Shaman. The elements already prickle in yer skin, but once ye speak with the stone, the ground itself'll set firm 'neath yer soles--and in yer soul.

Seek out Teo Hammerstorm, in Coldridge Valley. Ye'll find him within Anvilmar, a holdfast forged by hammer, fire, and will.
96243.objectivesText: Find Teo Hammerstorm in Dun Morogh.
96243.title: Call of Earth

96259.description:
There is an ancient tauren burial ground at the place called Gloomrise, just northwest of this camp. Of late it has been infested with a particularly vicious brood of spiders. These spiders not only pose a threat to the people of Mulgore, they are also damaging a site that most tauren consider to be sacred.

It would be of great service if you could travel to Gloomrise and put an end to this infestation. The ancestors will surely smile upon you if you see this done.
96259.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Gloomrise Hatchlings and $2oa Gloomrise Soldiers.
96259.title: Defending the Dead

96260.description:
Have you heard what befell the burial ground at Gloomrise? Giant spiders--rumored to have a venom so strong that it can wake the dead--have spread like wildfire. Nasty business, if you ask me.

One of the scouts dispatched to investigate returned half dead and covered in an incredibly resilient, crystalline spider silk. I harvested what I could, but I would highly value more samples of this silk for additional study.

Bring me more of this crystalline silk and I will reward you.
96260.objectivesText: Gather $1oa strands of Crystalline Silk from Gloomrise Spinners.
96260.title: Stronger than Steel

96261.description:
As is often the case with infestations such as the one we are facing at Gloomrise, a single powerful matriarch often leads to the rapid spread of a hostile spider population.

If we wish to drive these beasts off for good, we'll need to seek out the progenitor and end her. When you go to Gloomrise, seek out the broodmother there and destroy her. I'd advise you to bring allies, and be ready for anything. These seem to be no ordinary spiders.
96261.title: The Broodmother

96294.description:
<The Broodmother you just killed is no spider at all, but rather a night elf druid who assumed a twisted animal form. A variety of questions flood your mind about the nature--and purpose--of the spiders at Gloomrise.

You notice a note peeking out of the folds of the dead elf's robe. Perhaps this document may answer some of the questions filling your head.>
96294.objectivesText: Bring the letter you recovered from Broodmother Valraxx to Muln Earthfury at Skywatcher Plateau.
96294.title: A Darker Truth

96337.description:
I told you that I'd make it worth your while to free me. I don't have any gold for you, but I have something better.

Take this. It will help you find a treasure more valuable than gold. Do what you want with it, but if anyone asks you where you got it, tell them that the person who gave it to you died. 

Tell them he was vaporized by dragonfire... blown out to sea.
96337.objectivesText: Use the note provided by Mason Connery to find his hidden treasure.
96337.title: More Valuable Than Gold

96390.description:
Dark Iron spies have infiltrated Dun Morogh. To what end I canna' be sure, but this is a problem we need to nip in the bud before it is allowed to grow.

Head eastward to Ironband's Compound and kill the Dark Iron spies that you find there.
96390.objectivesText: Slay $1oa Dark Iron Spies in Dun Morogh.
96390.title: Nip 'Em in the Bud

conditionalDescriptions.text:
The map you are holding seems to show a complex series of underground tunnels and highways that all seem to converge on a point underneath Ironforge itself.

You can't be sure what the runes say as they are written in the ugly jagged rune language of the Dark Iron dwarves, but you can guess at the purpose of these tunnels. As you are reading the map, a gust of wind washes over you and you can faintly hear a dwarven voice carried on it, urging you to seek out an Earthseer named "Farsen".

96391.description:
The map you are holding seems to show a complex series of underground tunnels and highways that all seem to converge on a point underneath Ironforge itself.

You can't be sure what the runes say as they are written in the ugly jagged rune language of the Dark Iron dwarves, but you can guess at the purpose of these tunnels. As you are reading the map, a gust of wind washes over you and you can faintly hear a dwarven voice carried on it. Earthseer Farsen needs to see this.
96391.objectivesText: Deliver the Dark Iron Map to Earthseer Farsen in Dun Morogh.
96391.title: Underground Map

96393.description:
Gather some allies and head down into the caverns beneath Old Ironforge. Enter the Hall of Thanes there and push to the lower vaults. 

My Dark Iron is a bit rusty, but I can make out a name--one Durgen Dirgehammer. It's likely that he's the commander. Take his head and deliver it to King Magni Bronzebeard. 

Oh, and when you do, tell him his old friend Farsen sends his regards!
96393.objectivesText: Enter the Hall of Thanes beneath Old Ironforge and claim the Head of Durgen Dirgehammer.
96393.title: Old Ironforge Incursion

96394.description:
Something has disturbed the tombs down in the Hall of Thanes, and strange noises have been heard coming from deep within the vaults. The spirits of the dead are light sleepers, and whatever is going on down there seems to have startled them.

Head down there and see what you can do about that for us. If any of the dead are awake--well, put them back down!
96394.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Enraged Apparitions, $2oa Tormented Souls and put the spirit of Anvilmar to rest.
96394.title: The Restless Dead

96395.description:
The... Thane... my mighty... Thane... he... needs to... rest.

Please... help him... help him... rest...

Consumed... by... ancient... grudge... No... rest...
96395.objectivesText: Put the spirit of Faldrim Anvilmar to rest and then return to the Ghostly Attendant in the Hall of Thanes.
96395.title: An Ancient Grudge

96403.description:
You there, adventurer... I could really use your aid.

I was sneaking--uh... 'patrolling' in the vaults when a force of Dark Iron dwarves emerged from the depths in mole machines! I don't know what they are here for, but there is priceless loot--uh or, rather... I mean, 'important cultural heirlooms' down there! Please, recover any such relics you see and return them here.

I assure you that anything you recover will be catalogued and returned to its proper place of honor.
96403.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Dwarven Heirlooms from the Hall of Thanes.
96403.title: Important Heirlooms

96438.description:
$n, I need your aid. One of our brothers passing through Nigel's Point in Desolace overheard details of a battle that took place at the Mannoroc Coven. It was reported that one side brought powerful holy magic to bear in the battle against the warlocks there. Wielders of the light were certainly involved.

I'd like to learn more of who was involved in this skirmish. If one of our people was involved--or fell there... I want to know about it.
96438.objectivesText: Investigate the battle at the Mannoroc Coven in Desolace.
96438.title: Battle at the Mannoroc Coven

96604.description:
Lok-tar, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96604.objectivesText: Sit near Brakk's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.
96604.title: The Great Outdoors

96605.description:
Greetings, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.

96605.title: The Great Outdoors

96606.objectivesText: Sit near Lyreena's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.

96608.objectivesText: Sit near Eric's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.
96608.title: The Great Outdoors

96626.description:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

objectives.text: Learn cooking from Tomas in Goldshire

96626.objectivesText: Speak with Tomas in Goldshire to learn to become a cook.
96626.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96627.description:
$n, you have proven your competence as a protector thus far. That is why I am now entrusting you with an unusual task.

I've heard of a new adventurer down the road by Goldshire. Go and see what he's doing.
96627.objectivesText: Speak to Sam Sarsparilla near Goldshire.
96627.title: The Adventurer

96628.description:
Wait, $n. I have another ask of you, before you brave that tunnel.

My mountaineers have reported an adventurer that's shown up just outside of Kharanos. Could you deliver these supplies to him?
96628.objectivesText: Deliver the Supply Bundle to Eric Brighthammer near Kharanos.
96628.title: The Adventurer

96629.description:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

objectives.text: Learn cooking from Gremlock Pilsnor in Kharanos

96629.objectivesText: Speak with Gremlock Pilsnor in Kharanos to learn to become a cook.
96629.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96630.description:
<The journal appears to be quite plain, detailing the life and adventures of someone you've never heard of.

There are multiple entries mentioning camping. It seems to be quite... fun.>
96630.objectivesText: Bring the journal to Lyreena Duskblade near Dolanaar.
96630.title: The Adventurer

96634.description:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

objectives.text: Learn cooking from Zarrin in Dolanaar

96634.objectivesText: Speak with Zarrin in Dolanaar to learn to become a cook.
96634.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96638.description:
More and more adventurers like yourself have been seeking glory and fortune outside of the safety of Thendal Grove. There's one such adventurer who has made a camp outside of Shen'dar Village, along the road leading southwest out of Thendal Grove.

Seek him out and see what you can learn from him that may help you in your own travels.
96638.objectivesText: Speak to Raan Wildwind near Shen'dar Village.
96638.title: The Adventurer

96652.description:
<The journal appears to be quite plain, detailing the life and adventures of someone you've never heard of.

There are multiple entries mentioning camping. It seems to be quite... fun.>
96652.objectivesText: Bring the journal to Brakk near Razor Hill.
96652.title: The Adventurer
