96661.objectivesText: Speak with Pyall Silentstride in Bloodhoof Village to learn to become a cook.
96661.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96771.description:
In the region known as the Riverglades to the southeast, there is a place called the Krol'dok Stronghold. A highborne known as Zalfan Moonshadow has been seen there in the company of the Twilight's Hammer.

I'd pay handsomely if you'd rid the world of this cretin for me. He brings shame to the proud lineage of the highborne by consorting with fanatics and using stolen arcane knowledge in their service. There are few enough of us left without worms like him sullying our good name.
96771.objectivesText: Travel to Krol'dok Stronghold and slay Zalfan Moonshadow.
96771.title: Vengeance of the Highborne

96772.description:
Timear and I have been scrying the area on Kalimdor known as Alcaz Island and we've all but confirmed the presence of a powerful magic user there. The mage in question was able to dispel our probes, but before she did, I was able to glean an image of a tome of some sort. I believe it was a journal, written in ancient draconic script.

I don't know what is in that book, but I'd like to study it. We want you to travel to the hidden prison beneath Alcaz Island and recover that book for us.
96772.objectivesText: Recover Zarla's Journal from the depths of Alcaz Prison.
96772.title: The Dragon's Journal

96774.description:
The ancient Gurubashi of Stranglethorn Vale were da masters of dark blood magics. Rumors be they'd use pure truesilver idols to channel that bad bad voodoo.

Ol' Mazu'kon would love to get his hands on one of those idols... for academics ya see. How 'bout you gather some friends and do a bit of smash and grab on that drowned city stickin' out the ocean off the coast of Stranglethorn? Kill the most impressive lookin' priest ya can find in there, and they sure to have what I be lookin' for.
96774.objectivesText: Recover an Ancient Gurubashi Idol from the Drowned City.
96774.title: Ancient Gurubashi Idol

96776.description:
I have had a vision.

Deep in the place known as Maraudon, past the earth song falls, there is a chamber filled with brilliant white crystals and guarded by mighty giants. At the highest part of this chamber is a crystal of exceptional brilliance. It is an aspect of the sun god, the right eye of the Earthmother herself--An'she.

I've dreamed of its radiance and it calls to me. $c, remove An'she's Radiance from that place and bring it here where it belongs, under the open skies of Mulgore.
96776.objectivesText: Recover the crystal known as An'she's Radiance from Maraudon.
96776.title: An'she's Radiance

96784.description: <You recall Myrokos' instructions to find out about an important deal going on with the Syndicate in Stromgarde Keep. With your disguise, you should be able to talk to members of the Syndicate somewhat freely. Surely, one of them knows something.>
96784.objectivesText: While disguised as a member of the Syndicate, find someone inside Stromgarde Keep who knows about the secret deal.
96784.title: Master of Disguise

96785.description:
Who do you think you are? Showing up and sticking your nose in official business.

I'm not telling some rookie anything about the higher-up's dealings without good reason. Unless you've got something important, or valuable, for me, I've got nothing to say to you.
96785.objectivesText: Find something within Stromgarde Keep to convince Anastasia to give up details of the secret deal.
96785.title: Ain't No Telling

96797.description:
We often try to find surviving family for many of our charges, and occasionally we find something hopeful. I've received word that Randal here may have a surviving family member. The man's name is Danneth, and he is a soldier stationed at Nethergarde Keep. I need someone to travel there and find the man.

If you can, please convince Danneth to come retrieve his nephew. I don't think the two have ever met, but they are family all the same and Randal belongs with him.
96797.objectivesText: Travel to Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands and locate Sergeant Danneth.
96797.title: The Orphan

96800.description:
You there, $c. I have a matter I could use assistance with.

I just so happen to be writing a thesis on the ancient Wildhammer runemasters of Grim Batol, and there's a particular tome I need to complete my research. According to our ledgers, a mage by the name of Doan checked the book out of the old Dalaran library before the Third War and never returned it!

Arcanist Doan is now holed up in the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades. Retrieve this book for me and you'll be well rewarded.
96800.objectivesText: Retrieve the book The Lost Magic of the Runemasters from the Scarlet Monastery.
96800.title: Past Due

96821.description:
We see fewer and fewer travelers from Razor Hill these days. The scorpids were never much fun, but now I hear there are spiders making their nest along the road.

If your travels take you up north, kill some of the spiders on your way. Then, let Razor Hill know the path's a bit safer for them.
96821.objectivesText: Kill 6 Ridgeshade Creepers and 6 Ridgeshade Lurkers in southern Durotar, then report to Gar'thok in Razor Hill.
96821.title: Legging It

96822.description:
We lost many brave warriors of the Horde when we sacked Tiragarde Keep. Now that the humans have reinforced the ruins, we cannot collect their remains to properly honor their deaths.

Go to the ruins surrounding the keep, and search for the weapons left by our fallen kin. We will display them in a place of honor.
96822.objectivesText: Collect the Raider's Battleaxe, Raider's Bow, and Raider's Shield from the Tiragarde Keep outskirts, then return them to Turroc in Razor Hill.
96822.title: For Honor

96825.description:
Our hunters and fishers bring back plenty of savory food for our troops - but it's rare that they get a sweet treat.

I've seen a cactus that produces a prickly, tasty fruit. But it only grows in the hills to the west, where the wretched quilboars make their camps. Make your way past the quilboars and bring me some of those fruits. And be careful - the fruits are as spiny as the quilboars!
96825.objectivesText: Cook Torka in Razor Hill wants you to collect 8 Prickly Pear Fruit from the Razormane Grounds west of town.
96825.title: This Fruit Could Bite Back

96873.description:
The trolls east of here have lost their will to the witchdoctor, Zalazane. He uses many cruel magics to keep hold of his prisoners' minds, but one of his favorite tricks is to make them wear pendants wrapped in evil binding spells.

Practice your enchanting skills by stripping the magic from these pendants, and bring me the results. And don't accidentally put one around your neck, if you value your freedom!
96873.objectivesText: Pa'zula in Sen'jin Village wants you to collect 3 Luminous Residue. Luminous Residue can be obtained by disenchanting Hexed Pendants dropped by trolls in the Echo Isles.
96873.title: A Pain in the Neck

96874.description:
Have you seen the huge beasts of Thunder Ridge? I keep thinking the spines on their backs would be perfect for crafting the head of a mighty axe. Saru laughed when I told him... but what does he know!?

As part of your smithing lessons, you can help me out! Bring me some of those spines, along with grinding stones to sharpen them.
96874.objectivesText: Ug'thok in Orgrimmar wants you to collect 5 Weathered Spines from beasts in Thunder Ridge, along with 5 Rough Grinding Stones.
96874.title: This Is Spinal Axe

96875.description:
Orgrimmar is always expanding, $c. And when the peons need hides to line the walls and roofs of our new buildings, they come to me!

The hides of the lizards in Thunder Ridge are typically too thick for armor, but they make excellent building material. Bring me some of their hides, along with a few lighter cured hides. Let's see your skill with leather!
96875.objectivesText: Kamari in Orgrimmar wants you to collect 5 Rough Lizard Hide from beasts in Thunder Ridge, along with 2 Cured Light Hides.
96875.title: Beasts of Thunder Ridge

96876.description: The pack has the name "Ukor" crudely stitched along the flap.
96876.objectivesText: Return the pack to Ukor in southern Durotar.
96876.title: Ukor's Lost Pack

96877.description: The enormous hoof serves as proof of your victory over the mighty lizard.
96877.title: Halikor's Hoof

96895.description:
Not sure if you heard, but two emissaries of the Argent Dawn just passed through here. I don't mind the Argent Dawn, but I don't like them poking around Tirisfal unsupervised either. They were both Forsaken... but that doesn't make me any less nervous.

One of them just passed by here, headed southeast. There's a group of scourge cultists snooping around the outskirts of the city in that direction. If those two heard about them, there's no doubt that would have caught their attention.
96895.objectivesText: Find the Argent Dawn member near the entrance to the Undercity.
96895.title: The Argent Emissary

96899.description:
You've done a great thing for the cause of the Argent Dawn here today, and I thank you. I don't know how familiar you are with the fortress of Bandarion Keep, but my commander and I were headed that way to meet with the paladins that reside there. That was before we learned of the presence of the Cult of the Damned.

If you'd like to learn more about the Argent Dawn and our mission, seek out my commander at Bandarion Keep, to the northwest of here. I'll remain here to mop up the rest of this mess.
96899.objectivesText: Meet Leonid Barthalomew at Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades.
96899.title: Bandarion Keep

96984.description:
You may not have our best interests at heart, but I won't deny an extra pair of hands. And if Dalaran falls, it takes everything with it--including your Undercity.

So, your benefactor wants in? Fine. I'll imbue your key to work past my wards so you can enter the city. Once you're in, meet me at the Violet Citadel where this all began. With everything going on the Kirin Tor will be too busy to stop you.

Scavenge what you will, but whatever happens, our first priority is to prevent a catastrophe.
96984.objectivesText: Collect the Arcane Mote in the City of Dalaran for Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill.
96984.title: Heart of Disruption

96986.description:
Within the underbelly of the mage city to the north is a traitor to our kind. A necromancer of disturbing talent. He raises an army of undeath right under the Kirin Tor's nose.

I care not for the fate of the mage city, $n, but this grave knight spits in the face of everything we Forsaken stand for. Put an end to him. Show him no one is beyond the reach of the Dark Lady.
96986.objectivesText: Defeat Atrexis the Grave Knight in the City of Dalaran for Melisara in Tarren Mill.
96986.title: The Grave Knight

96987.description:
Well if it ain't a like-minded entrepreneur. Sneakin' into Dalaran durin' such troublesome times? Tsk tsk.

My kinda $r!

While our mage friends here are occupied, maybe we could find ourselves some 'misplaced' treasures. They gots whole libraries dedicated to fancy arcane magics. If you could bring me one of their secret tomes, I could sell it for a pretty penny. Split the profits with ya.

Hey hey don't look at me like that. You ain't exactly here on a field trip yourself. You want in or what?
96987.objectivesText: Collect the Founding of Dalaran from the City of Dalaran for Rexxie Copperclutch near the sewer entrance.
96987.title: Opportunistic Education

96988.description:
With the city of Dalaran under siege by their own constructs, this is the perfect opportunity to, let's say, borrow a few samples.

Imagine an army of arcane-powered abominations. The Dark Lady would have no choice but to recognize my alchemical prowess. Maybe even grant me head of the Royal Apothecary Society?

Go to the city and find the constructs' cores. They are unlikely to give them willingly, so do what you must.
96988.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Cracked Sentry Cores in the City of Dalaran for Doctor Martin Felben in Undercity.
96988.title: Source of Power

conditionalDescriptions.text:
Ey, warlock! I must admit I be surprised to see one of your talents here at me stables.

If you are looking for a mount, ya have come to the right place, though they ain't the same as those felsteeds you are accustom to summoning.

Either way, you're welcome to take a look at our raptors, should ya want one. Most be underestimatin' how intelligent and savage these beasts be. Ya won't be findin' a better, faster or more lethal companion once ya be bonded with it.

Go an' take a look to see if any catch ya interest and return to me when ya made ya choice.

96989.description:
Ey mon! Today be a big day for ya, I see. Ya think you're ready to take de reins of one of these fierce creatures, huh?

Most be underestimatin' how intelligent and savage these beasts be. Ya won't be findin' a better, faster or more lethal companion once ya be bonded with it.

So, you be havin' an important choice to make. Ya raptor and you will be traversin' the world together, and the raptor will also be needin' to choose ya in return.

Go an' take a look and return to me when ya made ya choice.
96989.objectivesText: Inspect the riding raptors to choose your first mount.
96989.title: Your First Riding Raptor

96996.description:
Now that you have completed your training, it would seem the winds wish you to bond with your first strider.

These galestriders have been ridden by our ancestors for generations. Despite their wispy and slender appearance, they are steadfast and fierce mounts.

You and your strider will traverse the world together, so you have an important choice to make. Fear not, whatever choice you make will be the right one.

Go examine the striders and return to me when you have made your choice.
96996.objectivesText: Inspect the riding striders to choose your first mount.
96996.title: Your First Riding Galestrider

conditionalDescriptions.text:
Greetings, paladin. I must admit I am surprised to see one of your order here at my stables.

If you are looking for a mount, you have come to the right place, though they may pale in comparison to the chargers you are accustomed to.

Regardless, I encourage you to peruse our steeds, should you want one. Ours are some of the finest steeds in the land, and even though you radiate with holy power they should still bear you as faithfully and without issue.

Go examine the undead horses to see if any are to your liking and return to me when you have made your choice.

Greetings, warlock. I must admit I am surprised to see one of your talents here at my stables.

If you are looking for a mount, you have come to the right place, though they may pale in comparison to the felsteeds you are accustomed to summoning.

Regardless, I encourage you to peruse our steeds, should you want one. Ours are some of the finest steeds in the land, and they should still bear you as faithfully as your summoned infernal felsteed.

Though I would advise against lighting the skeletal horses on fire. That is an aesthetic best saved for the unholy creatures you and your council conjure.

Go examine the undead horses to see if any are to your liking and return to me when you have made your choice.

96997.description:
Greetings, $c. I imagine I can guess what has brought you to my stables today.

If you are looking for a mount, you have come to the right place. Be warned though, riding an undead steed is not for the faint of heart.

As such, you have an important choice to make. You and your undead steed will travel the world together for good or ill. Fear not, whatever choice you make will be the correct one.

Go examine the undead horses and return to me when you have made your choice.
96997.objectivesText: Inspect the undead riding horses to choose your first mount.
96997.title: A Steed in Death as They Were in Life

97003.description:
You there, $c. I need your aid. There are rumors of a beast that makes its lair deep in a cave at Thorn Hill, northeast of here. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener". It's supposedly five times the size of a normal quilboar with a thirst for blood that can never be sated.

Most don't believe the tales. But I do--because I've fought its like before.

Seek out its lair and slay Chol'aruk. Bring me its head. I warn you though--prepare well and do not go alone.

Blood and thunder, $c.
97003.objectivesText: Bring the head of Chol'aruk to Gur'ak in the Barrens.
97003.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener

97005.description:
There are rumors of a colossal abomination that makes its lair at a cave to the northwest of here, on the plateau known as Thorn Hill. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener" and those that have seen it say it's so massive that it can swallow an orc whole.

Few believe such tales, but I do... because I've fought one like it myself. On the honor of those I lost to these things, this beast must die.

Gather strong allies and find the lair of Chol'aruk. Kill the abomination and bring me its head.
97005.objectivesText: Bring Chol'aruk's Head to Bainham in the Barrens.
97005.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener

conditionalDescriptions.text:
Ho there, paladin! I must admit I am surprised to see one of yer order here at my stables.

If you're looking for a mount, you have come to the right place, though they may pale in comparison to the chargers you are accustomed to.

Regardless, I encourage you to peruse our fine rams, should you want one. These rams are the most steadfast and sturdy in all of Azeroth. They're fiercely protective of their rider. Aye, you'll have a hard time finding a more and stalwart companion for your journeys.

Go see the rams and see if any are to your liking, then return to me when you've made yer choice.

97017.description:
Ah, it's a big day fer ya I see; here for yer first ram are ye?

These rams are the most steadfast and sturdy in all of Azeroth. They're fiercely protective of their rider. Aye, you'll have a hard time finding a more stalwart companion for yer journeys.

So, you have an important choice to make. You and yer ram will traverse the world together so choose wisely! Not to worry lad, whatever choice you make will be the right one.

Go see the rams and return to me when you've made yer choice.
97017.objectivesText: Inspect the riding rams to choose your first mount.
97017.title: Your First Riding Ram

97018.description:
Hello, $c! It would seem yer now seasoned enough as an adventurer for me ta teach ye how to ride a ram, for a fee o'course.

Veron will provide ye with a free mount once ye have trained with me, and after you'll be able to purchase any additional mounts ye would like. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but ye will have to find trainers for each.

Speak ta me when you have enough coin, and I'll teach ye all I know about riding rams.
97018.objectivesText: Learn the Apprentice Riding skill from Ultham Ironhorn.
97018.title: Learning to Ride

97022.description: Danitha Morr has ordered you to report back to Bandarion Keep to receive additional training. Please make your way back to the keep as quickly as you are able.
97022.objectivesText: Speak with Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep.
97022.title: Report to Danitha

conditionalDescriptions.text:
Salutations, warlock! I must admit I am surprised to see one of your talents here, but your coin is certainly still welcome.

If you are looking for a mount, you have come to the right place, though they will certainly feel different than the felsteeds you are accustomed to summoning.

Regardless, I encourage you to peruse our latest mechanostrider models, should you want one. If you see one you like, let me know so we can synchronize your biometrics to the rider detection protocol. This protocol will help the strider distinguish you from other possible riders.

Go examine the mechanostriders and let me know if you find any to your liking!

97046.description:
Salutations! I see today is a big day indeed; today you will synchronize your biometrics to the rider detection protocol of your first mechanostrider! This protocol will help the strider distinguish you from other possible riders.

As such, you have an important choice to make. You and your strider will traverse the world together so choose wisely! Fear not, whatever choice you make will be the correct one.

Go examine the mechanostriders and return to me when you have made your choice.
97046.objectivesText: Inspect the riding mechanostriders to choose your first mount.
97046.title: Your First Mechanostrider

97047.description:
Hey! You! You have to help me! I was just out exploring the jungle when, all of a sudden, I was ambushed by these maniacs! I don't know what they plan to do with me, but I've heard talk of tigers and headshrinkers, and I don't want part in either!

I don't know how, but you have to get me out of here! Please! A key to this cage, a disguise to sneak out, something! Anything!
97047.objectivesText: Find a key to Wendel's cage, and a disguise for him to sneak out, within the Kurzen compound.
97047.title: The Cook in the Cage

97048.description: Listen, I can't repay you right now, but I'm a cook on Captain Aransas' ship. I'll be sure to put in a good word for you when I get back to Booty Bay. You should speak to the captain when you get the chance. I'm sure she'll be grateful to have me back.
97048.objectivesText: Speak to Captain Aransas in Booty Bay.
97048.title: Returning to Port

97074.description:
Hello, $c! It would seem you are now seasoned enough as an adventurer for me to teach you how to ride a saber, for a fee of course.

Lelanai will provide you with a free mount once ye have trained with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts ye would like. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but you will have to find trainers for each.

Speak to me when you have enough coin, and I will teach you all I know about riding sabers.
97074.objectivesText: Learn the Apprentice Riding skill from Jartsam.
97074.title: Learning to Ride

97130.description:
Lan'dalock and I have been discussing a recent development in the south seas involving an ancient Gurubashi ruin that has suddenly appeared off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale.

Such a site has significant archeological value. We'd be highly interested in obtaining one of the idols that certain witch doctors amongst the ancient Gurubashi would use as a ritual focus for their blood magic.

Enter this "Drowned City" and recover one of these idols for us.
97130.objectivesText: Recover an Ancient Gurubashi Idol from the Drowned City.
97130.title: Ancient Gurubashi Secrets

97170.description:
Hello, $c! It would seem you are now seasoned enough as an adventurer for me to teach you how to ride a horse, for a fee of course.

Katie will provide you with a free mount once ye have trained with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you would like. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but you will have to find trainers for each.

Speak to me when you have enough coin, and I will teach you all I know about riding horses.
97170.objectivesText: Learn the Apprentice Riding skill from Randal Hunter.
97170.title: Learning to Ride

97173.description:
The Blackmaw furbolgs in the mountains overlooking Azshara have been dabbling in dark magic. While a primitive people being corrupted by demonic magic is nothing new for Azeroth, Lan'dalock and I would like to study their spell foci.

Travel to the stronghold known as Blackmaw Hold and recover one of the Blackmaw Ritual Totems for us. Only the most powerful of the Blackmaw's shamans will be carrying one of these, so bring allies and take care.
97173.objectivesText: Recover a Blackmaw Ritual Totem from Blackmaw Hold.
97173.title: Blackmaw Magic

97188.description:
Greetings, $c! You are now seasoned enough as an adventurer for me to teach you how to pilot a mechanostrider, for a fee of course.

Milli will provide you with a free mount once you have trained with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you would like. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but you will have to find trainers for each.

Speak to me when you have enough gold, and I will teach you about riding mechanostriders!
97188.objectivesText: Learn the Apprentice Riding skill from Binjy Featherwhistle.
97188.title: Learning to Ride

97194.description:
Mok'ra, $c. You are now seasoned enough as an adventurer for me to teach you how to ride one of our wolves, for a fee of course.

Ogunaro will provide you with a free mount once you have trained with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you would like. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but you will have to find trainers for each.

Speak to me when you have enough gold, and I will teach you about wolf riding.
97194.objectivesText: Learn the Apprentice Riding skill from Kildar.
97194.title: Learning to Ride

97196.description:
There is a servant of the Lich King that makes his home deep in the Death's Head quilboar lair known as Razorfen Downs. It is known to us that he makes use of a scrying orb to observe and direct the movements of his minions elsewhere.

With this artifact, we'd be able to hunt down the covert agents of the Scourge and put an end to them and the threat they pose to Kalimdor forever.

Go into Razorfen Downs to the lair of Amnennar the Coldbringer and retrieve the orb known as the Coldbringer's Eye for me.
97196.objectivesText: Recover The Coldbringer's Eye from Razorfen Downs.
97196.title: The Coldbringer's Eye

97220.description:
Every day this week we've been short dockhands.

Care to ease the stress on our cargo schedule?

Take this package to the stockroom entrance of the Gatehouse. You'll find it inside Trias' Cheese shop on the second floor. The mistress, Elaine, will be quite familiar with the deliveries. The Gatehouse often has shipments arriving with more discretion to allow for ceremonial surprises on behalf of the guard's officers.
97220.objectivesText: Bring the Gatehouse Shipment to the stockroom entrance located in Trias' Cheese shop in the Trade District.
97220.title: Philmor's Favor

97222.description:
Yes, it's only a flight of stairs, but if it's such a small ask, it should be no problem for you to finish the delivery yourself! 

Trias' Cheese isn't part of the Gatehouse or their stocking inventory, but our buildings share a floor.

Place the crate outside their stockroom door--the guard will send someone for a regular pickup. They will see the package arrival and carry it inside as they return to post.
97222.objectivesText: Carry the Gatehouse Shipment up the stairs in Trias' shop and leave it outside the door.
97222.title: Gatehouse Goods

97223.description:
All of the raptors you see before you are ones I have trained myself. They come from all over Kalimdor, but some of the finest come from the Bloodtalon raptors on the isles off our coast.

One raptor amongst them, the Bloodtalon Matriarch, is particularly savage and has killed many from our village and has become too dangerous to leave at our borders. If you can strike her down, return with her eggs so that we can raise the hatchlings as allies instead of enemies.
97223.objectivesText: Bring Eggs of the Bloodtalon Matriarch to Xar'Ti in Sen'jin Village.
97223.title: Bloodtalon Matriarch

97225.description:
When we fled the isles that Zalazane and his ilk now inhabit, we left behind many precious idols that help us commune with spirits we worship: our loa. They are of grave importance to our tribe.

The followers of Zalazane show no reverence for our loa and have scattered these idols across the largest of the isles.

This is an action that will not go unnoticed if we are not able to collect these idols, and offending a loa is a grave matter.

Go, find as many loa idols as you can and return them to me.
97225.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Forgotten Loa Idols from the Echo Isles. Bring them to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
97225.title: Forgotten Loa Idols

97236.description: A fresh specimen from a beast of this size is quite a find. Perhaps someone in Aldrassil familiar with the study of spiders would be interested in the fang.
97236.objectivesText: Deliver the Fang of Githyiss to someone interested in the study of spiders in Aldrassil.
97236.title: Fang of Githyiss

97237.description:
I've checked our inventory and all of the selections Mr. Lewells has listed are currently available.

You will, however, need to procure them off the shelves yourself. Part of our librarian duty is vigilance, and for that, I will resume supervisory bookkeeping.

Returning with the material to Roy on his behalf will not mark yourself accountable for their return; as with his note you're serving as the book club's official courier. Their establishment shall carry that burden.

Good day, $n.
97237.objectivesText: Find each of the reading materials located somewhere in the library and then return to Roy Lewells in Stormwind's Park.
97237.title: Shelf Picked

97242.description:
Yelmak doesn't want his apprentice breaking anything. Well, anything more than he already has.

He told me the young mixer in training has too much pride to ask for help when he really needs it. Yelmak wants to give him a taste of a particular home-brewed recipe.

Gather a mix of cattail and speargrass cuttings taken from the plants growing around the water in the Valley of Honor. I'd get them myself, but if I left the shop, Whuut would surely know we're catering to his mood.
97242.objectivesText: Take some cuttings from the Cattails and Speargrass growing around the water flows in the Valley of Honor and return to Kor'geld in Yelmak's Alchemy and Potions.
97242.title: Yelmak's Medley

97243.description:
Even though we are in the realm of Skywall, this is still the elemental plane. The spirits of all four elements speak to us, if we deign to listen. One among us Windshapers is in particular attunement with the element of fire. A shen'dorei by the name of Olariaan Swiftburn.

Bring this to him at the Shrine of Flames in the Gustberry Lowlands. You'll find it tucked away along the edge of the island, west of Valanaar.
97243.objectivesText: Bring the Torch of Dormant Flame to Olariaan Swiftburn at the Shrine of Flames in the Gustberry Lowlands.
97243.title: Call of Fire

97244.description:
There is an Al'Aketh Skypriest called Faladiel. He was once a caller of the flame and a stalwart Windshaper. Like so many Al'Aketh, he mortgaged his loyalty for power and his hands are now stained with the blood of his former brothers and sisters.

You will find Skypriest Faladiel at the farm to the northeast past Valanaar, just to the south of the Shrine of Akir. Kill the betrayer. Bring me his heart. It is a gruesome task, but it is needed for the ritual we are to perform.
97244.objectivesText: Slay Skypriest Faladiel in the Gustberry Lowlands and collect Faladiel's Heart.
97244.title: Call of Fire

97246.description:
My son, Migi, always takes off to play with his friends all day. I tell him to pick up a lunch at Borstan's, but I know he almost never does, because he comes home starving. These kids think their games are more important than their own bodies!

Please, stop at Borstan's Firepit and tell him you're there to deliver Migi's lunch. You can almost certainly find Migi behind Grommash Hold with the rest of his friends.

Duties keep me here during the day and I can't watch over his every meal.
97246.objectivesText: Visit Borstan's Firepit and tell him Thatog wants you to deliver Migi's lunch to him personally.
97246.title: Meal Appeal

97249.description:
Now that I know his parents worry about how much he's actually filling that belly, I've got an idea. 

They made me promise not to pack the same meal every day, so Migi grows a taste for more than one thing. Still, whenever the smoker's full and we're making sweetglazed hog belly sandwiches, he always shows up for lunch. We've started crumbling the leftover crispy glazed bits as a topping--something we can add daily. 

Take this to him. Maybe he'll start showing up early and bringing friends!
97249.objectivesText: Bring Migi's Lunch to him behind Grommash Hold.
97249.title: Favorite Food

97250.description:
Traveler, have you plans to head toward Dustwallow Marsh? I have heard mutterings that a few human soldiers have taken a stand at its border and are toppling the landmarks left behind by our tauren pathfinders.

Rumor has it that a favored tavern has burned to the ground, and in typical Alliance fashion, they immediately cast their blame onto the Horde! I cannot know whether there is any truth to their claim, but their incursion onto OUR land must not stand.

Kill first, investigate later!
97250.objectivesText: Slay Alliance soldiers encroaching into the Barrens at the border to Dustwallow Marsh, then return to Grunt Logmar at Camp Taurajo.
97250.title: Wrongly Blamed, Justly Corrected

97277.description:
Oi, had me back turned gettin' the boar roast ready when I heard me pal Gozwin screamin' fer his life!

Wicked fangs and a blur are all I saw when I turned. Such huge paws! A snow leopard was draggin' its gnomish catch away. I grabbed me shotgun and fired above the beast. It dropped him and sprinted off.

Luckily, it hadn't done more than give ol' Goz some deep scratches.

Head back to camp in the northwestern hills and retrieve Gozwin's Mechanic's Log. Kill that snow leopard too if you see it!
97277.objectivesText: Find Grund and Gozwin's camp in the hills to the northwest. Recover Gozwin's Mechanic's Log and kill the Snow Leopard Prowler.
97277.title: Grund and Gozwin

97279.description:
With an influx of new recruits like yourself, it's been hard to keep our weapons supplied. Our weaponsmith, Kzan, is running low on training weapons and I'd like to see what kinds of skills you possess to get an idea of what I have to work with. Luckily for you, I have a solution to both.

While you're out there cutting your teeth on boars, salvage six abandoned training weapons. Our failed recruits left them laying on the ground. Once you do, return them to our weaponsmith Kzan behind me in the Den.
97279.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Abandoned Training Weapons, then return to Kzan Thornslash in the Den.
97279.title: Wayward Weapons

97281.description:
<Before you is a strange orb with a dull surface. When picked up a small electrical current seems to vibrate from within. Upon closer inspection, it looks as if a dark mist swirls within and every so often a small electrical spark can be seen.

It is clear the harpy was using it for some purpose. Perhaps Rezlak would be interested in this object?>
97281.objectivesText: Bring the Dull Stormy Orb to Rezlak near Drygulch Ravine.
97281.title: A Simmering Storm

97282.description:
"Rezlack, when an opportunity comes knocking make sure you're ready to seize it." That's another gem Gazlowe taught me and that's exactly what I intend to do.

This orb doesn't seem damaged, it just looks like it's out of juice, but I've the idea to supercharge it back to full strength!

There are a bunch of thunder lizards in a gorge west of here. They have organs that hold a strong electrical charge that would be perfect for this.

Go harvest some and bring them back to me!
97282.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Charged Thunder Lizard Organs to Rezlak near Drygulch Ravine.
97282.title: Stormy Potential

97284.description:
If Malem is still alive, then I suspect the Burning Blade orcs are expecting someone to come searching for her soon enough. They will certainly be ready for a fight.

I would prefer if you kept a low profile and stayed out of their way, but the far more likely reality is that they will be looking to meet you, blade to Burning Blade, at every opportunity.

So how about we plan to keep score from the start. Kill as many as you can, and I'll make it worth your time.
97284.objectivesText: Slay Burning Blade orcs at Thunder Axe Fortress in the Desolace, then return to Vahlarriel Demonslayer at Nijel's Point.
97284.title: Vahlarriel's Vengeance

97287.description:
You have done well to infiltrate the city of mages, but I believe it is time for us to be more... negotiatory.

As much as it pains me to admit, there is no other place on Azeroth with such a vast knowledge of the arcane. My brilliant work still pales in comparison to the ancient wisdom the Kirin Tor have amassed over the years. I think it's high time we are granted access to this exclusive order, don't you think?

Take the mote you acquired. They will surely give anything to get it back. Anything.
97287.objectivesText: Speak with the Image of Archmage Modera near Dalaran.
97287.title: Shrewd Negotiations

97288.areaDescription: Deliver the Abominable Head to someone within the Undercity.
97288.description:
<As the creature falls, its head comes toppling off. It seems as if it has been reattached several times, and the connection gets weaker with each reconnection.

Someone in the Undercity would know more about this unique abomination.>
97288.objectivesText: Deliver the Abominable Head to Master Apothecary Faranell within the Undercity.
97288.title: Unending Torment

97289.description:
We craft abomination heads all the time, but this one is special. It belonged to a Grand Marshal of the Alliance once. A particularly unpleasant one. Othmar, I believe its name was. The Dark Lady had the pleasure of dispatching this one herself.

Ooh the secrets it could tell if it could talk. And it can! If we reattach it to an appropriate host.

Go ahead and place it next to the available body in the next room. But don't attach it. Not yet.
97289.objectivesText: Bring the Head of the Baron to the body of Othmar in the Undercity.
97289.title: Unending Torment

97290.description:
You... abomination...

Why should... help you...

Be gone...
97290.objectivesText: Report your findings to Master Apothecary Faranell in Undercity.
97290.title: Unending Torment

97291.description:
With the head reattached, all we need now is to bind it to the Dark Lady's will. This should not be a problem. The beast barely has brains left as it is after all the beatings it's taken.

We simply need to motivate it.

Fetch me a Toxic Skullcap from Miss Grisette in the Trade Quarter. Oh, and some Blisterweed from our local herbalist trainers, the Alliestars. Feel free to just take some, they owe me. And lastly a bit of Essence of Agony. Any old poison vendor should do.

We have a potion to make!
97291.objectivesText: Collect a Toxic Skullcap from Tawny Grisette in the Trade Quarter, Blisterweed near the Herbalism Trainer, and Essence of Agony from the poison vendor in the Rogues' Quarter for Master Apothecary Faranell in Undercity.
97291.title: Unending Torment

97326.description:
Hey! You've got time to help us out! I know you do, I can tell by the way you smiled watching the game we're playing.

This spot behind Grommash Hold is nice because it's clear enough for us to set up our figures. But what stinks is we don't have enough rocks for chairs or tables.

You're big and strong... d'ya think you could carry back some medium-sized rocks, smooth enough to sit on if we need a rest?
97326.objectivesText: Return $1oa Smooth Boulders to Thra behind Grommash Hold.
97326.title: Rocks to Rests

97328.description:
<As you sift through the debris left behind by a horrible zeppelin crash directly above, you find evidence of a hefty shipment of supplies that has long since been plundered of all its value. Even the shipping labels have been torn and shredded, leaving only the words 'Booty Bay' barely legible on one.

Countless two-toed footprints and several patches of divotted earth all lead toward ruins in the northwest.>
97328.objectivesText: Recover $1oa Stolen Shipments from the Ruins of Zul'Kunda in Stranglethorn Vale and return your haul to someone in Booty Bay.
97328.title: Anything of Value

97329.description:
You! Yes, you! Come here, keep your voice down!

I screwed up big time. I managed to secure a sweet deal for Booty Bay to use their zeppelin tower for expedited deliveries and on our very first route I saw a huge bird--err, got SHOT DOWN just to the east of here!

I survived the crash, unfortunately, but before I woke up, I was already being dragged by my ears! Now I'm surrounded by bloodthirsty trolls and locked in a cage!

Look, I just need the key, okay? I can escape on my own.
97329.objectivesText: Bring the Primitive Key obtained from the trolls at the Ruins of Zul'kunda in Stranglethorn Vale to Zimmix Sputterspark.
97329.title: Where's the Key?

97331.description:
Wait, wait, don't go yet!

I know I said I just needed the key but... well, they caught me once, they could do it again, right? I'm just one goblin, and there's hundreds of trolls around here!

You've already put enough of a dent in their numbers to get this key, so it should be easy enough to stand guard while we mosey on out of here, huh?
97331.objectivesText: Escort Zimmix Sputterspark away from the Ruins of Zul'Kunda then tell Wharfmaster Lozgil in Booty Bay of your successful rescue.
97331.title: Zimmix's Great Escape

97332.description:
As much as I don't like the guy, I've heard what the Bloodscalp tribe do to their prisoners, and it ain't pretty. I'm glad Zimmix made it out alright.

However, I have another urgent delivery and I do NOT trust him to take it on. The problem? Nobody else will be available to take this before he does. You, however, have rescued lost cargo and a captured goblin, so you're looking pretty trustworthy from down here.

Any chance I can convince you to take this to Whizzbuzz at Powderfuse Port?
97332.objectivesText: Deliver the Twice Reordered Package to Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.
97332.title: Twice Misplaced Trust

97405.description:
Gnaz over there has been building that death trap for the competition all the way over in Kalimdor. I have been warning him that his constant late-night tinkering is making a ton of noise, and last night I saw an ogre peeking his ugly head out from behind that tree!

He's obsessed with this ambitious dream to win the Mirage Raceway Championships, but I'm obsessed with not getting mauled to death! Please head over the hill to the north and make sure they stop snooping around the place.
97405.objectivesText: Knaz Blunderflame wants you to kill $1oa Mosh'Ogg Spellcrafters, $2oa Mosh'Ogg Warmongers, $3oa Mosh'Ogg Maulers, and $4oa Mosh'Ogg Shaman at the Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mount.
97405.title: Noise Complaints

97420.description:
I have a favor to ask of someone, and you look helpful!

You see this baby here? Ain't she a beaut? This is my newest racer, designed and built all by myself, because SOMEONE wouldn't help. I plan on taking this to the races in Thousand Needles, but it needs a little extra kick.

Now, I'm too handsome to be a goblin, and I know better than to trust their tech, but I know the Venture Co struck liquid gold over at the lake. I'm sure they won't mind if you, erm, borrowed some? They won't even notice!
97420.objectivesText: Acquire $1oa Drums of Crude Oil from the Venture Co. operations at Lake Nazferiti, then return to Knaz Blunderflame in Stranglethorn Vale.
97420.title: Reduce, Reuse, Reconcile

97534.description:
Pssst, wanna know somethin'? It's easier to make profit in a place like this than you think... it's all about knowing how to market! I've seen what these tech-heads do when they get their hands on something they think they can turn into a fuel cell.

Even better if it's still glowin' or sputtering steam.

Why don't we strike a deal? Bring back some of the parts that fall off their machines in the desert, and I'll kick you back a share of the coin I get from selling the salvage back to the junkers!
97534.objectivesText: Quinn wants you to recover $1oa  pieces of Desert Debris and return to her in Gadgetzan.
97534.title: Gritty Business

97536.description:
The Matter Transporter required experimentation to get right. Many tests were conducted on all sorts of materials... with various outcomes! Some of the results are no longer with us. Others have become dangerously charged!

These subjected objects emit an energy that burns if you stay near for too long. Almost like they've been charged with a year's worth of the desert sun's power.

Take this Crate of Radioactive Refuse and empty the contents in the sand a safe distance from town and other trash.
97536.objectivesText: Jhordy Lapforge wants you to return to him after you have dumped the Crate of Radioactive Refuse in the desert of Tanaris a safe distance away from Gadgetzan and other trash.
97536.title: Gnomish Garbage

97538.description:
Greetings, friend. I wonder if I may ask a favor of you? I have just run out of red pigment for my paints, and I am looking for one with younger hooves to make the long journey into the Stonetalon Mountains on my behalf.

In the middle of the mountain pass there lies a large circular lake, Mirkfallon Lake, that has a unique plant that grows within its waters. The pods of this plant, mirkweed, turn a vibrant red when dried. Gather the pods of this plant for me, and I will reward you well for your efforts.
97538.objectivesText: Tah Winterhoof in Thunder Bluff wants $1oa Mirkweed Pods from Mirkfallon Lake.
97538.title: Pigments for Paints

97617.description:
Hullo there, you look like the helpful sort.

The name's Dorgaron, and I'm with the Explorers' League. We've not had the best of luck with diggin' in the Badlands, but I know darn well there's artifacts to find and collect!

Before I can convince the boss to let us send another crew out here, I need to prove that the dig sites are safe AND haven't been picked clean.

If you find yourself down south, gather a few reasonably intact artifacts and some leftover equipment that hasn't been smashed yet.
97617.objectivesText: Recover $1oa Unstudied Artifacts, an Explorers' League Mining Helmet, and a Pristine Mattock and bring them to Dorgaron at the border of Loch Modan and the Badlands.
97617.title: Safety Checks

97821.description:
<Upon the elemental's demise, a relic fell from its core that glimmered in the sand.

As it was tilted in your hands, the reflection of the surrounding environment obscured it from your own view. Only once you saw a cracked surface that warped the reflection was it clearly visible again.

Perhaps someone would be interested in this discovery.>
97821.objectivesText: Find someone in the Badlands that would be interested in this discovery.
97821.title: Mirage Mirror

conditionalDescriptions.text:
You look like a well-preserved Forsaken, all things considered. I am looking for someone to travel to Sunnyglade, in the Riverglades just north of the Redridge Mountains.

My family owned an armory there, once. Now I imagine it is a burnt husk, but I would have you retrieve a tome containing my family's ancestral armor crafting techniques. It was originally in the basement, so hopefully it has not succumbed to the elements just yet.

97884.description:
You look like a healthy, able-bodied $r. I am looking for someone to travel to Sunnyglade, in the Riverglades just north of the Redridge Mountains.

My family owned an armory there, once. Now I imagine it is a burnt husk, but I would have you retrieve a tome containing my family's ancestral armor crafting techniques. It was originally in the basement, so hopefully it has not succumbed to the elements just yet.
97884.objectivesText: Travel to Sunnyglade in the Riverglades and recover the tome of Tremayne Family Blacksmithing Techniques.
97884.title: Armory of Sunnyglade

97891.description:
You! Quickly, I need you to bring this potion across the slime canal to Doctor Martin Felben in the Apothecarium!

It has a very limited shelf life, and no I can't go myself, my knees rattle and pop out if I attempt to run.

Just another lovely side effect of undeath, apparently.

But we're wasting time! Here, take this and go!

<Alessandro makes a shooing motion.>
97891.objectivesText: Bring the Unstable Potion to Doctor Martin Felben in the Apothecarium within the time limit.
97891.title: Prompt Potion Runner

97894.areaDescription: Take the boat to Auberdine and find Gorbold Steelhand.
97894.description:
Pleasure to make yer acquaintance! Name's Borgus, of the one and only Steelhand family. You can always count on a Steelhand fer a fair deal!

A few weeks back me brother Gorbold joined up with a merchant stall in Auberdine. Plenty of coin to be made supplyin' ships there, let me tell you! Lucky sod.

I haven't heard from him since--mind checking on him if yer heading that way?

There's a new ship in the harbor that will take ye straight there. Head to the southern-most dock; can't miss it!
97894.objectivesText:
Check on Gorbold Steelhand in Auberdine in Darkshore.

Borgus mentioned a boat on the southern-most dock in Stormwind Harbor that can take you there.
97894.title: Business in Auberdine

97900.description:
So, you've become a Blacksmith. That's a great choice if you want to make sure your blades never dull.

I reckon I know someone that can help with that by teaching you how to craft a Sharpening Wheel. Bring one of these out at your camp and all the warriors and rogues in the area will be lining up to hone their weapons.
97900.objectivesText: Speak with Dwukk in Razor Hill to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97900.title: Camping 101: Blacksmithing

97901.description:
Enchanters make everything better and are always welcome at any camp out in the wilds.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp. It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
97901.objectivesText: Speak with Jhag in Orgrimmar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97901.title: Camping 101: Enchanting

97903.description:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $c.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.

objectives.text: Raise your first aid skill to 20

97903.objectivesText: Speak with Rawrk in Razor Hill to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97903.title: Camping 101: First Aid

97904.description:
You might not think so, but your skill as a fisherman can actually come in handy at camp.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.
97904.objectivesText: Speak with Lau'Tiki near Sen'jin Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97904.title: Camping 101: Fishing

97905.description:
Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.
97905.objectivesText: Speak with Jandi in Orgrimmar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97905.title: Camping 101: Herbalism

97907.description:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.
97907.objectivesText: Speak with Krunn in Razor Hill to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97907.title: Camping 101: Mining

97908.description:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
97908.objectivesText: Speak with Thuwd in Orgrimmar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97908.title: Camping 101: Skinning

97914.description:
Auberdine is a humble place, $c. You won't hear its name spoken in the boughs of Darnassus. Most reference only what the Sundering took from us--the thriving cities of Ameth'Aran, Bashal'Aran, and... Lathar'Lazal.

Yet Auberdine remains in their shadow.

I would see our work here recognized. A new vessel connects us to the kingdom of Stormwind, bringing life and supplies to our shores. I beseech you to join its next voyage, and bring this letter to a human called Baros Alexston.

Make our home known.
97914.objectivesText:
Bring Thundris' Letter to Baros Alexston in Stormwind.

Thundris mentioned a boat in Auberdine that can take you there.
97914.title: Expanding Horizons
